As an equal opportunities employer, we recognize that diversity is a positive attribute and we welcome the differences and benefits that a diverse culture brings. Come join us! items.title: Performance Analytics and Dashboard Specialist
items.summary: Position SummaryThe Project Monitor operates the performance, data, and compliance monitoring system for project.
items.description: Position Summary The Project Monitor operates the performance, data, and compliance monitoring system for project. This individual translates the QASP and PWS into measurable definitions, reliable data-collection processes, dashboards, quarterly reports, and corrective-action workflows. The Project Monitor provides an objective view of whether TTA, pilots, products, and deliverables are timely, high quality, useful, and likely to produce sustainable results. Core Responsibilities Develop and maintain the performance-measure dictionary, data-collection plan, reporting calendar, source documentation, quality checks, and dashboard required by the QASP. Track the number, type, frequency, duration, level of effort, recipients, outputs, and status of TTA and program-support activities by quarter. Measure recipient roles, knowledge gain, use of rapid-cycle evaluation and learning, satisfaction, implementation progress, product use, and sustainability indicators. Monitor the PWS requirement that at least 85 percent satisfaction be achieved for sponsored training and technical assistance activities and flag emerging performance gaps. Compile quarterly performance and outcomes reports and provide validated monitoring inputs for monthly status reports, the annual report, briefings, and pilot learning products. Track deliverable schedules, review cycles, Government comments, acceptance status, quality findings, risks, corrective actions, and evidence of closure. Support pilot-site data planning, baseline and monitoring data, data dictionaries, data-use controls, privacy protections, missing-data rules, and cross-site synthesis. Conduct data-quality checks, reconcile source records, document limitations, and prevent unsupported causal claims or overstatement of results. Coordinate with the Project Leader and SME and Content Manager on logic models, measures, analytic questions, promising-practice evidence, and product performance. Required Qualifications At least five years of experience in program monitoring, performance measurement, evaluation, data analysis, quality assurance, or federal contract compliance. Demonstrated ability to define measures, design data-collection tools, validate data, develop dashboards, and produce clear performance reports. Experience with qualitative and quantitative data, surveys or feedback instruments, data dictionaries, documentation, and data-quality controls. Working knowledge of privacy, confidentiality, secure data handling, Section 508, and responsible reporting of limitations. Strong analytical writing and ability to explain performance findings to project leaders, technical staff, pilot sites, and nontechnical client audiences. Preferred Qualifications Graduate training in program evaluation, public policy, statistics, economics, sociology, public administration, or a related field. Experience with TANF, HMRF, means-tested programs, rapid-cycle learning, multi-site pilots, or human-services administrative data. Proficiency with Power BI, Tableau, Excel, R, Stata, SPSS, SAS, Qualtrics, or comparable analytics and survey tools. Education and Experience Bachelor's degree in evaluation, statistics, economics, public policy, social science, public administration, or a related field required; master's degree preferred. Five or more years of directly relevant experience is preferred. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Data Liaison (Business Analytics & Insights)- 6 Month Contract
items.summary: OGC is a boutique research and consulting agency specializing in data-driven strategy, quantitative analytics, and Customer Experience (CX) program design and optimization.
items.description: OGC is a boutique research and consulting agency specializing in data-driven strategy, quantitative analytics, and Customer Experience (CX) program design and optimization. We work with some of the world's largest organizations across a variety of industries, including Financial Services, Specialty Retail, Telecommunications, Hospitality, and Software, helping them gain a deep understanding of their customers, develop actionable insights, and improve business processes. Our client is a global leader in the Consumer Packaged Goods industry, with a focus on delivering data-driven insights that support commercial decision-making and business growth. Their Growth Analytics team develops dashboards and reporting solutions used by senior leadership across the organization. They are seeking a Data Liaison to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical development teams, ensuring reporting solutions accurately reflect business needs and industry metrics. This is a 6-month remote contract with the potential for extension. About the Role The ideal candidate is analytical, commercially minded, and an exceptional communicator who enjoys translating business needs into actionable data requirements. You will work closely with business stakeholders, insights teams, and analytics developers to ensure dashboards and reporting solutions are built using the correct business logic, calculations, and data sources. This role is ideal for someone with experience in business analytics, commercial insights, or consumer insights who understands both the language of the business and the language of data. should be comfortable working closely with technical teams, translating business requirements into technical specifications, and validating data before it reaches senior leadership. You'll also play an important role in helping the analytics team build a stronger understanding of the business, enabling them to become increasingly self-sufficient over time. Responsibilities Include Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, insights teams, and analytics developers, translating executive requests into clear business requirements, data specifications, and analytical approaches. Review dashboards, calculations, and reporting logic before release, ensuring the correct business logic, methodologies, metrics, and data sources (including syndicated datasets such as Nielsen) are used while proactively identifying and resolving reporting inaccuracies. Participate in business and executive reporting discussions to understand business priorities, reporting requirements, and how data is used to support decision-making. Document business metrics, calculation methodologies, and data source guidance to establish consistent reporting standards and best practices. Coach and mentor analytics developers to strengthen their understanding of business metrics, commercial context, and reporting expectations, with the goal of enabling greater independence over time. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve reporting processes, strengthen communication between business and technical functions, and develop scalable documentation and best practices that enhance the long-term capability of the analytics team. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Marketing, or a related field. 4+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Consumer Insights, Market Research, Strategy, or a related analytical role. Experience within Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Retail, or a similar commercial environment is strongly preferred. Experience working with syndicated data sources, particularly Nielsen, with the ability to determine the most appropriate data source for different business questions. Strong understanding of retail and commercial performance metrics, including velocity, points of distribution, market share, merchandising, pricing, and related KPIs. items.summary: Payments AnalystStellarTech is a rapidly growing company at the forefront of innovation in the EdTech industry.
items.description: Payments Analyst StellarTech is a rapidly growing company at the forefront of innovation in the EdTech industry. We build and scale educational apps for users around the world, combining data, technology, and an x1000 mindset to create meaningful products and sustainable business models. We are looking for a Payments Analyst to join our Payments Division. Payments sit at one of the most critical points in the customer journey: the moment user intent turns into revenue. As our product portfolio and global presence continue to grow, we need an analyst who will help us keep payment reporting accurate, monitor performance, identify anomalies, and support data-driven improvements across our payment flows. You will gradually take ownership of day-to-day payment analytics while developing deep expertise in transactional data, monetization, and subscription products. What You’ll Do Maintain and improve recurring payment reports and dashboards. Adapt existing reporting for new applications, markets, and business needs. Create analytical reports and data extracts independently. Add new filters and dimensions to existing dashboards. Monitor payment performance, alerts, and week-over-week changes in key metrics. Identify anomalies in payment data and conduct first-line investigations into possible causes. Perform data quality checks and help maintain consistency across multiple data sources. Work with large product and transactional datasets. Support the Payments team with clear conclusions and actionable insights, not just raw data. Collaborate with Payments, Product, Finance, and other cross-functional teams. Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports and analytical workflows. Gradually contribute to more advanced payment analytics, experiments, and business hypotheses. What We’re Looking For 1-3 years of hands-on experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, or a similar analytical role. Strong SQL skills and the ability to write queries independently. Practical Python skills for data analysis and automation. Working knowledge of statistics and analytical methods. Experience working with large datasets and real product or business data. Experience creating or maintaining reports and BI dashboards. Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills. Ability to validate data, identify inconsistencies, and investigate anomalies. Ability to clearly explain what you did, what problem you solved, and how the result was useful. Strong attention to detail and respect for data accuracy. An ownership mindset: you do not simply complete tasks but take responsibility for the result. High learning agility and genuine interest in developing within the payments domain. Clear, structured communication and willingness to raise questions or blockers early. Nice to Have Experience working with payment, transactional, billing, or financial data. Experience in subscription-based, web-to-app, fintech, e-commerce, gaming, or other high-volume B2C products. Understanding of monetization models and online payment flows. Experience with AWS Athena or Amazon S3. Experience with Tableau, Apache Superset, Looker, or similar BI tools. Experience automating reports or recurring analytical processes. Personal, academic, or professional projects involving automation, AI tools, or real-world datasets. Previous payments experience is an advantage, but it is not a requirement. Strong analytical fundamentals, ownership, and the ability to learn quickly matter more. What Success Looks Like During your first months, you will learn the Payments Division’s data, reporting logic, and key processes. You will gradually take ownership of recurring dashboards, reports, filters, data extracts, monitoring, and alerting. You will be able to identify issues, explain what is happening in the data, and escalate anomalies with the necessary context. Why You’ll Love Working With Us Direct business impact: Work with data at the point where customer intent becomes revenue. Global scale: Analyze payment flows across multiple products, markets, and payment methods. Valuable expertise: Build your career in payments, transactions, subscriptions, and monetization. Professional growth: Learn directly from an experienced Senior Analyst and gradually take ownership of your analytical area. Modern tools: Work with SQL, Python, AWS Athena/S3, Tableau/Superset, and AI-powered solutions. Innovative environment: Experiment, improve processes, and bring your own ideas. Global remote: Work remotely as part of an international product company. Health support: Company-provided medical expense compensation. AI tools: Company-covered AI subscriptions and other tools. Balance: 21 days of annual leave plus 10 bank holidays. Collaborative culture: Work with ambitious professionals who value reliable evidence, extreme ownership, energy, and speed. Hiring Process Recruiter Screening Technical Interview Final Interview Originally posted on Himalayas

We are one of the most established players in the wellness app space, and we are accelerating. Over 25.5 million people across the world use our apps — Muscle Booster, Yoga-Go, and WalkFit — to build healthier habits, move more, and feel better every day. Every subscription represents a real person making a real change in their life, and we take that seriously. With 500+ people across hubs in Cyprus, Ukraine, Poland, Spain, and the UK , we combine the scale of a market leader and the drive of a team that's just getting started. What We're Looking For As a Senior Data Engineer , you will play a crucial role in building and maintaining the foundation of our data ecosystem. You’ll work alongside data engineers, analysts, and product teams to create robust, scalable, and high-performance data pipelines and models. Your work will directly impact how we deliver insights, power product features, and enable data-driven decision-making across the company. Proficient in Python and SQL for data transformation and automation. Experience with dbt for data modeling and transformation. Good understanding of streaming architectures and micro-batching for real-time data needs. Experience with CI/CD pipelines for data workflows (preferably GitLab CI). Familiarity with event schema validation tools/ solutions (Snowplow, Schema Registry). Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Strong problem-solving skills—able to dig into data issues, propose solutions, and deliver clean, reliable outcomes. items.title: Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher
items.summary: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher.
items.description: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher. Your core mission will involve a deep dive into the complex internals and mechanics of various blockchain networks, reverse engineering of sophisticated Decentralized Finance (DeFi) protocols, and translating these complex systems into actionable, structured data. Develop new derivative data models and datasets for client insights and competitive advantages. Map, cleanse, and normalize raw, disparate blockchain data (transaction logs, smart contract events, state changes) into consistent, structured relational and non-relational schemes for consumption by analytics, machine learning, and AI tools. This role requires a unique blend of expertise in distributed systems, data engineering best practices, and a profound understanding of the crypto and decentralized ecosystem. What You’ll Do Maintain an AI-native and blockchain-forward mindset, proactively leveraging emerging trends and generative technologies to stay at the vanguard of the crypto revolution while maximizing work efficiency and uncovering novel, high-alpha data opportunities. Architect Intuitive Data Models: Turn the messiness of on-chain data into elegant, unified abstractions. You'll build the models that provide our users with granular, high-integrity insights across various protocols. Deconstruct DeFi Mechanics: Get under the hood of DeFi protocols. You'll reverse-engineer smart contracts and on-chain events, translating complex interactions into clean, production-grade SQL/dbt models. Scale Our Ecosystem Coverage: Lead the charge in indexing new blockchains. You’ll design the schemas that transform raw chain data into our internal "source of truth," ensuring every block is captured with 100% accuracy. Engineer Signal from Noise: Define the metrics that matter (TVL, Volume, Fees). You’ll be the gatekeeper of data quality, proactively identifying and filtering out wash trading, bot activity, and Sybil attacks. What You'll Need: Experience 3+ years hands-on in Data Science, Data Engineering, or a hybrid role; Blockchain or crypto analytics background strongly preferred, familiarity with on-chain data structures, transaction semantics, and asset classification; Streaming & Lakehouse Apache Flink or Spark Streaming building and operating real-time data pipelines; Apache Iceberg or Apache Hudi managing large-scale Data Lakehouses with schema evolution, time travel, and ACID guarantees over petabytes of raw blockchain data; AWS Data Platform S3 for scalable data lake storage; RDS for structured relational workloads; Spark SQL and PySpark for interactive querying and ad-hoc analysis; Caching & Distribution Familiarity with Data Grid technologies (e.g. Hazelcast, Apache Ignite, Redis) for high-throughput, low-latency data access patterns; Languages & Tooling SQL advanced query writing, window functions, query plan analysis, performance tuning at scale; Python Pandas, Polars for data wrangling; Scikit-learn for model development; Proficient in architecting high-throughput ingestion pipelines that leverage external data sources REST/WebSocket APIs, JSON-RPC node queries; Strong grasp of ETL fundamentals (extract, transform, load), including managing schema mismatches between heterogeneous sources and destinations; Engineering Mindset Systematic approach to debugging: reproducing issues, isolating root cause, validating fixes; Comfortable working with large, semi-structured, or undocumented data sources. Why Join Lukka ? Are you looking for a challenge? Lukka solves the most complex data and technology challenges for an industry that is at the forefront of innovation. At Lukka , we strive to anticipate and respond to the needs of this new and ever-changing ecosystem of digital assets. That was true in 2014, while everyone was focused on trading & buying this new asset class, we were thinking about the tax implications of crypto. That innovative foresight continues today as we evolve and iterate on our product suite to address the regulations and educate our customers. We are looking for passionate, collaborative, and strategic individuals who want to help shape the future of, well, everything – starting with making crypto more accountable. We invest in our teammates, promote from within & are responsible to each other by fostering an inclusive space for curious minds to thrive and innovate. What’s life @ Lukka like? We move fast and continue to be ahead of the curve. You could be part of a growing company bridging the gap between business and blockchain. Here’s some insight into why our team members have joined: Ability to own the projects they work on; Less red tape to take ideas from inception to delivery; Being at the forefront of an industry; Small team, big dreams. Of course, let’s discuss some perks: Opportunity to work directly on data for digital assets, an industry-leading product with well-known clients. Working with multiple AI solutions daily. Exposure to both technical problem-solving and customer-facing challenges. A growing Poland-based team with direct collaboration across US and global stakeholders. A startup-style culture where your impact is visible every day. So you’ve scrolled, your interest is piqued and hopefully read all of the important things...now what? This is an exciting time to join a team that’s at the forefront of this rapidly growing industry. We are looking for people who constantly push themselves to think differently, are ready to face new challenges and chart exciting new paths. If this sounds like you, apply! items.description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 6000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The Role: We are seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer to drive significant business impact by shaping our data infrastructure, developing robust data models, and promoting best practices in analytics engineering (e.g., data quality, documentation, and scalable data architectures). You will collaborate closely with the Marketing team in order to ensure that funnels are being tracked and surfaced in our data models and that Marketing campaigns can be evaluated using accurate data. What you'll do: Create trusted, self-serve datasets and reporting layers in Omni that power Marketing performance reviews, campaign reporting, attribution analysis, funnel health monitoring, and investment decision-making. Proactively identify and resolve data quality issues across Marketing and GTM systems, including source tracking, campaign metadata, funnel stage completeness, attribution coverage, and spend data. Add comprehensive metadata to datasets, including documentation, lineage, ownership, definitions, data quality checks, and sensitive data masking. Partner with Marketing stakeholders to translate business questions into robust data products, dashboards, analyses, and decision-ready insights. Enable Marketing teams to confidently use Omni and core GTM datasets through documentation, training, office hours, and self-serve resources. Activate data from Snowflake into operational tools where needed, supporting audience segmentation, lifecycle programmes, campaign optimisation, or GTM workflows. We'd love to hear from you: Extensive experience in analytics engineering or related data roles, with demonstrated expertise in advanced SQL, dbt, and Snowflake. Proficient in using BI tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker, PowerBI, Snowsight) to deliver clear, actionable insights for business stakeholders. Skilled in performing data ingestion and activation using no-code tools (e.g. Fivetran, Stitch), ensuring efficient data integration into operational systems. Knowledgeable in managing metadata, documentation, data quality checks, and sensitive data masking effectively. Effective at collaborating closely with diverse stakeholders, understanding their data needs, and delivering impactful solutions. Experienced in conducting training sessions and providing informal mentorship to junior analytics team members, fostering a collaborative and knowledge-sharing environment. Familiar with Marketing and GTM data concepts such as campaign tracking, attribution, funnel stages, lead/account lifecycle, pipeline generation, paid media, web analytics, CRM data, and marketing automation data. Experienced with common GTM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Google Analytics, ad platforms, enrichment tools, or similar. The exact stack is less important than the ability to understand how GTM data is created, transformed, and used. Comfortable working across Marketing, RevOps, Sales, Finance, and Data to align definitions, reporting logic, and ownership. Everyone is welcome at Paddle At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group. Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together. Our Values Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us” Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple” Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs” Why you’ll love working at Paddle We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture. We are a ‘digital-first’ company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and 4 months paid family leave regardless of gender. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

items.title: Senior Manager, Business Performance & Analysis
items.summary: ABOUT ALUALU provides higher education for a higher purpose.
items.description: ABOUT ALU ALU provides higher education for a higher purpose. Our students declare missions, not majors.They develop the real-world skills to take on the world’s most pressing challenges. And they take ownership of their learning from day one through our peer and student-led approach – because ALU believes in the power and agency of young people to start shaping the future right now. Together with a world-class faculty and staff, our students are igniting a ripple of positive impact across Africa and the world. We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities. HOW WE WORK The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new. The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding. ABOUT THE TEAM The Business Performance & Analysis team is one of ALU ’s core performance intelligence functions, providing the insight, analysis and challenge required to help leaders understand performance, make informed decisions and improve institutional outcomes. Working across academic and professional functions, the team goes beyond reporting what has happened to understand why it happened, what it means, what is likely to happen next, and what action is required. It brings together performance data, analysis and external benchmarks to identify trends, risks, opportunities and areas for improvement. The team connects strategy, performance and execution by strengthening performance measurement, supporting decision-making and helping leaders translate insight into action. Its impact is measured not by the volume of reports produced, but by the quality of decisions informed and the improvements in institutional performance that follow. ABOUT THE ROLE The Senior Manager, Business Performance & Analysis will lead the analysis, interpretation and management of institutional performance information to support evidence-based decision-making across ALU . The role will translate complex business, financial, operational, academic and student data into clear insights, identify performance trends and gaps, assess their underlying drivers, and provide actionable recommendations to improve institutional outcomes. The role will also strengthen ALU 's performance management and business intelligence capabilities, ensuring that leadership has timely, reliable and forward-looking information to guide strategic and operational decisions. Working across functions and with senior leaders, the role will connect institutional strategy, performance targets and operational results, providing the analysis and challenge required to improve execution and organisational performance. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Institutional Performance Management Lead the development, implementation and continuous improvement of ALU 's institutional performance framework, including KPIs, targets, scorecards and performance measures. Monitor performance against strategic and operational objectives, identify material variances, emerging risks and areas of underperformance, and recommend appropriate interventions. Lead periodic performance reviews and provide analysis that enables leadership to understand not only what is happening, but why it is happening and what action is required. Analyse performance across key institutional areas including enrolment, recruitment, retention, student progression, programme performance, revenue, costs, resource utilisation and other strategic priorities. Establish appropriate performance benchmarks and support leadership in setting meaningful, measurable and outcome-focused objectives and targets. Business and Strategic Analysis Identify trends, patterns, performance drivers and root causes across multiple sources of institutional data. Develop business cases, investment analyses and decision papers, including assessment of financial, operational and strategic implications. Undertake scenario analysis and modelling to assess the potential impact of strategic and operational decisions. Conduct complex business and institutional analysis to support strategic planning, operational decisions and strategic initiatives and prioritization. Provide objective analysis and constructive challenge where data, assumptions or proposed interventions require further scrutiny. Conduct internal and external benchmarking to assess institutional performance against relevant peer institutions, competitors, sector standards and market trends. Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations, implications and actions for senior leadership. Performance Intelligence and Reporting Lead the development of high-quality management information, executive performance reports, dashboards and analytical products for senior leadership and governance forums. Establish standards for performance reporting, data interpretation, and analytical storytelling. Ensure management reports focus on material performance issues, drivers, trends and decisions rather than simply presenting data. Develop forward-looking analysis and forecasts to support proactive management of institutional performance. Work with data and technology teams to improve access to, integration of and confidence in institutional data. Ensure the accuracy, consistency and appropriate interpretation of performance information used for management decision-making. Analytics Capability and Continuous Improvement Develop clear standards for analytical quality, delivery and stakeholder service. Coach team members in analytical thinking, problem solving, business partnering and effective communication of insights. Develop and continuously improve analytical methodologies, tools and processes. Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and improve performance reporting and analysis. Promote a culture of evidence-based decision-making and stronger use of data across ALU . Partner with other functions to develop integrated views of institutional performance. Executive Stakeholder Engagement Establish and maintain data supply arrangements with the functions that own the underlying data: agreed definitions, cut dates, quality standards, and named counterparts. Resolve definitional inconsistency across campuses, programmes and systems so that the institution reports a single number for each institutional metric. Build effective working relationships with senior leaders, Deans, Directors and functional teams across ALU . Present complex analysis clearly to non-technical audiences and translate findings into practical business implications. Facilitate performance discussions and support leaders in identifying appropriate responses to performance gaps. Influence decisions through evidence, insight and constructive challenge, including where findings may challenge established assumptions or practices. Provide analytical support to strategic, executive and governance forums as required. Maintain a strong understanding of the ALU ’s operating environment, priorities and strategic objectives to ensure analysis remains relevant to institutional needs. Ensure the safety and well-being of all young persons and vulnerable adults with whom we deal, by adhering to ALU ’s comprehensive safeguarding policy, maintaining a zero-tolerance approach to any violations of safeguarding standards REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 10+ years of relevant professional experience in business performance, institutional research, strategy, business intelligence, analytics, planning, consulting, financial analysis or a related field. Demonstrable experience leading, developing and managing organisational or institutional performance frameworks, including KPIs, targets, scorecards and performance reporting. Proven experience analysing complex datasets and translating findings into actionable recommendations for senior decision-makers, forecasting, scenario modelling, business case development and quantitative analysis. Experience producing executive-level performance reports, dashboards and decision-support materials. Experience using data to identify performance drivers, diagnose problems and support measurable improvements in organisational outcomes. Demonstrated experience delivering analytical or performance improvement initiatives that resulted in measurable business, operational, financial or institutional impact. Experience benchmarking organisational or institutional performance against external peers, competitors or sector standards is desirable. REQUIRED COMPETENCIES Functional Competencies Strategic and Performance Analysis: Analyse complex institutional issues, identify performance drivers and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Data & Business Intelligence: Analyse complex datasets and develop clear dashboards, management information and performance insights. Financial & Commercial Acumen: Understand the financial, operational and institutional implications of decisions. Forecasting & Modelling: Develop forecasts, scenarios and business models to support planning and decision-making. Problem Solving: Diagnose root causes, test assumptions and develop practical, evidence-based solutions. Executive Reporting: Distil complex information into clear insights, implications and recommendations for senior leaders. Analytics Tools: Advanced Excel and strong proficiency in Power BI and uses digital and AI-enabled tools effectively to accelerate analysis, improve productivity and generate insight, while independently validating outputs and exercising sound judgement. Behavioural & Leadership Competencies Strategic Thinking: Connect performance trends and analysis to broader institutional priorities. Critical Thinking: Question assumptions and assess evidence objectively. Influencing & Challenge: Build credibility with senior stakeholders and challenge constructively using evidence. Executive Communication: Communicate complex findings clearly and persuasively to varied audiences. Collaboration: Work effectively across academic and professional functions. Leadership & Coaching: Develop people, set high analytical standards and build team capability. Delivery Orientation: Focus on turning insight into action and measurable institutional improvement. Match the ALU Archetype: Alignment with the ALU Archetype, including ownership, courage, and stewardship. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Lead Product Analyst, B2C Financial Services
items.summary: Tabby is on a mission to give people power over their money.
items.description: Tabby is on a mission to give people power over their money. For too long, financial systems have worked for the institutions that built them, not the people using them. Runaway interest, fine print and limited access have left many behind, feeling shut out of a system that wasn't setting them up for success. We're building a different kind of system, in a complete money app to send, spend and save. One that's clear, flexible and puts people and businesses in control. Founded in 2019, we serve customers and businesses across Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait. Millions of customers and 65,000 global brands, government services and small businesses rely on us today. What began as a better way to pay at checkout has grown into a financial system working the way it should have all along. About the roleThis role focuses on Tabby Cash , and the growing ecosystem of our debit financial products. You will lead a team of analysts that work on activation, engagement, and profitability , helping shape how the product grows from 1 → 100. The role requires balancing user growth with sustainable economics , working across Product, Risk, and Growth teams. You will play a key role in defining how users adopt and use our cards, and how we optimize the products for long-term value. What you will be doing Lead a team of product analysts to provide support to the product and business teams across all aspects of their work. Generate hypotheses, conduct research and A/B tests, and present your findings clearly and compellingly, which highlights the importance of your insights. Regularly work with several stakeholders, including product and marketing teams, on fundamental research as well as on one-time requests. Support and monitor existing metrics for the Financial Products, identify areas for improvement, and develop new metrics that inform decision-making across the organization. Develop data visualizations and reports that are both informative and easily understood by business and product teams. Assist in the planning of necessary data structures and data quality improvements. What you will need Minimum of 4 years of work experience as a data/product analyst. Experience in leading a team of data analysts of any size. Proficiency in SQL and relational databases. Proficiency in data visualization and BI tools. Experience in planning data structures for new products and features. Strong knowledge of Python (Pandas, Numpy, Statsmodels, Matplotlib, etc.) Experience in product analytics in fintech is a plus. Experience in leveraging LLM/AI for analytical purposes is a plus. Strong quantitative skills and a structured approach to problem-solving. Ability to analyze issues, identify root causes, and recommend solutions. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact with business and product teams. At least an upper-intermediate level of English proficiency is required. What we offer: Full-time B2B contract Fully remote setup Up to 20% tax allowance 22 paid leave days annually Stock options (ESOP) in a fast-scaling, pre-IPO company Flexi benefits you can use for wellness, travel, or learning Work alongside a high-performing, international engineering team in a global fintech unicorn Relocation support is available to our hubs in Armenia, Georgia, Serbia, Portugal, and Spain, including flights, temporary accommodation, and legal setup (if needed) What you can expect We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team. A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one. You should be comfortable with the idea that the quality of your work will influence the shape of your career. We are passionate about creating an inclusive, high-performing workplace that gives people from all backgrounds the support they need to thrive, grow, and meet their goals. If this sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: About Dutchie Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis. Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue. Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups. Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors. About This Job The Brands Ad Analyst is a critical partner to the Dutchie Ads sales team, sitting at the intersection of data analytics, client services, and digital advertising strategy. This role is responsible for equipping the sales team with the data and narratives they need to win new business and retain existing clients. You will build compelling, data-driven stories that demonstrate the impact of advertising on Dutchie’s platform, deliver strategic recommendations for campaign optimization, and serve as a trusted analytical voice in client-facing conversations. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable writing SQL queries in Snowflake, building dashboards in visualization tools, and presenting performance insights to brand partners. You thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and bring a consultative mindset to every interaction. What You'll Do… New Business Support Develop data-driven prospect briefs identifying high-potential brand targets based on market share, category penetration, and competitive positioning Build budget recommendations and media plans grounded in historical performance benchmarks and retailer-level data Create compelling pitch materials, including performance projections and ROI scenarios, to support the sales team in new business presentations Existing Business – Monthly & Quarterly Reporting Own the end-to-end production of monthly performance narratives for brand clients, translating raw ad data into clear, strategic stories for client review meetings Conduct quarterly deep-dive analyses evaluating campaign health, incrementality, share of voice, and consumer behavior trends Frame insights around business outcomes—connecting ad spend to ROAS, new buyer acquisition, market dollar share, and conversion rate improvements Dashboard & Visualization Design and maintain client-facing dashboards and internal reporting tools using visualization platforms such as Hex or Looker Develop reusable templates and automated workflows to streamline monthly and quarterly reporting cycles Ensure data accuracy and consistency across all deliverables through rigorous QA processes Strategic Partnership Serve as the analytical voice in client meetings, confidently presenting findings and fielding data questions from brand stakeholders Provide strategic recommendations for new campaign launches, budget reallocations, and placement optimizations based on performance data Quantify the cost of inaction—translate ad spend pauses or reductions into measurable performance impact to reinforce the value of sustained investment Cross-Functional Collaboration & Product Testing Work closely with Sales, Ad Operations, and Product teams to align on priorities, surface data needs, and communicate insights across the organization Participate in product testing for new ad placements, targeting features, and platform capabilities, providing structured feedback grounded in performance data Support ad hoc analytical requests from the sales team with quick, accurate turnarounds What You Bring... Required 3-5+ years of experience in digital advertising analytics, media analytics, ad operations, or a related data-driven role Proficiency in SQL with hands-on experience querying large datasets (Snowflake strongly preferred) Strong data storytelling ability—you can turn a table of numbers into a narrative that drives action Comfort in client-facing settings: you can present findings clearly and handle questions with confidence Experience working cross-functionally with sales, operations, and product teams Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables across clients and deadlines Technical Skills: Use snowflake or Hex to maintain, update and create ad reporting for client reviews Be familiar with the following schemas: Ad platform Data POS Data Telemetry Data Product Data Retailer Data Understand how all of the following relate to each other in order to build: Market Share Reports Market Impact Reports QBRs Ad Metric Reporting Ad Incrementality Reporting Retailer Level Reporting Be familiar enough with the data to quickly and accurately pull insights (ad projections, store lists, state rollups etc.) for sales and product teams Understand ads, snowflake and the data to write queries to test impact of campaign optimizations Work with Product team to rewrite incrementality report with A-B testing using ad server and user level data It’s a Bonus if You… Experience with data visualization tools such as Hex, Looker, or similar BI platforms Background in media, digital advertising (retail media, programmatic, display, or sponsored product ads) Familiarity with ad performance metrics including ROAS, CTR, incrementality, share of voice, and conversion rate Experience with presentation tools (PowerPoint, Google Slides) for building polished client-ready decks Exposure to cannabis, CPG, or retail media industries is a plus You’ll Get… We are targeting a starting salary of $107,000 - $178,000 based on the intended level for this role. In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards package includes: Full medical benefits including dental and vision plans to ensure you always have the best care. Equity packages in the form of stock options to all employees. Technology (hardware, software, reading materials, etc..) allowance Flexible vacation and sick days At Dutchie, we’re committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Dutchie believes that diversity and inclusion among our teammates is critical to our success, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool.

While we're proud of what we've already accomplished, we're searching for new collaborators to help us get to the next level! If you're looking to join a forward-thinking, rapidly growing organization with helping people as its number one goal, we want to hear from you. About The Role The Manager of Strategy & Analytics will conduct analyses focused on optimizing and understanding marketing channel performance, client retention, and lifetime customer value. The role will collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, operations, product and sales to deliver actionable insights that help meet company goals. A successful manager will quickly build a deep understanding of the business and be able to effectively communicate results and present recommendations to executives. The ideal candidate will be a results-driven, strategic thinker able to thrive in a dynamic, rapid-growth environment. Exceptional candidates will have best-in-class data skills including SQL, Excel, dataset manipulation, data visualization, and presentation. What You'll Do Dive into data and processes to understand major operational challenges and opportunities Present findings to stakeholders and recommend actionable solutions for non-analytical partners including Senior Leadership Re-define and challenge company KPIs that are critical to achieving company and business unit goals Work closely with the product and operations teams in defining tests and experimental design What We Look For Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business, STEM, or other analytical field 2-4 years professional experience in marketing, product, strategy, or business analytics Prior experience in Strategy Consulting, Financial Services, or Start-up environments Familiarity with doing analysis in Excel and coding in SQL Experience in Python or R is not required but a plus Looker or Tableau experience is a plus Quick learner; willing to dive in and get her/his hands dirty Demonstrated ability to deliver results in a fast-paced environment Desire to work in an ambiguous environment and solve open ended problems Beyond Finance is a Chicago based company and is looking for candidates in the Chicagoland area. Candidates from other markets may be considered if they have proven success working in a fully remote environment. #LI-AW1 The base annual salary range is listed below. This role is eligible for additional incentives, including an annual bonus. Base Salary Range $118,830—$162,636 USD Why Join Us? While you make a difference for others, we’ll work to make a difference for you, providing an uplifting, collaborative work environment and benefits that reflect your value to us. For eligible full-time employees, we offer: Considerable employer contributions for health, dental, and vision programs Generous PTO, paid holidays, and paid parental leave 401(k) matching program Merit advancement opportunities Career development & training And finally, our team spirit and culture! We cultivate an environment of community, connection, and belonging across our entire organization. Beyond Finance does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job positions. No fee will be paid to their parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to Beyond Finance employees or the Beyond Finance HR team. No placement fee will be paid to any third party unless such a request has been made by the Beyond HR team.

items.title: Marketing Analytics Specialist
items.summary: About usTameson is a global e-commerce business helping SMEs source industrial components.
items.description: About us Tameson is a global e-commerce business helping SMEs source industrial components. We are looking for a Marketing Analytics Specialist to join our Data Analytics team and bring statistical rigor to how we run and measure paid advertising. The role This is a data-oriented ownership role, not a simple marketing role. We want a paid platform owner with a quantitative background who has worked extensively with paid advertising data, not a media buyer or campaign manager who has picked up SQL along the way. If your strengths are creative strategy, platform certifications, or campaign execution, this role will not fit. You will work directly with the Data Analytics Lead and Marketing Lead in a team that sits at the center of how Tameson makes decisions. Your output will materially shape where marketing budget goes, how we measure its return, and how we test new ideas. A flavor of recent work Built a Markov-chain multi-touch attribution model to improve our early-funnel bidding in paid ads channels. Built LTV and cohort retention models that let us value customer segments differently, and feed those values back into bidding and targeting. Designed and ran A/B and CRO experiments to validate channel changes, on-site changes, and bidding strategies. Built the BigQuery and Google Data Studio reporting layer that the business actually uses to track CAC, POAS, and LTV. Designed an experimental framework to measure incremental effect of paid advetisement spend. What you would pick up Extend and improve our attribution work, challenge assumptions, try alternative models, quantify uncertainty. Take full ownership of our paid advertisement strategy, based on data insights and experimental results. Design experiments end-to-end: A/B, geo, holdout, CRO. All with proper power analysis, randomization, and evaluation. Build models that inform capital allocation across channels: saturation curves, diminishing returns, MMM, for example. Analyze complex datasets across customer journeys, search query data, marketplace performance, and CRM. Develop customer and audience models that inform who we should target, where, and how much we should pay to reach them. Requirements What We Are Looking For Background in a quantitative field: Statistics, data science, physics, computer science or similar. A university degree in one of these is strongly preferred; a strong demonstrable track record can substitute Paid Media Expertise: You have a deep understanding of paid acquisition across multiple channels and know how to balance direct response with branding. AI Native Efficiency: You have an enthusiasm for using AI and LLMs to improve productivity and enable new internal workflows. Outcome Owner: You are driven by results like revenue and profit rather than simple output. Collaborative Investigator: You work cross functionally with Product and Operations teams to provide data insights and measurement frameworks. A skeptical disposition: Uncomfortable with conclusions drawn from underpowered tests or last-click reports. Why Choose Tameson ? Direct Business Impact: Your work directly correlates to sales and bottom line profitability. You will build the analytics dashboards that allow you to point to a chart and say, "This ad drove that revenue growth". Innovation: We are an aggressive, modern company that values technical experimentation. We want you to test new channels, automate complex workflows, and deploy the latest data engineering tools to keep us ahead. Company culture: We value collaboration, professional growth, and fun. We regularly have company activities (online and offline) to stay connected and inspired. Growth: We are scaling rapidly. As we expand, your professional opportunities grow. Role Work Conditions Employment type: Full time position (remote). Working hours: Flexible work hours, with availability required Monday through Friday and a minimum overlap of 12:00–17:00 GMT+1. Ready to define the future of industrial e-commerce? Ready to turn data into our biggest competitive advantage? Apply today. Highlights - Own experimentation, modeling, and measurement across paid acquisition - Real ownership over how our marketing budget gets spend - BigQuery, Python/R, Google Data Studio - Work from home or hybrid Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Talent Acquisition Strategist
items.summary: Canonical has re-imagined hiring. We have created a Talent Science team that has a mission to ensure that we follow objective, scientifically rigorous and efficient processes to select the very best new colleagues regardless of location, culture or background. We are not recruiters, but our work connects hiring strategy to performance outcomes. We work closely…
items.description: Canonical has re-imagined hiring. We have created a Talent Science team that has a mission to ensure that we follow objective, scientifically rigorous and efficient processes to select the very best new colleagues regardless of location, culture or background. We are not recruiters, but our work connects hiring strategy to performance outcomes. We work closely with our key stakeholders to ensure that decisions are being made in the right way and that our hiring model supports the selection of world class talent. We lead an effective hiring ecosystem to deliver talent acquisition excellence. We leverage data to enable evidence-based decisions, weaving behavioural science throughout our selection process, working closely with our Hiring Leadership team who drive hiring at Canonical. Due to the growth of the business we are seeking a set of new leaders to drive delivery excellence. You will work directly with the Global Head of Talent Science to plan and drive work within the team against our strategic objectives. With overall accountability for project delivery relating to hiring outcomes you will drive efficiencies and create new processes whilst coaching and developing team members to grow their careers. You will bring an analytical and objective approach to work and be seasoned in making data driven decisions relating to talent outcomes. Your experience will include being able to plan and lead project roadmaps, experience interacting with senior leadership on talent related topics leveraging your thought leadership experience and the ability to influence and steer talent agendas internally. You will be capable of stepping up to lead the function when required. Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region. The role entails Leading and delivering the strategic Talent Science project roadmap using exceptional project management capability and influencing skills to manage multiple projects at any given time. Leveraging expertise from your career to date to design and implement solutions to complex problems that ultimately ensure we hire exceptional talent. Ensuring all talent selection initiatives map to high performance outcomes and career frameworks. Designing professional processes and frameworks, allowing efficient delivery of our agenda. Coaching and mentoring team members to grow and develop skill sets specifically around analytical capabilities and thought leadership, developing training materials and documentation to support team members. Driving and representing the team in the absence of the Head of, acting as a credible and trusted adviser and an inspiring leader. Working closely with company leaders to understand, appreciate and communicate our vision for talent at Canonical. What we are looking for in you Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university, with an undergraduate degree in a psychology or people based subject. A track record of team leadership in a talent function from the technology or consulting industry, with exceptional project management, to lead roadmap execution and delivery. Deep understanding of talent selection, with a technological mindset to create automation's and products to drive hiring efficiencies. Advanced analytical ability to dissect and analyse data, using either SQL, Python and/or statistical analysis. Exceptional written and spoken English with strong presentation skills for a senior audience. Ability to travel internationally 2-4 times a year for company events. Nice-to-have skills Advanced psychometric assessments with an excellent understanding of the marketplace and vendors A deep understanding of human behaviour and what drives intrinsic motivation Experience of using Superset and advanced dashboarding What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Employee Assistance Programme Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #LI-remote

items.title: Senior UX Research and Design Specialist
items.summary: Cambium Learning® Group is an award-winning educational technology solutions leader dedicated to helping all students reach their potential through individualized and differentiated instruction.
items.description: Cambium Learning® Group is an award-winning educational technology solutions leader dedicated to helping all students reach their potential through individualized and differentiated instruction. Using a research-based, personalized approach, Cambium Learning Group delivers SaaS resources and instructional products that engage students and support teachers in fun, positive, safe and scalable environments. These solutions are provided through Learning A-Z® (online differentiated instruction for elementary school reading, writing and science), ExploreLearning® (online interactive math and science simulations, a math fact fluency solution, and a K–2 science solution), Voyager Sopris Learning® (blended solutions that accelerate struggling learners to achieve in literacy and math and professional development for teachers), and VKidz Learning (online comprehensive homeschool education and programs for literacy and science). We believe that every student has unlimited potential, that teachers matter, and that data, instruction, and practice are the keys to success in the classroom and beyond. Job Overview: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior UX Research & Design Specialist with a dual passion for user advocacy and tangible web design. In this role, you will lead end-to-end qualitative and quantitative research cycles within our K-12 educational data and assessment platforms. Beyond traditional data synthesis, you possess a strong sense of visual and layout design, allowing you to translate raw researcher findings directly into clean, interactive, and tangible UI prototypes. You will act as a critical bridge between educator insights and production-ready web design. Job Responsibilities: Advanced User Research & Methodology Execute End-to-End Research: Lead qualitative and quantitative research initiatives (focus groups, structured interviews, surveys, and usability testing) involving teachers, instructional coaches, and school administrators. Conduct Market & Competitive Analysis: Perform targeted market and competitive research to evaluate industry trends, benchmark rival EdTech solutions, and identify strategic positioning opportunities for our platform features. Drive Feedback Syntheses: Design and facilitate educator panels to capture nuanced workflows, translating feedback into clear product design opportunities. Iterate and Track Perceptions: Build systematic, iterative research loops to measure shifts in user perception and long-term platform adoption. Manage Diverse Recruitment: Orchestrate participant recruitment strategies across varied K-12 demographics (elementary, middle, and high school tenures). Tangible Web Design & Interactive Prototyping Translate Insights into Mockups: Convert user pain points and research metrics into high-fidelity web designs, intuitive screen flows, and interactive layouts. Bridge Design and Engineering: Collaborate directly with front-end web designers by delivering design specifications that map closely to web structure realities. Refine Interface Hierarchy: Evaluate and rapidly iterate on layout sequences, visual hierarchies, UI text labeling, and main navigation structures. K-12 Assessment & Data Literacy Demystify Student Data: Apply deep knowledge of K-12 grading architectures and standards-based reporting to build accessible teacher dashboards. Align with Classroom Realities: Design specifically for time-constrained educators who need immediate visual data displays for student remediation and administrative groupings. Data Visualization & Web Usability Apply Visualization Best Practices: Craft clean, visual progress bars, color-coded matrices, and grouping indicators tailored for non-technical users. Enforce Digital Accessibility: Ensure all generated data visualizations and interface layouts meet inclusive, accessible design guidelines. Job Requirements: Experience: 7+ years of dedicated professional experience in UX research, interface design, or digital analytics architectures. Preferred Degrees: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Interaction Design, Human Factors, Cognitive Psychology, Computer Science, or a related behavioral/technology-focused discipline. Design Stack Literacy: Mastery of contemporary UI wireframing and prototyping ecosystems (e.g., Figma). items.description: Data and Analytics Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers. The Role As a Lead AI Consultant (Field) (known internally - Lead Deployment Engineer) of the Iberia & LATAM region, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance. You will lead the team of junior Consultants and team with experts (AI, Product, Functional) to make sure the customer achieves value and adoption. As a strategic driver in the pre-sales stage, you will partner closely with Account Teams to shape and position our Services solutions. You won't just present offerings—you will architect the foundation for long-term customer success, ensuring rapid adoption and value realization. This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are Product expert and an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, to ensure the platform delivers measurable impact and adoption. The Work You’ll Do Pre-Sales: Designing tailored deployment roadmaps and implementation strategies aligned with the customer's maturity. Estimating project timelines, team structures, and overall professional services effort to support commercial proposals. Partnering with Account Executives and Value Engineers to translate business cases into actionable deployment plans. Drafting clear Statements of Work (SOW), defining project scope, deliverables, assumptions, and acceptance criteria. Aligning client expectations with operational feasibility to prevent post-sale scope creep. Post-Sales: Initiate and Connect Define the strategy and oversee junior Consultants covering - Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required Build & Value Direct AI deployment agents to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements – do we make this less of a must have? Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance Rollout, Adoption, and Handover Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff Domain & Industry Depth Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually – still hands on technical? You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable The Qualifications You Need Experience: 7+ years in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators. Consulting pre-sales experience Platform skills: Track record in complex IT/SAP transformations, process optimization, and PQL/SQL/Python technical capability AI fluency: Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus. Business and process domain expertise : Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus. Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences. Analytical mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with a value-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact. Learning agility: Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools. Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field. Languages: Fluency in English and Spanish required. Portuguese beneficial. Travel : Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases. What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here .
