items.title: Product Operations Lead
items.summary: Proudly voted a Great Place to Work®, we are a dynamic startup in the CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) space that is revolutionizing the way businesses communicate.
items.description: Proudly voted a Great Place to Work®, we are a dynamic startup in the CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) space that is revolutionizing the way businesses communicate. Our team is made up of 400+ energetic and passionate Unifones who are dedicated to delivering the best possible experience to 5000+ customer-centric companies. We pride ourselves on our fun and collaborative work environment, where creativity and new ideas are constantly encouraged. As shareholders in the business, we’re so much more than a group of passionate communicators. We are Unifones. Join our team and be a part of something big! Meet the team! Our Engineering team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic ’s solutions. We work closely with other departments to ensure our products and services meet the needs of our customers. If you are passionate about technology and are excited about working on cutting-edge communication and engagement solutions, we want you on our team. As a Product Operations Lead, you will partner closely with Product Leadership to translate product strategy into scalable operational practices that drive alignment, efficiency, and measurable business outcomes. You will establish and continuously improve product operating models, governance frameworks, and cross-functional processes that enable Product, Engineering, Commercial, Marketing, and Customer-facing teams to work effectively toward shared goals. Acting as a trusted partner to stakeholders across the organization, you will drive collaboration, facilitate informed decision-making through data and insights, and ensure clear communication of product priorities, roadmaps, and outcomes. You will lead product enablement initiatives, support successful product launches and adoption, develop performance metrics and reporting frameworks, and identify opportunities to streamline workflows through process optimization and automation. By championing operational excellence, customer-centricity, and continuous improvement, you will help create an environment where product teams can scale efficiently, deliver value consistently, and maximize the impact of the product portfolio. Help us shape the future of communication by: Leading and continuously improving product operations frameworks, governance, and ways of working across Product teams. Owning and optimizing product planning processes, roadmap reviews, prioritization workflows, and operational cadences. Establishing scalable operational practices that improve alignment, transparency, delivery predictability, and execution quality. Driving standardization of product reporting, KPIs, operational dashboards, and decision-support insights. Identifying operational inefficiencies and implementing process improvements to increase team effectiveness and focus. Promoting adoption of AI tools, automation, and operational best practices to improve workflows, reporting, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Customer Success, Support, Presales, and Marketing teams to ensure strong operational alignment. Acting as a central point of coordination between business and product organizations. Facilitating communication of product priorities, roadmap updates, launches, and operational initiatives across stakeholders. Supporting leadership teams with operational insights, strategic reporting, and executive-ready communications. Leading Product Enablement initiatives that help internal teams effectively position, support, and adopt product capabilities. Supporting product launches, feature rollouts, demos, and internal readiness activities. Translating complex product functionality into clear messaging, use cases, enablement materials, and customer value narratives. Partnering with Commercial and Marketing teams to improve product awareness, adoption, and customer engagement. Helping identify and remove adoption barriers impacting internal teams or customers. Synthesizing customer feedback, product analytics, sales insights, and market trends into actionable recommendations. Identifying product usage patterns, operational gaps, and growth opportunities that can influence product strategy and commercial outcomes. Supporting Product leadership in defining and tracking success metrics tied to product and operational performance. Contributing to strategic initiatives focused on scaling Product Operations maturity and organizational effectiveness. Requirements What you’ll bring: 5+ years of experience in Product Operations, Product Management, Product Enablement, Product Marketing, Presales, Solution Consulting, or related roles. Proven experience leading or scaling operational processes within Product or SaaS organizations. Strong understanding of product lifecycle management, product delivery processes, and cross-functional collaboration. Experience working closely with Product, Engineering, and Commercial teams in fast-paced environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to translate insights into actionable outcomes. Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. Demonstrated ability to drive initiatives independently and influence cross-functional teams. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. Experience in SaaS or CPaaS environments is a strong advantage. Craft and Toolkit: Product Operations & Process Optimization Strategic Planning & Execution Cross-Functional Leadership Product Enablement & Adoption Operational Excellence & Governance Data Analysis & Insight Generation Communication & Executive Storytelling Stakeholder Management & Influence Solutioning & Product Demonstrations AI Tools & Workflow Automation Customer-Centric Mindset Proactive, ownership-driven approach Character Traits: Analytical thinking and problem-solving – approach problems clearly, use data, and find solutions. items.description: Data and Analytics About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. The Opportunity The 3PL Operations Customer Success Manager acts as the crucial operational bridge between Flexport's e-commerce and retail clients and our warehouse fulfillment teams. You ensure SLA compliance, manage onboarding, and drive client retention by translating complex supply chain metrics into actionable business value. It's a client-facing, cross-functional role, and you'll be a key voice in how Flexport delivers on its commitments to fulfillment clients. You will: Client Success & Operational Liaison: Be the client's day-to-day point of contact, connecting them with warehouse, inventory, and tech teams to resolve fulfillment issues. Partner Oversight & SLA Accountability: Serve as Flexport's primary POC for assigned 3PL/4PL partners, inspecting sites and holding them accountable for SLAs on receiving, shipping, inventory accuracy, and packing quality. Coach teams of 30 to 100 at partner facilities and drive corrective action when needed. Forecasting & Capacity Planning: Share SNOP forecasts with partners and confirm labor and capacity plans align to demand. Billing & Invoice Management: Review and approve 3PL/4PL invoices and resolve discrepancies with partner teams. Process & Systems Compliance: Ensure partners follow Flexport SOPs and use our WMS correctly; troubleshoot system issues on the ground and reinforce best practices through hands-on support and training. Client Onboarding: Guide new merchants through WMS and OMS integration for a smooth transition into Flexport's fulfillment network. Performance Reporting: Deliver client-facing reports on inventory turns, shipping volume, and logistics efficiency to guide business reviews. Escalation Management: Own high-pressure escalations involving inventory loss, delayed shipments, or compliance fines, resolving quickly and communicating transparently with clients. Retention & Growth: Build long-term client trust through consistent operational reliability. Build the Function: Document how Flexport works with 4PL partners, including processes, escalation paths, and performance standards. You Should Have: 3+ years of hands-on experience in a warehouse, fulfillment, or 3PL/4PL operations environment, with working knowledge of floor-level workflows. 2+ years managing or coaching a team in a fulfillment, warehouse, or 3PL setting. Experience in account management or client-facing operations, translating operational performance into business outcomes. Proven ability to hold external partners accountable to SLAs without direct authority over their staff. Comprehensive, practical knowledge of WMS operations: capable of identifying root causes, training staff, and resolving system complications rather than merely managing daily operations. Strong reporting and data analysis skills: experience building and interpreting KPI dashboards (Excel or BI tools) and turning data into clear recommendations. Polished client-facing communication skills: experience leading business reviews and presenting performance data to external stakeholders, including navigating difficult conversations. Experience building structure and process in fast-paced, evolving environments. Nice-to-Haves: Experience managing merchant onboarding or system integrations Familiarity with client business reviews (QBRs) or account growth conversations International logistics or supply chain experience Before You Apply: Availability: Client fulfillment issues can arise outside standard business hours; you'll need to be reachable and able to manage your own time to match. Travel: You will visit partner and client sites regularly, including some travel outside your home region. A valid passport is required. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire base salary for the position in the posting's respective region. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range displayed, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education and / or training. Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at Flexport, which also includes bonus, equity, and comprehensive benefit offerings such as medical, dental, and flexible time off. The US base salary range for this position (this does not include bonus, equity and benefits): $64,800 — $89,100 USD Commitment to Equal Opportunity At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

items.description: Customer Support Headquarters: Remote (USA) PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform. PagerDuty is seeking an Account Manager to join our diverse, customer-focused team! As an Account Manager, you will serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of existing SaaS customers, partnering closely with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes. You will maintain and grow customer relationships, drive product adoption, manage renewals, and identify strategic expansion opportunities that deliver measurable business value. This is an exciting opportunity to blend customer success and sales expertise to help customers realize the full potential of PagerDuty’s platform while driving revenue growth. The ideal candidate is a proactive relationship builder with strong commercial acumen, a passion for data-driven customer management, and experience with SaaS products and AI-driven insights. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Own a portfolio of existing customers to ensure adoption, value realization, and retention. Develop and execute account plans that drive renewals, mitigate churn risk, and uncover expansion opportunities. Present and negotiate renewal proposals, structure multi-year options, and manage contract value through strategic account management. Monitor customer health using usage analytics, telemetry, and business insights to identify and address risks early. Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Sales Operations, and Renewals teams to ensure smooth contracting, forecasting, and reporting processes. Maintain strong product knowledge and deliver consultative guidance to drive configuration optimization and feature adoption. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 7+ years of combined customer-facing experience, including Account Management, Customer Success, or Renewals. 4+ years of proven success managing renewals and growth within a SaaS environment. Experience using Salesforce (SFDC) and analytics tools such as Gainsight, Tableau, or Looker. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Demonstrated ability to leverage data analytics and health metrics to manage and retain customer accounts. Prior enterprise sales expertise leveraging MEDDPICC & Value Selling. Experience working with enterprise software customers or in a DevOps environment. Strong understanding of AI-powered tools and how they can be leveraged to drive efficiency and insight. Proven history of achieving revenue and retention goals through consultative account management. Self-starter with strong collaboration, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. The base salary range for this position is $105,000.00 - $125,400.00 USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission, equity, and/or benefits. Our base salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range, which is subject to change based on primary work location, reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we expect to pay newly hired employees for the position. Within the range, we determine pay for an individual based on a number of factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills/competencies and experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific offerings for this role, as well as the salary range for your primary work location during the hiring process. Hesitant to apply? We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for job alerts ! Where we work PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with offices in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we cannot employ candidates residing in: Location restrictions: Australia: Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia Canada: Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon United States: Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role. How we work Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian. People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance. What we offer As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country-specific offerings, on our benefits site . Your package may include: Competitive salary Comprehensive benefits package Flexible work arrangements Company equity* ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Program)* Retirement or pension plan* Generous paid vacation time Paid holidays and sick leave Dutonian Wellness Days & HibernationDuty - companywide paid days off in addition to PTO Paid parental leave: 22 weeks for pregnant parent, 12 weeks for non-pregnant parent (some countries have longer leave standards and we comply with local laws)* Paid volunteer time off: 20 hours per year Company-wide hack weeks Mental wellness programs *Eligibility may vary by role, region, and tenure About PagerDuty PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. The PagerDuty Operations Cloud is an AI-powered platform that empowers business resilience and drives operational efficiency for enterprises. With a generative AI assistant at its core, PagerDuty empowers teams to detect and resolve issues in real time, orchestrate complex workflows, and drive continuous improvement across their digital operations. Trusted by nearly half of both the Fortune 500 and the Forbes AI 50, as well as approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100, PagerDuty is essential for delivering always-on digital experiences to modern businesses PagerDuty is Great Place to Work-certified™, a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, a Fortune Best Medium Workplace, a Fortune Best Workplace in Technology, and a top rated product on TrustRadius and G2. Go behind-the-scenes on our careers site and @pagerduty on Instagram. Additional Information PagerDuty is an equal opportunity employer. PagerDuty does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or disability status. Your privacy is important to us. By submitting an application, you confirm that you have read and understand PagerDuty's Privacy Policy . PagerDuty is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application process. Should you require accommodation, please email accommodation@pagerduty.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs. PagerDuty uses the E-Verify employment verification program. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pagerduty-account-manager-dc

GUS is an international network of higher education institutions, brought together by a shared passion for accessible and industry-relevant qualifications. We deliver a wide variety of programmes, including bachelor’s degree programmes, master’s degree programmes, professional training, English Language training, and corporate & executive education. When someone chooses to study at one of our institutions, whether on campus in Europe, North America, Asia or even in their own home, they are joining a network of over 100,000 students worldwide. When you decide to work with GUS, you will be joining an industry leading, global organisation that has a reach in over 150 different countries. Role Overview The Marketing Coordinator supports the day-to-day functioning of the Global Marketing Team, driving efficient processes, cross-team coordination, reporting, and project execution. This is a pivotal operations-focused role that ensures seamless collaboration between marketing, creative, content, and performance teams across our network of institutions. Key Responsibilities: · Project & Campaign Coordination: Support the delivery of global marketing campaigns and initiatives by tracking timelines, deliverables, and dependencies. · Team & Stakeholder Support: Act as a central point of coordination between cross-functional teams and regional stakeholders, ensuring clear information flow and task follow-through. Where needed, arrange face-to-face calls to clarify briefs and avoid misalignment. · Reporting & Performance Monitoring: Collate data from various teams to support the creation of marketing performance reports and dashboards. · Documentation & Knowledge Management: Maintain shared folders, ensure campaign materials are archived correctly, and assist with onboarding documentation for new team members. Key Skills & Attributes: · Native French speaker · Excellent level of English · Strong organizational and project coordination skills · Excellent written and verbal communication · Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint, and project management tools (e.g., Asana, Monday.com ) · Experience working in Salesforce is a plus · Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously · A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset · Ability to collaborate across global, multicultural teams · Comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment Preferred Qualifications: · Bachelor’s degree in Languages, Linguistics, Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field · 2-3 years of experience in marketing coordination, project management, or operations · 2-3 years of experience in communications, linguistics, or translation · Experience with Salesforce is a plus · Prior experience in education or a global marketing team is desirable Other information Please note this position is only available on our Consultancy agreement. Please note due to the high volume of applications we will only contact you if you are selected to continue for the next stage of the recruitment process. We wish you every success. GUS is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, or religion or belief. items.description: H2 Performance Consulting is subject to the Vietnam Era Veteran’s Readjustment Assistance Act as a Federal Contractor and is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and strives to build a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status or disability status. Additionally, as mandated under Executive order 12989, H2 is required to verify employment eligibility of selected candidates through the Department of Labor’s - E-Verify. H2 Performance Consulting (H2), a high-growth technology firm, is seeking a Senior Project Manager to support a U.S. government client. The Senior Project Manager will lead complex Federal projects, programs, and transformation initiatives from planning through implementation and closeout. The position integrates mission requirements, scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, resources, governance, contractor performance, and stakeholder decisions to deliver measurable outcomes within the Federal operating environment. This is a fully remote position supporting a government client. The position requires U.S. citizenship and an active Public Trust clearance at the time of application. This position is contingent upon contract award, final staffing requirements, security eligibility, certification requirements, and customer approval, where applicable. Key Responsibilities: Plan and lead complex projects or programs involving multiple workstreams, offices, bureaus, commands, contractors, or stakeholder organizations. Establish the project management approach, integrated schedule, work breakdown structure, governance cadence, performance baseline, quality controls, and reporting processes. Manage scope, schedule, cost, staffing, dependencies, risks, issues, assumptions, decisions, changes, deliverables, acceptance, and closeout. Translate contract, statutory, policy, program, technical, and stakeholder requirements into executable plans, milestones, backlogs, and assignments. Lead multidisciplinary Government and contractor teams and coordinate the work of functional, technical, data, cybersecurity, acquisition, financial, and operational specialists. Facilitate program reviews, integrated project teams, governance forums, risk reviews, sprint reviews, and executive decision sessions. Develop forecasts, corrective action plans, alternatives, decision papers, executive briefings, and Government-ready status reports. Maintain requirements and deliverable traceability and ensure work products are accurate, timely, defensible, and contractually compliant. Support implementation, organizational change, communications, training, transition, adoption, benefits realization, and sustainment planning. Align project objectives, outcomes, and acceptance criteria with agency mission, policy, acquisition strategy, funding, and operational priorities. Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, resource forecasts, risk and issue registers, action logs, decision logs, and performance dashboards. Monitor progress using tools like GitHub or Jira with appropriate predictive, adaptive, Agile, or hybrid delivery methods and recommend timely management action when performance varies from the baseline. Coordinate dependencies among policy, business processes, workforce, data, technology, security, privacy, accessibility, procurement, and deployment activities. Manage communications with Government leads, contracting personnel, executives, end users, vendors, and partner organizations. Protect procurement-sensitive, proprietary, personally identifiable, controlled, unclassified, and other sensitive information in accordance with applicable requirements. Promote practical continuous improvement while maintaining accountability for scope, decisions, approvals, and outcomes. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in business, public administration, project management, engineering, information systems, or related field; master’s degree preferred. 10+ years of progressively responsible project, program, operations, or management-consulting experience. 10+ years supporting Federal civilian, defense, intelligence, military, or comparable public-sector organizations. 10+ years leading complex projects, major workstreams, multidisciplinary teams, or transformation initiatives. Demonstrated experience managing scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality, staffing, stakeholders, and contract deliverables. Demonstrated ability to advise senior Government leaders and convert complex information into decisions and executable actions. Documented results improving mission effectiveness, timeliness, quality, cost, compliance, customer experience, or workforce performance. U.S. citizenship required. Active Public Trust clearance required at the time of application. Preferred Qualifications: Project Management Professional, FAC-P/PM, DAWIA Level III Program Management, Certified ScrumMaster, PMI Agile Certified Practitioner, or comparable credential. Lean Six Sigma, Prosci Change Management, ITIL, or comparable process, change, or service management credential. Experience managing firm-fixed-price, time-and-materials, cost-reimbursement, multiple-award, task-order, or performance-based Federal work. Experience with integrated master schedules, earned value concepts, Agile delivery, product roadmaps, requirements traceability, quality assurance, and executive governance. Experience supporting Cabinet-level departments, defense organizations, independent agencies, or multi-agency initiatives. H2 Performance Consulting offers competitive benefits to include health insurance, vision/dental insurance, paid time off, holiday pay, and 401K.

items.description: Job Title: Marketplace Operations Manager II Job Location (Remote): Remote, USA About the Company Wheel is evolving the traditional care ecosystem by equipping the nation’s most innovative companies with a premier platform to deliver high-quality virtual care at scale. We offer proven strategies and cutting-edge technologies to foster consumer engagement, build brand loyalty, and maximize return on investment. Wheel solutions include configurable virtual care programs, an intuitive consumer interface, and access to a nationwide network of board-certified clinicians. Discover how Wheel is transforming the future of healthcare by visiting www.wheel.com. About the Role We’re looking for a Marketplace Operations Manager II to own visit delivery for a defined set of Wheel’s client programs. This is an operator’s role for someone who wants day-to-day ownership of critical business outcomes - and can carry that accountability even when some levers live with peer functions. You’ll take on the complex, ambiguous problems that come with scaling a fast-growing telehealth marketplace - from stabilizing a roster through demand volatility, to leading cross-functional projects that shape how Marketplace Operations scales next. You will own the visit delivery SLA commitments, program-level consult cost performance, and the roster health for your clients. Separate functions on the team own overall clinician supply forecasting, clinician performance management, and scheduling - freeing you up to optimize their use within your programs. This is a role for someone who wants to run marketplace operations for key clients end-to-end: launching and configuring new client programs, writing the operational playbooks your programs run on, and deploying incentive spend within guardrails - while trusting peer functions to own adjacent responsibilities in order for you to maintain a singular, maniacal focus on client performance. What You’ll Do Program Performance and Delivery Own marketplace performance outcomes (contractual and otherwise) for your assigned client programs: SLA attainment, program-level clinician pay cost, and roster/staffing health. Own roster composition and staffing strategy for your programs, building and adjusting rosters to ensure SLA through client growth, churn, and short-term volatility. Own operational data analytics and reporting for your programs - pulling and interrogating utilization, breach-pattern, and profitability data yourself and turning it into recommendations and actions Own the operating rhythm and upward performance visibility for your programs: recurring performance reviews of SLA, utilization, and cost that turns into actions. Partner with the Capacity Planner to understand near-term volatility and how it may affect client demand (ie demand surges, modality changes, etc) and own the operational response for your programs (escalation thresholds, incentive levers, roster mix) to keep the program on track. Cost and Incentives Optimize program-level clinician pay cost and deploy consult incentive spend within a defined budget. Own the cost plan for your programs and be accountable to variance - partner with the Director of Marketplace on expected cost-per-consult, and keep your lever costs calibrated so you know how to deploy your incentives appropriately. Real-Time Response and Agent Oversight Author the real-time escalation and response playbook your programs run on: thresholds, approved corrective actions, escalation triggers. Real-time monitoring and AI agents execute against the playbook you write, and you refine how they act on your programs as their capabilities grow. Review how the agents act on your programs - audit their decisions for quality, catch policy drift or mistakes early, and feed corrections back into the playbook and the agent logic. You’re the human-in-the-loop that keeps automated responses trustworthy on your book. Partner with clinician management peers to relay clinician performance observations that impact your programs and to identify roster improvements that will drive your client performance. Client Launches and Partnership Partner with Customer Success as the operational counterpart on the client’s commercial relationship - supporting quarterly business reviews and the real-world story behind client performance. Own launch supply-readiness with Provider Operations and the Capacity Planner - ensuring clinicians are credentialed, licensed, and activated in the right states, at the volume the program needs, before go-live. Lead new-client implementation - configuration and setup - as part of cross functional onboarding teams, and own expansions for programs you already run. Support strategic projects across Marketplace Operations as they arise. Who You Are An operator with experience working in fast-paced, high-demand environments - someone who digs into the details to find root cause, spots broken or inefficient processes, and builds the fix rather than just flagging the problem. Experience owning end-to-end operational performance in a marketplace, logistics, or two-sided platform environment (delivery, rideshare, staffing, workforce management) - direct accountability for SLA, throughput, or cost. Strategic thinker who connects day-to-day program performance to the bigger picture - you can zoom out from a single roster or escalation to spot the pattern worth fixing structurally, and zoom back in to execute it. A strong cross-functional partner and team player - you know how to work through peer teams and different personalities to drive your program’s outcomes, even when you don’t own every lever yourself. Strong data fluency. You pull and interrogate your own SLA, completion, utilization, and cost-to-plan data and drive decisions from it - hands-on with SQL, Looker, and Excel - rather than waiting for someone to translate it for you. A direct, clear communicator who authors and revises the procedures your programs run on - escalation playbooks, response plans, launch runbooks - rather than only following ones someone else wrote. Nice to Have Don’t let these stand in your way—they’re just added bonuses! If you meet most of the core requirements, we encourage you to apply. Exposure to multi-state licensure, credentialing, or other regulated-workforce dynamics. Experience launching or configuring new client programs in a marketplace or platform business. Healthcare, telehealth, or regulated-workforce experience. Marketplace or platform experience. Salary and Perks Pay Range: $122,075- $155,000 plus equity Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations. Wheel is unable to consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position. As an employee of Wheel, you’ll enjoy our Total Rewards Program to help secure your financial future and preserve your health and well-being, including: Medical, Dental and Vision Ancillary: Life, Short and Long Term Disability 401K match Flexible PTO Parental Leave Stock options Additional programs and perks Wheel is committed to equal employment opportunities for all team members. Every decision we make regarding employment is solely based on merit, competence, and performance. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Research shows that underrepresented groups typically apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria listed. At Wheel, we encourage women, people of color, and LGBTQ+ job seekers to apply for positions even if they don’t check every box for the role.

items.description: Join Telaid as a Collections Specialist! Who We Are: Telaid is a leader in technology deployment solutions for multi-site enterprises. For over 40 years, we have been the trusted partner for accelerating the adoption of innovative technologies that drive positive business outcomes. Our mission is to reduce the time, effort, risk, and cost associated with implementing cutting-edge technology. Position Overview: As a Collections Specialist , you will play a vital role in ensuring the company receives timely payments from clients. This role requires strong financial analysis skills, customer service excellence, and problem-solving abilities to maintain Telaid’s financial health. If you’re a detail-oriented, results-driven professional who thrives in a collaborative environment, this is the perfect opportunity for you! Key Responsibilities: Use accounting software to generate reports and review open accounts for past-due balances. Track invoices nearing due dates and send reminders to customers proactively. Identify overdue amounts based on customer payment terms. Contact customers via phone or email in a professional manner to resolve outstanding payments while maintaining positive client relationships. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Design and simulate challenging, realistic business scenarios that require expert-level use of Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, mirroring tasks from your professional experience. Engage in structured, multi-turn conversations with an LLM, presenting complex document-related prompts and evaluating AI-generated deliverables. Create and review Office documents (.xlsx, .docx, .pptx), assessing two AI-generated solutions against professional standards and selecting the preferred output. Document feedback and provide detailed, side-by-side preference data to inform AI model improvements, focusing on quality, accuracy, and business relevance. Contribute domain-specific insight across multiple industries and business functions, ensuring the data collected covers diverse, real-world use cases. Communicate clearly and thoughtfully in both written and verbal formats to ensure precise understanding and actionable feedback for the AI training team. Preferred Qualifications Minimum 3+ years of professional experience working in Fortune 500 environments using Excel, PowerPoint, and Word on high-impact business projects. Demonstrated expertise in creating complex models, reports, analyses, and presentations across various industries such as finance, healthcare, tech, consulting, or retail. Background in business roles such as private equity associate, investment banking analyst, junior consultant, FP&A analyst, HR, or marketing strategist, with hands-on involvement in deal or project work. Proficiency in designing use cases reflecting functions like strategy, operations, sales, marketing, finance, or HR. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a keen eye for detail and clarity in articulating feedback. Experience interacting with LLMs or writing long-form prompts for AI tools is a strong plus. Strong analytical mindset and ability to evaluate nuanced differences in document quality and business applicability. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Role: Global Business Development Manager Location: Remote (Applicable only for Global candidates) Who You Are You are a commercially focused business development professional with UK and global student recruitment expertise, strong agent networks, CRM experience, and a proven ability to lead teams and drive growth. About Us Regent College London is a leading independent higher education provider, offering flexible and inclusive learning across multiple London campuses. We are student-focused, digitally forward, and committed to academic excellence. The Role Lead UK and global student recruitment by managing agent partnerships, developing new business, improving conversion and compliance, and supporting teams to achieve growth targets. Key Responsibilities 1. Key Activities and Responsibilities Report management – ensuring that daily reports are up to date and sent out to all partners/agents daily or until the SLA set with partner. Manage between 12-18 agent/accounts and ensure they are meeting expectations and are providing the quality of learners that is expected. Identifying potential new agents/accounts/businesses to further develop UKBDL and UKDL student recruitment and any other global remit. Managing junior business development executives and supporting teams – Ensuring their activities support the objectives of student recruitment. Providing a smooth journey for both the agent/account and students, ensuring the application process is efficient to support improved conversion. This can include getting feedback from relevant parties to continuously improve processes. Have a detailed understanding of all systems used by both agents and students to ensure advice and guidance in this area is clear Ensuring KPI’s set by the Head of Business Development are met. This includes delivery of targets set via agents/account, onboarding new business, improving conversion rate from application to enrolment, and improving brand awareness in existing and new markets. Proactively support all colleagues in pursuit of the University’s central objectives and values within the business at all levels. Gathering intelligence and data to propose new initiative to further develop new and existing UK and global opportunities. This will include – interpreting of data, and articulating key messages, and publishing papers for relevant committees. Ensure that the University’s reputation is protected by getting all agents/accounts to adhere to the University’s processes and acting with integrity internally and externally. Part of this to ensure existing and new agents/businesses recommended have a good track record in HE Adhere to the universities admissions processes and regulations ensuring a clear audit trail for training and compliance purposes. Ensuring all students recruited through agent meets the required levels of progression/AU benchmark, this will include the continuous auditing of students referred via agents. 2. Analysis and Reporting Identify gaps or shortfalls in recruitment strategies and identifying how to solve these issues. Analyse data/statistics, interpreting and reporting patterns and trends and highlighting and prioritising any issues for further investigation to support informed decision making. Provide daily reports on student activity to agents and partners. Provide reports and updates to key commercial leads within the business. Analysing agent performance not only from a recruitment perceptive but from a student engagement perceptive as well. 3. Customer/Service Support Provide advice to peers and partners to respond and independently resolve a range of standard and unforeseen issues, within pre-determined operational limits. Support and lead Business development Executives, support teams, and other relevant departments. Advise and update the team on regulatory/compliance/product/process changes providing appropriate training as needed. Ensuring the partner/agent is receiving the best support and is being provide the best service to the standard the University requires. Diagnose and rectify any problems with sales processes and systems. Feedback to the agents/ Partners on performance of students. Planning and organising Plan and organise own activities to ensure that routine operations and ongoing KPI’s deadlines are continuously met. Support in the development of team structures. Prepare a plan agent/partner training both face to face and online. Ensuring SLA’s are met and that partners are happy with service being provided. Participate in or co-ordinate student recruitment projects or development activities. Make recommendations about resource planning. 5. Liaison Communicate and build working relationships with agents/partners to ensure they are happy with the service being provided and that they grow within the business. Attend meetings, as requested by manager, to support departmental activities and to report back on main discussion points. Liaising with key stakeholders, such as admissions, quality assurance and student support. Regular communication with the Business Development Team, providing feedback on Agent documents that are being submitted. 6. Continuous Improvement Advise on and propose changes in procedures, planning and systems to improve operational efficiency to improve quality of service in student recruitment. Keep skills up to date and develop depth or breadth of knowledge in student recruitment practice by learning from colleagues and exposure to a range of activities, training and networking opportunities. Continuing to improve conversion rate and enrolled numbers coming from each partner. Make recommendations on how to improve the University’s brand and make it more commercially attractive. Look at ways of improving current processes, especially when looking at growth within the team and recruitment numbers. 7. People Management Co-operate with other colleagues (either individually or in a team setting) to contribute to the achievement of departmental objectives. Train and develop junior staff members, and ensure direct reports are performing their duties and meeting their KPI’s. Managing the agent/partnership relationships, ensuring they are clear on all admissions procedures and are meeting their quality requirements. Show sensitivity and consideration and emotional support to other people’s/student’s needs and feelings, which often include dealing with signs of obvious distress. Dealing with culture differences, for example when dealing with overseas staff remember they may be used to a different working environment than we are in the UK or other global countries Deliver guidance and support in a calm, discreet, diplomatic and professional manner. Support agents/partners and provide referral and signposting pathways for students in crisis to internal and external support function and organisations. 8. Personal and Professional Development and Training Identify and address development needs to ensure continuing professional development. Communicate and share best practice. Proactively identify new opportunities and work with management to develop solutions. Work in accordance with the University’s Values Framework. Maintain strong empathy for the university's commitment to equality of opportunity and equality of treatment for colleagues and students. 9. Other Responsibilities Any other duties as appropriate to seniority and role. The post-holder will be required occasionally to travel to other locations for meetings or training. Attendance at appropriate internal working parties as required. To always ensure the University’s name and brand is never brought into doubt and that externally we are seen as professional and a pleasure to work with. Essential: Analyse market data and trends, to assist and advise faculties, departments and senior management within the University on the development of UK and global recruitment strategies, new programmes, or policies on UK activities where appropriate. Liaise and engage with key stakeholders and internal and external contractors to influence opinion, delivery and reputation of services. Influence and contribute to the scoping and resource planning across a range of activities at operational level to meet organisational objectives, including contributing to business plans and strategy documents where required. Implement processes to manage the integrity and security of all commercially and professionally sensitive and personal data. Analysis & problem-solving capability Well-developed written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal skills Ability to manage partners expectations and provide training sessions to ensure quality Ability to prioritise tasks and delegate tasks to direct reports. Represent the University at education expositions, Universities, schools, and colleges, as a University Influencing Senior Colleagues/external partners. Develop external relations, identify and develop opportunities for communities of practice, employers, alumni and donors via extra-curricular activities and increased levels of participation with a view to positively impact student recruitment. Build and sustain an influential network of contacts both internally and externally to influence and promote reputation, including relevant education institutions, Embassies, Consulates and sponsorship bodies. Keep well informed about the University in all relevant aspects of its work through engagement with relevant committees, attendance at workshops and events, and networking with University colleagues. This will include submit committee papers helping to aid UK recruitment. In collaboration with finance business partners create business cases to validate commercial opportunities for the university Contribute to operational leadership teams and decision making to shape the nature and level of support services. Provide expert professional subject and/or managerial expertise at an operational level to support UK/Domestic student recruitment, including achievement of UK/Domestic student application targets, increasing the quality of the student intake, increasing conversion rates from application to registration, and increasing diversity in terms of ethnicity, subject of study and recruitment from under represented community groups. Experience of working with complex sales processes and CRM software Experience of working/responding independently and dealing with unforeseen problems and circumstances Comprehensive knowledge of the work practices, processes, and procedures relevant to the role. Clear understanding of the standards and regulations set for the conduct and output for the role. Understanding of the activities of other areas of the University relevant to the student recruitment function. Experience in successfully managing partners/ agents. Experience pulling reports and providing them to key stakeholders. Ability to analyse reports and sales figures to identify trends within the agent market, and share/articulate intelligence to drive change. Desirable: Extensive UK and global network including agents, institutions (i.e. British Council, QS, local education ministries, etc) Post Grad/PhD (or candidature), Previous account management experience. Working Hours & Flexibility 40 hours per week 100% Remote - Working from any other country apart from UK Compliance Statement Successful applicants will be required to complete pre-employment checks, including a criminal records check, two references, ID and Right to Work verification, and education confirmation. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity and inclusion, selection for employment is based solely on an individual’s skills, qualifications, and experience relevant to the role. items.summary: ABOUT OUTRIGHT INTERNATIONALFounded in 1990, Outright International strives to help lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, intersex, and queer (LGBTIQ) people live safer, healthier, and more empowered lives worldwide.
items.description: ABOUT OUTRIGHT INTERNATIONAL Founded in 1990, Outright International strives to help lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, intersex, and queer (LGBTIQ) people live safer, healthier, and more empowered lives worldwide. With staff in 18 countries and global headquarters in New York City, Outright documents human rights violations, helps resource LGBTIQ movements and allies, and advocates for the rights of LGBTIQ people. Reporting to the Senior Director of Global Programs and Grantmaking, the Program Manager will manage the program's implementation across its target regions, serving as the primary link between Outright's leadership, regional program staff, and in-country partners to ensure the program is delivered in a locally owned, demand-driven, and donor-compliant manner. Key Responsibilities Program Oversight and Implementation Lead day-to-day management of a large, multi-country grant portfolio, ensuring activities align with donor requirements and organizational strategy Coordinate across regional program staff to ensure coherent implementation in high-risk, conflict-affected, and restrictive operating environments Oversee program inception phase, including finalization of Theory of Change, MEL plan, and capacity strengthening plans with in-country partners Partner Management Manage relationships with a diverse portfolio of in-country partner organizations, including selection, risk assessment, and reassessment processes Oversee co-design and rollout of individualized capacity strengthening plans with partners, ensuring demand-driven and participatory approaches Support flexible, partner-led financing mechanisms including emergency, programmatic, and organizational development funding Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning Coordinate participatory MEL processes with partners, including outcome mapping, baselines, and qualitative assessment tools in close cooperation with Outright´s MEL team Track programmatic and contextual risk registers, escalating significant shifts and coordinating adaptive management responses Liaise with external MEL consultants and support donor-led baseline and mid-term evaluation processes Risk and Safeguarding Monitor evolving political, security, and civic-space risks across the program's regions and adjust implementation accordingly Ensure safeguarding standards (including SEAH prevention) are upheld across all partner relationships Coordinate risk-sharing arrangements and contingency planning with partners and internal compliance teams Advocacy Coordination Support in-country partners' engagement with regional and multilateral human rights mechanisms Coordinate logistics and strategic input for partner participation in international convenings and advocacy weeks Ensure advocacy priorities remain demand-driven and reflect partner-identified needs Compliance and Reporting Ensure adherence to donor financial and narrative reporting requirements across all in-country partners Coordinate with finance and grants teams on disbursement schedules, compliance checks, and sanctions screening Prepare consolidated narrative and financial reports for donor submission Qualifications Significant experience managing complex, multi-country grants in the human rights, LGBTIQ+ rights, or international development sector Demonstrated experience working with civil society partners in restrictive, high-risk, or conflict-affected contexts Strong understanding of grantmaking, localization principles, and partner-led program design Experience with MEL frameworks, particularly outcome mapping or similar qualitative approaches Familiarity with donor compliance requirements (e.g., government or multilateral funding instruments) Cultural competency and sensitivity to SOGIESC dynamics and intersectional analysis Willingness to travel to program regions as security conditions allow Language skills relevant to program regions are considered an asset. English and Spanish are mandatory. How to Apply Interested candidates should applyvia BambooHR at this link. ( Outright is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. People of color, people who are transgender, intersex, or gender-variant, and individuals originally from the Global South are strongly encouraged to apply. Only qualified candidates will be contacted. Please do not call. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Role Title: Clinician (Oncology / Hematology) Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Clinician (Oncology / Hematology)s to contribute to a customer’s project at the forefront of AI in healthcare. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Author and review evaluation tasks that require nuanced clinical judgment, leveraging Clinical Study Reports, periodic safety reports, and regulatory correspondence in oncology and haematology. Assess the clinical defensibility of efficacy and safety conclusions, ensuring endpoints and effect sizes reflect true clinical significance. Apply advanced judgment to dose escalation, dose-limiting toxicity, modifications, adverse event grading and attribution, and the coherence of patient narratives. Evaluate benefit-risk reasoning, scrutinizing the durability of conclusions in light of new events, and the realism of described management strategies. Identify and flag content that is clinically implausible or internally inconsistent, distinguishing these from legitimate clinical variation. Provide structured, guideline-based written rationales that clearly explain the validity or limitations of clinical interpretations for a non-clinical audience. Preferred Qualifications Specialist registration or board certification in medical oncology and/or haematology, with 5+ years of post-training clinical experience. Direct involvement in clinical trials as investigator, sub-investigator, or sponsor-side medical monitor, safety physician, or clinical development physician. Proficiency with CTCAE grading, relevant response criteria (RECIST, Lugano, IMWG, IWCLL, ELN), and outcome endpoints (ORR, DoR, PFS, OS, MRD). Hands-on experience with trial documents such as protocols, investigator brochures, CSRs, safety narratives, or DSMB/IDMC materials. Demonstrated excellence in written communication, with clear, structured explanations of clinical reasoning tailored for non-clinical readers. Previous roles in medical monitoring or as medical director on oncology or haematology programmes, and committee participation (IDMC, DSMB, adjudication, or independent review committees). Peer-reviewed publication record or authorship on clinical trial manuscripts, with any exposure to AI-assisted clinical review tools seen as a plus. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Role Title: Adolescent/Child Safeguarding & Exploitation Specialist Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Adolescent/Child Safeguarding & Exploitation Specialists to contribute to a customer's project focused on assessing sexual safety and exploitation risk in adolescent scenarios. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Review complex adolescent cases to assess sexual safety and exploitation (CSE/CSA) risks. Produce clear, defensible written safeguarding guidance suitable for non-specialists. Apply recognised risk-assessment and safeguarding frameworks to evaluate urgency and appropriate interventions. Identify indicators of grooming, coercion, and exploitation within nuanced case details. Recommend protective actions and escalation pathways, including when mandatory reporting is warranted. Utilise a trauma-informed lens, weighing developmental, capacity, and consent factors in each assessment. Benchmark your clinical judgments against peer standards and established protocols to ensure guidance accuracy and reliability. Preferred Qualifications 3–5+ years post-qualification experience in child safeguarding, adolescent-protection, or relevant clinical roles. Specialty background in child protection, forensic child/adolescent psychiatry or psychology, or paediatric medicine with a safeguarding remit. Active clinical license or registration in good standing. Current or recent (within the last two years) adolescent caseload or safeguarding practice. Demonstrated expertise in CSE/CSA risk assessment and mandatory-reporting requirements. Strong skills in trauma-informed practice and documentation. Exceptional written communication in research-grade English (native, or IELTS 7.5+/writing 7.0+, TOEFL 100+, Cambridge C1–C2, or equivalent). Experience in a designated safeguarding or expert-witness capacity, and familiarity with ACEs and trauma frameworks, is a plus. Start Timeline & Availability We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24 – 48 hours of completing onboarding. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: External Communications Strategist
items.summary: Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference?
items.description: Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference? Make an impact. Join PMI. How will you make a difference to PMI? The External Communications Strategist III is an execution-first, senior individual contributor responsible for driving earned media opportunities and narrative enablement in support of PMI’s corporate reputation, thought leadership, and strategic priorities. This role sits within the PR + Communications team and operates with a high degree of autonomy, judgment, and ownership. As a Level III individual contributor, this role is expected to operate as a trusted advisor within Communications—anticipating opportunities, identifying risks, and independently driving work forward while ensuring alignment to broader narrative and reputational priorities. You will provide strategic counsel to senior stakeholders on external narrative direction, message discipline, and reputational considerations, and recommend narrative adjustments based on trends, current events, and performance insights. What you’ll bring to the role: Earned Media Strategy & Agency Partnership Collaborate with PR agency to identify story opportunities and develop timely, compelling pitch angles aligned to priority narrative beats for both B2B and consumer audiences. Maximize PR agency performance helping to sharpen briefs, challenge thinking, and ensure proactive, high-quality execution against PMI’s strategic communications goals. Partner with PR agency (and consult with internal stakeholders, including regional and functional leads) on developing strategy and positioning for global media house moments. Partner with the broader Marketing organization to source appropriate community or executive spokespeople; vet, prepare, and align them for earned media pitching and engagements. Use media intelligence and performance insights (e.g., message pull-through, tier-1 quality, topic traction) to identify narrative opportunities and gaps, and to refine story angles and pitching strategy. Shape earned media strategies that strengthen PMI’s discoverability and influence in search and AI-driven answer environments, ensuring coverage reinforces desired brand perception, priority narratives, and authoritative topic associations. Earned & Sponsored External Opportunities Independently or collaboratively identify and execute strategic earned opportunities for PMI executives or community spokespeople to reach unaware or new audiences (e.g., third-party events, podcasts, partner activations, key account–adjacent moments). Partner with PR agency and relevant internal teams to evaluate, secure, and execute selective sponsored opportunities (e.g., panels, conferences, tentpole events) that advance PMI’s narratives and reputational goals. Assess external opportunities for narrative fit, audience value, and reputational considerations; recommend go/no-go decisions and execute approved engagements end-to-end. Identify and shape thought leadership platforms (e.g., executive bylines, strategic reports, high-impact forums, and selective partnerships) that reinforce priority narratives and differentiate PMI’s point of view. Narrative Ownership & Enablement Lead efforts for defined corporate message houses, including maintenance of current proof points, examples, and data, ensuring they reflect evolving business priorities and external context. Own external narrative governance for assigned topics (message architecture, claims/proof points, and executive-ready guidance), ensuring consistency across earned media, executive platforms, and thought leadership moments. Define what is included in narrative-specific enablement kits (e.g., message houses, executive-ready slides, talk tracks, FAQs, supporting materials) and proactively distribute to internal stakeholders and executives ahead of external opportunities. Maintain and refresh enablement kits on a regular cadence; communicate updates clearly and ensure adoption across PR, Marketing, and regional teams. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Judgment Work closely with Director of PR & Communications, Marketing, regional teams, and agency partners to ensure narrative consistency and executional excellence across external touchpoints. Influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners to align on narrative, timing, and external positioning—often without direct authority—and deliver clear recommendations (including go/no-go) in ambiguous, high-visibility situations. Maintain issues readiness for assigned narratives, including rapid response positioning, Q&A, and escalation recommendations in reputationally sensitive moments. Navigate nuanced, high-visibility topics with maturity and discretion; identify risks early (misalignment, gaps, timing, tone) and recommend solutions. Independently manage multiple workstreams and deadlines; maintain clear tracking of opportunities, deliverables, approvals, and outcomes. Role Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Public Relations, or related field (or equivalent experience). 8-10+ years of experience in corporate communications, PR, or earned media–focused roles. Demonstrated experience partnering with and managing PR agencies to drive earned media outcomes. Proven track record of developing and executing proactive earned media or external engagement strategies tied to corporate narratives. Experience operating with senior-level autonomy and judgment in complex, matrixed organizations. Strong earned media instincts with the ability to translate narrative strategy into executable story angles. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to distill complex topics into clear, compelling messages. High judgment and discretion; comfortable operating in reputationally sensitive areas. Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills. Highly organized, self-directed operator with strong prioritization and follow-through. Ability to anticipate needs, proactively identify opportunities, and execute with minimal oversight. Stakeholder management is paramount; ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment on narrative direction and recommendations. Strategic, analytical mindset with the ability to use insights and reporting to optimize external communications strategy and outcomes. Proficiency in the business language for PMI (English). Possible travel up to 5% What you can expect from us We value and nurture an environment of inclusivity and diversity, and a culture of communication and collaboration. Your health, safety and well-being come first, and we believe that you should have time for your work, but you should also have time for you.. Join us and you’ll get: an excellent total package, with compensation and benefits based upon your geographic location. skill development opportunities, to help you grow now and into the future. access to a global network, to enrich your professional experience. flexible options to help balance work time and your time award and bonus opportunities. The salary offer will be based on several factors, including the candidate’s demonstrated skills, qualifications and relevant experience. Let’s help make the world work better for everyone. Apply today! Project Management Institute, Inc. is committed to providing equal employment opportunities without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. items.title: Community Strategist
items.summary: About UsMighty Networks helps people and brands build communities, online courses, memberships, challenges, and events.
items.description: About Us Mighty Networks helps people and brands build communities, online courses, memberships, challenges, and events. Through its advanced technology, called people magic, Mighty helps the members of those networks build relationships with each other by surfacing the most relevant and interesting connections. Because of this novel approach and member-centered experience, Mighty has produced the most $1M communities and helped its Hosts earn over $500M. The Role As a Community Strategist, you’ll work with our premium Mighty Pro customers to help them create deeply engaging community experiences that lead to powerful outcomes. You will lead workshops, co-create launch strategies, and shape the early member experience for some of the world’s boldest and most influential Hosts. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in both structured systems and creative problem-solving, and is excited to model excellence, mentor peers, and scale success through repeatable frameworks. What You'll Do Serve as a strategic partner to new Mighty Pro Hosts during their onboarding phase as they set up their Network in the way that leads to maximum member adoption, engagement, and retention. Facilitate impactful workshops with Hosts and their teams that establish strong foundations in community design, content cadence, and engagement strategy. Deliver targeted training on feature utilization, member onboarding flows, and tactical programming to drive adoption, activation, and retention. Provide creative input and feedback on brand elements like landing pages, welcome experiences, email sequences, and network messaging to ensure a cohesive and compelling member journey. Own the development and delivery of strategic Community Design Plans—including network architecture, monthly themes, onboarding flows, and launch programming calendars. Collaborate closely with Launch Specialists and Implementation teams, providing timely information and handling lightweight setup tasks directly where appropriate. Ensure clarity, consistency, and excellence in the execution of space configuration, access structure, and end-to-end member experience. Maintain regular updates to internal stakeholders on Host performance, needs, risks, and outcomes—contributing to visibility and cross-functional alignment. Contribute to shared knowledge across the Customer Success team by capturing and scaling best practices, identifying emerging trends, and improving playbooks. What We're Looking For 6+ years of client-facing experience, ideally working with strategic accounts or supporting 5–6 figure engagements in a SaaS, media, or creator-focused business. 2+ years experience in a consulting, business coaching, or agency role. Strategic thinker and tactical executor—you can map out long-term plans, define metrics for success, and follow through on details to deliver. Deep understanding of community-building and digital member experiences; you’re passionate about helping others create belonging at scale. Excellent communicator and facilitator, with confidence in guiding executive teams through planning, decision-making, and feedback cycles. Master of meetings—you show up with a plan, gather input with nuance, read the room, and close with clear decisions and next steps. Adaptable and proactive, energized by growth and ambiguity, and always seeking ways to streamline and improve. Highly collaborative and cross-functional, thriving when working across CS, Implementation, Product, and Strategy to elevate outcomes. Radically curious, with a growth mindset and drive to keep learning about Hosts, their businesses, and how digital communities are evolving. What We Offer A dynamic, remote-first work culture that values creativity, autonomy, and bold thinking. Comprehensive benefits, including health, vision, dental, and generous paid time off. Clear opportunities for professional growth, including leadership pathways and skill development support. The chance to shape the future of how communities, creators, and brands thrive online—with the team that’s building what’s next. Join us in shaping the future of community-driven digital businesses with Mighty Pro! Compensation: The base salary for this role ranges from $80,000–$145,000, with exact compensation based on location, experience, and cost of living. Originally posted on Himalayas

Consensys is the leading blockchain and web3 software company. Founded by Joe Lubin, CEO of Consensys and Co-Founder of Ethereum in 2014, Consensys has been at the forefront of innovation, pioneering technological developments within the web3 ecosystem. The financial system is being rebuilt on open, programmable infrastructure, and Consensys is helping power that transition. Our mission is to unlock the collaborative power of communities by making the decentralized web universally easy to access, use, and build on. You'll join a network of builders that reaches the edge of our ecosystem. Consensys alumni have moved on to become tech entrepreneurs, CEOs, and team leads at tech companies. We strive for an environment that gives our people high trust and autonomy, while also facilitating collaboration, communication and camaraderie among teams and teammates. We aspire to build a diverse engineering team, inclusive to people from all backgrounds and demographics. It is also of great importance to us that working at MetaMask is an experience that catalyzes career growth and learning. Unify, enhance and transform our experiences across MetaMask Portfolio, Browser Extension, and Mobile platforms to support social experiences Coordinate and communicate with other experience teams to complete complex projects Mentor more junior team members and broadly elevate the level of engineers around you Requirements: 6+ years working with web and mobile-based technologies Hands-on experience with React and React Native Extensive experience with modern Javascript (ES6/TypeScript/etc.) Experience with blockchain fundamentals across multiple blockchain architectures Strong working knowledge developing cross platform/browser compatibility Experience working in an agile development team Experience developing medium to large-scale applications across the entire stack with minimal tech debt through sensible abstractions, testing, linting, and adherence to coding/web standards Experience consuming APIs A demonstrable understanding of Continuous Integration Strong understanding of web-based security threats and prevention techniques Bonus Points: Working knowledge of multiple blockchain protocols (EVM and non-EVM) Experience with cross-chain bridges, transaction lifecycle and/or interoperability solutions Demonstrated passion for and knowledge of blockchain technologies Experience working in a decentralized, distributed team Previous experience working in Web3 Product knowledge about the Web3 wallet space Mobile experience (React Native, Objective C, Swift) Other skills to demonstrate: Excellent verbal and written communication in English Teamwork, flexibility, initiative, communication and organization Willingness to constantly learn & improve, challenging yourself to stay at the top of your game Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role. Further details will be provided to applicants that successfully meet the criteria for the position as determined by the company in its sole discretion. By submitting an application for employment, you are acknowledging and consenting to this requirement. Other - NOT USA $130,000—$190,000 USD In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At Consensys , this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3. Consensys is an equal opportunity employer.
