items.description: Who is Boulevard? Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most. Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen . We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most . Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too. Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard. We're hiring a Director of Engineering - Cloud & Reliability to lead our infrastructure transformation and establish industry leading reliability practices. This role will be instrumental in evolving Boulevard's infrastructure into a scalable, reliable, secure, and highly available platform that supports our rapid growth and customer needs across a spectrum of market segments (Small Business, Franchises, Enterprises). Reporting to the SVP of Engineering, you'll lead a team of infrastructure and reliability engineers while driving the technical strategy for our cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, and platform capabilities. Your work will directly enable the Engineering & Data teams to deliver APIs, services, customer-facing products and data capabilities at scale by providing robust, self-service infrastructure foundations. You'll architect and implement modern infrastructure practices including containerization, infrastructure-as-code, advanced CI/CD pipelines, and comprehensive observability systems. This role is perfect for a technical leader who wants to build the infrastructure platform that becomes the backbone of Boulevard's next phase of growth. Domains of Ownership Cloud Infrastructure & Platform - Design, implement, and maintain scalable AWS infrastructure including multi-region deployments, and infrastructure-as-code DevOps & CI/CD - Transform deployment pipelines, implement container orchestration, and enable rapid, reliable software delivery Observability & Reliability - Implement comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and incident response using DataDog and related tools Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity - Establish DR infrastructure, failover systems, and business continuity planning across all Boulevard services Infrastructure Automation - Build self-service infrastructure capabilities and advanced automation using Terraform and GitOps practices Security & Compliance - Establish comprehensive security practices, manage compliance frameworks (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2), and implement security-by-design principles Key Projects & Initiatives EKS Migration & Containerization : Lead the migration from current infrastructure to Amazon EKS, implementing container orchestration and services-ready architecture Multi-Region DR Implementation : Design and implement hot-hot disaster recovery with automated failover, load balancing, and regular testing procedures CI/CD Pipeline Transformation : Modernize deployment pipelines to support faster, more reliable deployments Advanced Observability : Enhance comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and incident response using DataDog, enabling proactive issue detection and resolution Security Framework : Establish enterprise-grade security practices, compliance frameworks, and automation to support Data team's governance requirements Infrastructure-as-Code Evolution : Scale Terraform usage, implement GitOps practices, and create self-service infrastructure capabilities Database Scaling : Address current RDS limitations and implement scalable database architecture What you'll do here: Technical Leadership : Define and execute the long-term infrastructure and security strategy, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security as Boulevard grows Team Building : Lead, mentor, and grow a team of infrastructure and reliability engineers, establishing best practices and fostering a culture of operational excellence Cross-functional Collaboration : Partner closely with Product, Services and Data Engineering teams to provide the infrastructure foundation for their initiatives Architecture & Design : Drive architectural decisions for cloud infrastructure, security systems, and operational practices Operational Excellence : Establish monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices that ensure high availability and performance Compliance Management : Ensure compliance with industry standards (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2) and implement security controls What you'll need to thrive: 10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure and platform engineering, with 5+ years leading infrastructure teams of 5-15 engineers Deep experience with AWS services including EKS, RDS, VPC, IAM, and infrastructure automation using Terraform Proven experience migrating applications to Kubernetes/EKS and implementing container-based architectures Strong background in security practices, compliance frameworks (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2), and security automation Experience transforming CI/CD pipelines, implementing GitOps practices, and enabling rapid software delivery Expertise with monitoring and observability tools (DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana) and implementing comprehensive alerting strategies Proven ability to work with Product Engineering, Data Engineering, and Platform Services teams to enable their technical initiatives How we'll take care of you: At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we’re happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For U.S. based candidates, the anticipated base salary range is $209,500 - $270,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling. In addition to the wonderful people you’ll get to work with and challenging projects that’ll push you - Boulevard is here to make sure you’re always at the top of your game emotionally, mentally, and physically. ✨ We’ve got you covered with a 401(k) match plus dental, medical, vision, and life insurance. Take a break whenever you need with our flexible vacation day policy. Fully remote so you can choose where you want to work. You’ll receive a work from home stipend every month. Family planning resources and specialized support programs. Equity: get ahead on the ground floor and grow with Boulevard. Boulevard Bucks Learning and Development program allows employees to explore businesses in the market we serve. We recommend following our official LinkedIn page to stay up to date on all things Boulevard life! Boulevard Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

items.description: Customer Success Manager - Remote Application Deadline: 30 September 2026 Department: Talent Team Employment Type: Full Time Location: Philippines Reporting To: Andrew Valle Compensation: ₱60,000 - ₱80,000 / month Description Why does this role exist? This is an in-house Magic role — you'll be a Magic employee owning client relationships on behalf of the company, not a VA placed with a client. Magic's business runs on retention and expansion, and the CSM is the engine behind both. Our clients are busy founders and executives who need their remote workers to deliver real ROI — and they need a strategic partner who ensures that happens. You're not here to answer tickets. You're here to protect revenue, grow accounts, and turn satisfied clients into long-term advocates. Your success directly translates to company growth. Every account retained and every expansion closed is a measurable outcome you own. What's In It For You Compensation Salary: ₱60,000–₱80,000 gross monthly Employment type: Permanent, Full-Time Fully remote, global Benefits HMO coverage (after regularization) 12 vacation days + 10 sick days per year 13th month pay SSS, PhilHealth, PAG-IBIG Paid training Growth Path CSM (0–12 months) → Senior CSM (12–24 months) → Team Lead / CS Manager (24–36 months) → CS Director (3+ years) Magic promotes from within — top performers move into leadership, enterprise accounts, and CS strategy What Winning Looks Like You maintain 90%+ gross revenue retention and 110%+ net revenue retention across your full book of business — consistently, not occasionally You spot at-risk accounts before clients say a word, and your save plans are already in motion You run QBRs that clients actually look forward to — data-driven, strategic, and action-oriented You identify expansion opportunities organically and build the business case without being prompted Your HubSpot is always clean — account health scores current, touchpoints logged, zero renewals sneaking up on you Core Responsibilities Strategic Account Management & Revenue Growth (40%) Own a portfolio of accounts segmented by size, health, and growth potential — prioritize ruthlessly Maintain 90% gross revenue retention and drive 110%+ NRR through proactive expansion identification and closure Navigate renewals 60–90 days before expiration; address concerns and negotiate terms before they become problems Facilitate comprehensive QBRs for enterprise and growth accounts with data-driven presentations on value delivered Customer Onboarding & Enablement (25%) Execute Magic's 30-60-90 day onboarding framework for every new client; conduct kickoff calls within 24–48 hours of signing Build tailored success plans with specific milestones and success criteria for each client's business objectives Introduce clients to their remote workers and actively facilitate early relationship-building Relationship Management & Communication (20%) Build trusted advisor relationships with C-suite executives, founders, and senior decision-makers Multi-thread across client organizations to reduce churn risk from champion departure Own escalations end-to-end — intake through resolution — coordinating cross-functionally to deliver results Data, Reporting & Process Improvement (15%) Analyze usage data and behavioral patterns to predict churn risk and expansion potential Prepare monthly portfolio health reports tracking retention rate, NRR, CSAT, NPS, and QBR completion Document playbooks, identify process inefficiencies, and share learnings with the broader CSM team Required Experience What You Bring 3–5 years of B2B customer success or account management experience managing a portfolio of accounts simultaneously Direct ownership of revenue retention and expansion targets, with proven experience from onboarding through renewal US market experience — strong understanding of US business culture, SMB challenges, and executive communication norms HubSpot proficiency (or expert-level Salesforce with transferable skills) used daily for pipeline and health tracking Intermediate to advanced Excel/Google Sheets — pivot tables, VLOOKUP/INDEX MATCH, dashboards, trend analysis Strong English proficiency, written and spoken, at a level sufficient for daily C-level and Director-level client conversations Your Superpowers Strategic Relationship Builder · Proactive Problem Solver · Data-Driven Thinker · Ownership Mentality · Resilient & Adaptable · Cross-Functional Influencer Our Hiring Process Application + Pre-Qualifying Questions → HR Interview (45 min) → 24-Hour Reflection Period → Panel Interview with Senior CSMs → Interview with CS Leadership → Final Interview with Head of Sales & CS → Background Check → Job Offer The Reality This is a US-hours role. Your shift follows Eastern Time (9:00 AM–8:00 PM ET, Monday–Friday), with occasional flexibility for West Coast clients or urgent situations. You'll be running client calls, managing escalations, and tracking account health across a live portfolio — every single day. If you thrive on ownership and outcomes, this is the environment for you. Before You Apply — Quick Gut Check Do you have 3–5 years of B2B customer success or account management experience with direct revenue retention accountability? Is your English strong enough for daily executive-level conversations with U.S.-based C-level and Director clients? Do you approach customer success as a revenue-driving function — not a reactive support role? Do you have a professional home office setup with high-speed internet (50+ Mbps), a headset, and a quiet environment right now? If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. About Magic Magic is a leading modern outsourcing platform that connects SMBs to high-quality remote workers, from SDRs to virtual assistants and more. With roots in Silicon Valley and backing from top venture capitalists, our workers are supercharged with a combination of the latest AI technology and training. We came out of Y Combinator in 2015, have grown to 1,000+ remote workers, and are backed by Sequoia Capital with over $30M in funding.

items.description: Apaleo is the world’s most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. About the role Revenue Operations keeps Apaleo's GTM engine running, and running toward one thing: revenue growth. As our RevOps Engineer, you'll work across the go-to-market org making sure the systems and data behind the funnel are clean, fast, and increasingly AI-native. You'll work directly with our Team Lead RevOps, and while you'll touch nearly every GTM function, growth and pipeline are where your work has the clearest line to revenue. What you'll do Own and maintain our CRM (HubSpot), keeping data clean, pipelines accurate, and workflows humming — the foundation everything AI touches depends on Query our data with AI to answer real business questions (why a metric moved, which accounts look like our best customers) instead of waiting on a dashboard to tell you Build AI agents and automations for repetitive RevOps work — CRM hygiene, lead routing, reporting — using n8n, Claude, and our existing stack When a number moves and the dashboard can't say why, dig into calls, emails, and tickets, using AI to get to the real cause faster Manage our toolstack day to day, including HubSpot, n8n, lemlist, modjo, sales navigator, etc. Document how each automation you build works — inputs, what it touches, when it should hand off to a human — so someone else could pick it up without you in the room Flag issues before they become problems and propose simple, practical fixes proactively, using AI to get there faster Work closely with sales, marketing, customer success, partner management, onboarding, support, BI, finance, and product on cross-functional requests What you bring Proven experience in a RevOps, sales ops, or marketing ops role Solid HubSpot skills, comfortable with workflows, properties, and reporting on funnel and pipeline metrics Genuinely AI-fluent: you use AI tools daily and have built at least one real automation or agent — not just used a chatbot Comfortable digging into messy, unstructured data (calls, emails, tickets) to find an answer a dashboard won't give you Documents your work well enough that someone else could run it without you in the room A structured mindset and a bias for action Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture Genuine interest in how pipeline gets built and converted, not just how data gets cleaned Good communication skills, you'll work closely with GTM leadership Experience with an AI-native growth stack - think Clay for enrichment/agents, n8n or Make for workflow automation, Claude or ChatGPT for building agents, and intent tools like Koala or Clearbit - is a big plus What We Offer Culture & Growth A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech. Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You’ll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact. Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration. Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you’ll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life. Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution. Perks & Lifestyle Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business. Free Public Transport: Travel across Germany with ease using our fully covered Deutschland Ticket . Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events. Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired. Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership. How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role it’s about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

items.description: Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide. Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2 . Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We’re a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees– our employee NPS is in the high 80s. Design at Tremendous We design experiences that make complex systems feel straightforward and intuitive by taking our time to get things right. We favor depth and scale over speed, while raising the bar for quality so our product stays ahead of the competition. We’re a place for designers who care about doing things well. About the role We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to own design for one of our product areas. You'll join a small team of product designers led by our Director of Product Design, and you'll be embedded in a squad with a product manager and several engineers. Half of our product is used by recipients who never chose us, so the experience has to be self-evident. The other half is a powerful dashboard and API used by everyone from mom-and-pop shops to Google. With one designer per squad, you'll have direct ownership of the experiences you ship. What you'll do Craft rational, elegant, and intuitive interfaces. We care about implementation ease as much as we care about pixel-perfection. Own the content. Designers at Tremendous own the product copy in their designs. Strategic influence. Contribute to the team’s vision, planning, and roadmap. Contribute to our design system. Consistency is a big part of usability, especially for a financial platform. We aim to leave the system better than we found it. Document heavily. We're an async, international team. Your Notion docs and Figma files should give anyone clear context, constraints, and options without a meeting. Use AI throughout your workflow. Research, prototyping, and iteration. We expect designers to prototype with AI tools and bring working artifacts to the team. Help raise the bar. Push forward and maintain a high design bar and level of execution. Design for a diverse set of recipients , with accessibility and internationalization in mind. Collaborative design. Work closely with PMs, Engineers, and others. What you'll bring 8+ years of product design experience. Experience at a startup or fast-moving product company. A portfolio demonstrating functional, simple, and delightful user interfaces. Proven experience building and improving design systems. Excellent written communication and copywriting skills. Experience using AI tools in your design workflow, including prototyping (v0, Claude, Cursor, or similar). The ability to handle ambiguity. You're comfortable conducting research and gathering information to make informed decisions on your own. What's cool about the role Ship work you’ll be proud of. Own design for a product area, end-to-end. You'll help scope, drive, and measure your work, pushing forward user and business goals. Become the champion for your users. You'll conduct research and usability tests to gain a deep understanding of problems before designing solutions. Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: $200,000 - $265,000 Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave. Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas. Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook .

items.description: Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand. Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence. About the role: We're looking for a Finance Manager to join our Commercial FP&A team within Strategic Finance. This team member will own a diverse set of recurring deliverables and analyses that keep the business informed. The Commercial FP&A team acts as the analytical engine of the company, providing insights that support optimal business decision-making. This role requires strong commercial finance acumen and a genuine interest in understanding the "why" behind the numbers. You'll support the narrative behind revenue performance for the Senior Leadership Team and Board-level materials, partner with Commercial and Sales Operations teams on GTM reporting, and help maintain the reporting infrastructure that leadership relies on for in-quarter decisions. Responsibilities: Own recurring revenue reporting workflows - daily/weekly file maintenance, revenue trackers, attainment dashboards, and variance analysis - ensuring accuracy and timely delivery at a daily cadence Prepare and update executive materials for KPI reviews, Board of Directors presentations, and SLT meetings, including slide updates, and supporting data files Conduct variance analysis on revenue movements and deliver clear, concise commentary that explains the "what" and the "why" behind performance trends Support quarterly sales target-setting - assembling bottoms-up data, reconciling against tops-down forecasts, and surfacing risks and opportunities for leadership discussion Own the commercial commission review process - synthesizing attainment data, identifying trends, and providing analysis that informs leadership's compensation and incentive decisions Execute ad-hoc analysis for Revenue, GTM, and Commercial leadership to support in-quarter decision-making Maintain and improve core financial reporting infrastructure - identifying opportunities to enhance accuracy, reduce manual effort, and improve consistency across deliverables Partner cross-functionally with Revenue, Sales Operations, and GTM teams to understand business drivers and translate them into financial context Apply a common-sense quality check to all outputs - flagging anomalies, verifying data integrity, and ensuring deliverables are clean and free of error Exercise independent judgment in prioritizing analyses and sequencing deliverables to maximize impact for commercial leadership Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field with 8+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree with 6+ years experience Expert-level Excel and Google Sheets skills - can build, troubleshoot, and maintain complex reporting files independently Strong data analysis capabilities with the ability to work across multiple data sources and reconcile discrepancies Excellent communication skills - can format data clearly for executive audiences and draft concise commentary Experience supporting executive-level reporting (KPI reviews, Board materials, SLT presentations) Ability to ramp quickly on existing processes and deliver reliably with minimal hand-holding Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment Experience in commercial finance / sales finance, preferably in a high-growth or ad tech environment Location: This role is eligible for full-time remote work within British Columbia (Pacific timezone). Travel Expectations: We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building. Compensation: Liftoff offers all employees a full compensation package that includes equity and health/vision/dental benefits associated with your country of residence. Below you will find the On Target Earnings (OTE) for our various locations which includes a 10% bonus paid out quarterly. Canada: CAD 125,000 - 150,000 #LI-NM1 #LI-REMOTE Liftoff offers a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative work environment where employees are empowered to grow and make an impact. We’re shaping the future of the mobile app ecosystem—join us and help accelerate what’s next. Liftoff’s compensation strategy includes competitive salaries, equity, and benefits designed to support employee well-being and performance. We benchmark compensation based on role, level, and location to ensure fairness and market alignment. Benefits may include medical coverage, wellness stipends, and additional perks based on your country of residence. Liftoff is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Agency and Third Party Recruiter Notice: Liftoff does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or Recruiting Team. All candidates must be submitted via our Applicant Tracking System by approved Liftoff vendors who have been expressly requested to make a submission by our Recruiting Team for a specific job opening. No placement fees will be paid to any firm unless such a request has been made by the Liftoff Recruiting Team and such a candidate was submitted to the Liftoff Recruiting Team via our Applicant Tracking System.

items.description: About Trafilea Trafilea is a Consumer Tech Platform for Transformative Brand Growth. We’re building the AI Growth Engine that powers the next generation of consumer brands. With over $1B+ in cumulative revenue, 12M+ customers, and 500+ talents across 19 countries, we combine technology, growth marketing, and operational excellence to scale purpose-driven, digitally native brands. We own and operate our own digitally native brands (not an agency), with presence in Walmart, Nordstrom, and Amazon, and a strong global D2C footprint. Why Trafilea We’re a tech-led eCommerce group scaling our own globally loved DTC brands, while helping ambitious talent grow just as fast. 🚀 We build and scale our own brands. 🦾 We invest in AI and automation like few others in eCom. 📈 We test fast, grow fast, and help you do the same. 🤝 Be part of a dynamic, diverse, and talented global team. 🌍 100% Remote, USD competitive salary, paid time off, and more. Job Responsibilities Partner with business leaders to drive Trafilea 's performance and talent development programs, ensuring managers have the tools, insights, and support to build high-performing teams. You'll own key initiatives such as Performance Reviews, Talent Calibration, Individual Development Plans (IDPs), Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), career pathing, promotions, and succession planning while continuously improving our talent processes. Own and execute the Performance Review cycle from planning to completion. Manage Talent Calibration, IDPs, PIPs, Succession Planning, and Promotion processes. Track talent metrics and deliver dashboards and reports with actionable insights. Partner with leaders and HRBPs to drive talent development and process adoption. Maintain career frameworks, job leveling, and competency documentation. Create and facilitate training, workshops, and learning materials for managers and employees. Identify and implement process improvements using data, AI, and automation tools. Ensure talent programs are delivered accurately, on time, and aligned with business goals. Requirements 3+ years of experience in Performance Management, Talent Management, Learning & Development, Organizational Development, or HRBP roles. Experience managing Performance Reviews, Talent Calibration, IDPs, PIPs, Succession Planning, and Career Development programs. Strong analytical skills with advanced Google Sheets/Excel and dashboard reporting experience. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills to partner effectively with leaders and teams. Advanced English , both written and verbal communication skills. Experience using HRIS, Talent Management, or LMS platforms (e.g., BambooHR, Small Improvements, or similar). Familiarity with AI and automation tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Zapier, n8n, or similar) to improve efficiency and reporting. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: To learn the Hiring Ranges for this position, please select your location from the Apply Now dropdown menu.
items.description: To learn the Hiring Ranges for this position, please select your location from the Apply Now dropdown menu. To learn more about our Hiring Range System, please click this link. Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. About this team and role: In the past few years, Marketing has emerged as a key vector and focus of Firefox’s growth, with Data Science playing an essential role in evaluating Marketing’s impact and developing clear strategies to ensure that success. Marketing Data Science supports Firefox through the standard fare of marketing (ongoing measurement, experimentation/lift testing, adhoc analysis, forecasting/budget optimization), and beyond that as thought leaders at Firefox in translating broad goals into clearly defined objectives and identifying the path towards succeeding in them. In this role, you will continue to build on the Marketing team’s recent successes as Firefox’s Marketing program continues to expand its footprint throughout the funnel. You’ll look to support this success in owning global data strategy for Firefox Marketing, developing new data capabilities to unlock future business growth, collaborating with Data Science counterparts in other domains domains, and working closely across marketing and adjacent cross-functional teams to translate your team’s work into practical recommendations and enablement that drive Firefox’s growth. What you’ll do: Set the strategy and roadmap for Marketing Data Science, prioritizing the highest-impact opportunities with key partners. Establish goals and measurement approaches for attribution, ROI, and campaign performance; deliver insights that improve marketing investment and outcomes. Lead and develop the team’s core capabilities across: Performance marketing: budget optimization, causal lift measurement, and conversion-signal testing Brand marketing: measurement planning and assessment of long-term and lower-funnel impact User insights: retention/LTV modeling and audience segmentation Reporting and infrastructure: build self-service dashboards, deliver ad hoc and executive reporting, and develop scalable data models and internal tools that expand our understanding of the acquisition landscape. Bring a forward-looking perspective on advertising, media innovation, and marketing analytics methods. Partner with Data Science leaders to evaluate and responsibly adopt emerging AI tools that improve team workflows and impact. What you’ll bring: 6+ years of marketing data science experience, ideally at a media agency or in-house marketing organization. Proficiency with marketing analytics tools, including Google Analytics and advertising platforms, and familiarity with modeling methods such as MMM, causal lift/synthetic control, saturation modeling, optimization, and Bayesian approaches. Proven experience leading, mentoring, and developing talent, with strong stakeholder management and the ability to prioritize multiple complex workstreams. Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to tailor data-driven insights and recommendations to different audiences. What you’ll get: Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday One-time home office stipend Annual professional development budget Quarterly well-being stipend Considerable paid parental leave Employee referral bonus program Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) About Mozilla Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla , you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online. Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at to request accommodation. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose. items.title: Senior Affiliate Marketing Manager
items.summary: At Bondora, our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone.
items.description: At Bondora , our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone. Founded in 2008, we’ve helped more than 700,000 customers across Europe borrow and invest effortlessly through our trusted digital products. As a rapidly growing financial technology company, we’re reaching new heights with a bold vision. We’re set to acquire a banking license, unlocking a world of possibilities for our customers. This transition will allow us to expand our lending across more EU countries and broaden our product suite to deliver even more value. Join us on this journey and let’s build the future of finance together! What is this role about? 🚀 As a Senior Affiliate Marketing Manager at Bondora , you'll take ownership of the affiliate marketing channel for Go & Grow, managing and growing the partnerships that bring new investors to the platform. You'll work with content creators, publishers, comparison sites, communities, and affiliate networks across Europe, while building a strong pipeline of new partners. This is a highly autonomous, hands-on role where you'll combine partner management with business development — strengthening existing relationships, sourcing and onboarding new affiliates, negotiating commercial agreements, and using data and AI to continuously improve partner performance. You'll work closely with Product, Data, Engineering, Brand, CRM, Legal, and Compliance to optimise the full journey from first click to long-term investor value. You'll have the opportunity to own and shape one of Go & Grow's key growth channels , with direct access to senior leadership and significant freedom to improve how the affiliate programme operates and scales. Your main responsibilities 🎯 Own and Execute the affiliate marketing channel strategy, operating plan, forecast and performance. Source, qualify and close direct partnerships with affiliates (in other words publishers: content creators, comparison sites, communities and relevant affiliate networks). Create clear segmentation, outreach, onboarding and activation routines that move partners from prospect to live Design and negotiate CPA, CPL, fixed-fee and hybrid deals Define and improve the funnel from click and sign-up through funded investor, first 30-day deposits, repeat deposits and 30/60/90-day retained value. Operate and improve Target Circle/Circlewise Build partner- and cohort-level reporting covering acquisition cost, revenue (deposits) value, retention, net revenue (net deposits) Test placements, content, landing pages, incentives, creative and localized messaging with Brand, CRM, Product and Design. Apply country-specific financial-promotion rules, execute approval workflows, required disclosures, content monitoring and documentation together with Legal and Compliance. What would ensure success in this role?💪 Expert in at least one partner management platform (Affiliate platforms such as Target Circle/Circlewise, Impact, Awin or Partnerize, CJ Advanced Excel or Google Sheets and BI dashboard experience AI fluency: Comfortable using AI tools for data analysis, partner research and qualification, and content/compliance review, with strong judgment on when human verification is essential. Fluent in English and German is a plus What can you expect at Bondora ? 🎯 Be part of Bondora ’s ambitious journey toward 1BN in revenue - your work will have a real impact. 💰 Enjoy a competitive salary and amazing benefits: 5 weeks of vacation, private healthcare compensation, hobby grant, mental health support, share options, and much more! 📈 Work in an environment that encourages growth and innovation - with resources and budget for continuous learning. The next steps If you have the guts, ideas, and a team vision, apply now! Our hiring process: 1️⃣ Meet Anna , our Recruiter — your first chat to share your story and ambitions. 2️⃣ Meet Krzysztof Schmidt , CMO at Go&Grow 3️⃣ Tackle a home task to showcase your skills. 4️⃣ Complete our personality and logic assessments via Alva Labs. 5️⃣ Meeting Pärtel Tomberg , CEO of Bondora 6️⃣ Chat with Olga Kikas , our Chief of People 7️⃣ 🎉 If the stars align — welcome to Bondora ! Join our team of Bondorians, and let's make it happen! If you'd like to read how Bondora collects, uses, and protects your personal data during recruitment, please see HERE. And finally: zero ego, we’re a team of builders who work hard, stay humble, and support each other. Extra Experience in management consulting, sales engineering, or post-sales technical support. items.title: Senior Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst
items.summary: About DutchieFounded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis.
items.description: About Dutchie Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis. Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue. Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups. Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors. About This Role Dutchie is looking for a Senior Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst to help drive the financial operating rhythm of the company. You’ll partner across Finance, Accounting, and business leaders to build forecasts, evaluate performance, improve planning processes, and deliver insights that influence executive decision-making. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building scalable financial infrastructure, automating manual work, and using data to tell compelling business stories. You’ll report to the Senior Director of FP&A while helping establish the next generation of planning capabilities across Dutchie . What You’ll Do Financial Planning & Forecasting Own portions of the annual operating plan, quarterly forecasts, and long-range financial planning process. Develop financial models that improve visibility into company performance and future investment decisions. Analyze monthly results, identify business drivers, and communicate actionable insights to leadership. Partner closely with Accounting to ensure accurate reporting and alignment between actuals, forecasts, and KPIs. Operational Excellence Improve and automate planning workflows using AI, modern financial tooling, and scalable processes. items.description: Shape the Future on Autopilot At Autopilot , you won’t just design screens – you’ll design how fintech works. As a Product Designer , you’ll own product experiences end-to-end and help redefine what great UX means in a complex, data-driven industry. We’re building a high-performance, AI-native Fintech Operating System designed to optimize cost and revenue for digital businesses. Join us on a multi-year mission to build smarter infrastructure for commerce. Why Join Us? You’ll help build an ambitious product from the ground up, with a team that values speed, craft, and autonomy. If you’re ready to make an outsized impact in fintech, we’d love to meet you. About the Role You'll join a fast-moving team building modern, data-intensive web applications that help digital businesses operate more intelligently. This is a founding design role with strong emphasis on product logic, systems thinking, and end-to-end collaboration with engineers. 🛠️ What You'll Do Translate complex financial logic and backend systems into intuitive user flows Design dashboards, workflows, and visual systems for payments, orchestration, and automation Build and maintain our scalable design system in Figma (aligned with React components) Collaborate with engineers on real-world UX states — success, failure, pending, retry Prototype and validate features with real data and user context Participate in product discussions, shaping user journeys before pixels are drawn Uphold usability and domain accuracy as the standard for design quality 🎯 What We're Looking For 5+ years of experience designing digital products with complex logic (fintech, B2B SaaS, or data-heavy systems preferred) Strong product and systems thinking — you design for states and workflows , not just screens Deep Figma expertise (Auto Layout, Variants, Tokens, Components) Ability to translate backend logic, APIs, and data models into coherent user experiences Excellent communication and documentation skills (Linear, Figma, Slack) Comfortable working directly with engineers and iterating quickly without handoffs 🌟 Bonus Points Experience in fintech, payments, or compliance-related products Exposure to analytics or developer tooling Understanding of design-to-code workflows (React component parity, tokens) Strong interaction or motion design craft (Framer, ProtoPie, etc.) Our Hiring Process We focus on real-world collaboration, not design showreels. Here’s what to expect: Apply with LinkedIn Profile And Resume We’ll review based on the requirements above. If shortlisted, you’ll receive an email to schedule a 90-minute live design collaboration session once you’re comfortable with our pre-interview brief. 90-Minute Live Design Collaboration You’ll work with our product and engineering team on a small feature challenge — from user problem to Figma prototype. We’ll look at: How you think through logic and flows How you translate constraints into UX decisions Your interaction, hierarchy, and state management How you communicate trade-offs and rationale The session mirrors our actual workflow: accessible pragmatic collaborative Design Review & Feedback After the session, we’ll walk through your design decisions together. You’ll get feedback from our CTO and team, and discuss potential improvements or extensions to your solution. Culture & Alignment Chat A final call with CEO to discuss your long-term goals, how you work best, and whether Autopilot is the right fit for both sides. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Sr. Financial Analyst
items.summary: ABOUT RENEW CAPITALRenew Capital is a pan-Africa investment firm with a presence in 13 countries.
items.description: ABOUT RENEW CAPITAL Renew Capital is a pan-Africa investment firm with a presence in 13 countries. We back the bold founders using technology to pursue Africa’s greatest opportunities. With more than a decade of investing on the continent, Renew Capital is among the most active investors building Africa’s thriving private sector. Renew Capital is powered by a team of investment, finance, legal, advisory and market development professionals. Our bench includes seasoned investors, analysts, operators and ecosystem experts with deep experience scaling businesses across Africa. ROLE SUMMARY The sr. financial analyst plays a critical role in evaluating, supporting and scaling high-potential ventures across Africa. This role sits at the core of Renew Capital ’s investment process, supporting sourcing, due diligence, investment decision-making and portfolio value creation. The sr. financial analyst will work closely with investment managers, portfolio company CFOs and senior leadership, building rigorous financial models and translating complex data into clear insights that inform investment decisions. Responsibilities: The sr. financial analyst’s responsibilities are focused on three core areas: 1. Investment Analysis & Due Diligence Prepare and maintain robust financial models for pipeline and prospective investment opportunities. Analyze historical financial data, forecasts and assumptions to assess risk, return, and scalability. Evaluate capital expenditures, depreciation schedules, and capital structuring scenarios. Conduct market sizing, competitive analysis and primary and secondary research to support investment theses. Support financial and commercial due diligence processes from initial screening through investment committee review. 2. Portfolio Support & Monitoring Work directly with portfolio company finance teams on budgeting, 13-week rolling cash flow forecasts, and financial controls. Monitor portfolio company performance, identify trends, calculate key ratios, and flag risks or opportunities early. Build and maintain strong working relationships with portfolio CFOs and founders. 3. Communication & Insight Generation Translate complex analysis into clear, decision-ready materials for investment managers, leadership and the investment committee. Prepare presentations, memos and dashboards that communicate insights concisely. Collaborate with a diverse, distributed investment team across Africa using digital tools. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business or a related field; MBA or Master’s in Finance preferred. 6–8+ years of progressive experience in financial analysis, investment analysis, private equity, venture capital, investment banking or corporate finance, with exposure to growth-stage companies. Advanced financial modeling expertise, including integrated three-statement models, valuation, scenario and sensitivity analysis and capital structuring. Strong experience supporting or leading financial and commercial due diligence processes. Proven ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear, decision-ready insights for senior leadership and investment committees. Excellent Excel and financial analysis skills, with experience working with large, complex data sets. Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with investment teams, portfolio company CFOs and founders across diverse markets. CFA or other recognized investment or financial modeling credentials preferred. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS As Renew Capital continues to expand its investment activity across Africa, strong financial analysis is essential to deploying capital responsibly and supporting portfolio companies through growth and complexity. This role provides exposure to venture investing across multiple sectors and markets, with the opportunity to influence real investment outcomes. Location and Travel Opportunities: This is a remote role; however, candidates must be based in Côte d'Ivoire. About Renew Capital : We invite you to learn more about Renew Capital by visiting our website:. Application Process: Renew Capital invites qualified applicants to fill out the application form on our website here. Renew Capital is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran or disability status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Further, Renew Capital supports gender-based pay equity and is committed to compensating women and men equally, for equal work. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: About Discovered LabsDiscovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher and a demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR.
items.description: About Discovered Labs Discovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher and a demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR. We’re trusted by hyper-growth companies like Instantly, Granola, incident and other $10M+ ARR B2B SaaS companies who want more leads and customers from both Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT. We do this through a mixture of content marketing, technical optimisations and off-site brand amplification (PR, backlinks, Reddit marketing). View recent case studies at . High-level, our approach rests on three things: AI automation and workflows. We build marketing programs the way you’d build a product. Rather than burn hours a week on repetitive tasks, our in-house team of ML engineers builds workflows with custom tooling so we can focus on the high-impact work. Senior expertise. Everything is managed and elevated by a team of experts, so it’s done to a high standard and differentiated. We don’t let automation get in the way of quality. Full-stack. SEO and AEO rarely work as isolated tasks. We work across the entire funnel and multiple surfaces so we own the outcome and clients win. If you want to stand out, include a Loom showing a tool, system or deliverable you’ve built and are proud of. We’d love to see it. This role You analyse the data, work out why performance is moving and turn the result into a report the client can act on. You implement the fixes and improvements yourself with our internal tooling. “DS who owns data → analysis → decision → implementation end to end” Concretely, that means you: Analyse the data behind reports, strategy questions, client queries, technical issues and SWOTs — reconciling messy, incomplete sources into a clear picture of what's actually happening. QA via analysis - Is the rationale sound? Does the logic hold? Where's the unsupported claim? Run experiments. Design a falsifiable test, run it, and know when a result is noise rather than signal. Tie every finding to the client's business. You get to "so what, and why does this matter to their revenue," not just "here's what the data says." Own the report. Hand the client and the account strategist a decision-ready read the data, the diagnosis and the “so what?” never a raw data dump. Optimise for answer engines (AEO). Make client content the source LLMs and Google AI Overviews cite, using our internal methodology and tools, as one surface among many. Execute, not just recommend. You implement the findings yourself with our internal tooling. The analysis only counts once it's shipped. Improve the tactics and the systems. Turn a one-off finding into a repeatable process, and keep sharpening the tooling and methodology behind how the system works. Communicate it cleanly to clients , in writing and on calls, so your output needs no translation. This role is fully remote. Ideally your working hours overlap the GMT business day (we’re flexible within roughly ±4 hours). This is not for you if: You need heavy management, or you wait for perfect instructions before acting. If you spot a broken process, we expect you to fix it. Produce genius insights but don’t ship them. Insight with no execution is exactly the failure mode we screen for. The analyst who gets on the tools is the one we want. Lack experience and/or willingness to use advanced AI workflows. Prefer to spend weeks performing audits before implementation. B2B SaaS clients expect results fast and everything needs to tie to commercial impact. Not comfortable with data and analytics. We want someone who can diagnose the why behind performance and back it with evidence. What’s in it for you Benefits $30,000 -$50,000 annual salary depending on relevant skills and experience Fully remote position. (Ideally flexible within roughly ±4 hours GMT ) Room to grow. We’re small but growing, which means real opportunity, including a senior track with no people management required. Paid leave and autonomy to perform your role. The best in-house SEO/AEO tools i.e. ML/AI and data science tooling , built by top engineers, at your disposal. How you’ll spend your time A rough split; it flexes month to month with what each account needs. 40% — Implementing and shipping. Producing and shipping the week’s work across your accounts: technical fixes, on-page, content refreshes, internal linking, off-page and AEO, all verified at source before it goes out. 30% — Analysing, diagnosing and measuring. Getting into the numbers to understand cause and effect, designing and running experiments, and measuring what actually moved after a change. 15% — Reporting and client communication. Owning the client-facing report, being present on calls to walk through the diagnosis, staying close in day-to-day client Slack, and giving the account owner the read behind the story they lead. 15% — Building and evolving the methodology. Sharpening your own skills as search and AI assistants keep changing, and constantly improving the tooling, templates and process behind how the team works. Requirements This role owns the full loop end to end, analyse → explain → implement → report. You don't hand off execution: you analyse it, you build it, you ship it. High agency and a builder's instinct are the two traits we weight above everything, including domain knowledge. High agency covers execution and tempo; builder covers coding, AI workflows, and evolving the methodology. Strong analytical and quantitative background: you reconcile messy, incomplete data (GSC exports, rank trackers, partial client analytics not clean warehouse tables), design falsifiable experiments, and reason to a root cause with evidence, never inventing a cause where the data is silent. Demonstrated evidence of shipping a time your analysis changed what a business did, and you implemented at least part of it yourself. Insight without execution is exactly the wrong fit for this seat. You're AI-native and have built something with it: a side project, agent, scraper, or internal tool. You use AI tools daily as a workflow multiplier (briefs, clustering, audit summarisation, scraping) and still own the final, validated output. You build workflows, not just prompts and we take portfolio over claims. Experiment design and statistical rigour : you design a test, run it, and know when a result is noise. Systems thinking: you improve the tactic and improve the system colonbehind it, turning a one-off finding into a repeatable process. Commercial curiosity: you get to "so what?" unprompted, asking about the client's business model and KPIs, and land every finding as a business consequence revenue, pipeline, or cost not just a metric movement. Strong written and verbal English , with the ability to convey findings cleanly to non-technical stakeholders. Reports and QA rationale go straight to clients; the analysis only counts once a client understands it and acts on it. Nice-to-haves (not required) Experience with SEO/analytics tooling (GSC, GA4, Ahrefs, a crawler such as Screaming Frog). If you don’t have it, we’ll ramp you this is teachable. Client-facing experience, and commercial awareness. Familiarity with B2B SaaS. Culture fit You should ideally believe: Search has fundamentally changed. Google and backlinks still matter but are no longer the full picture — AI search is a new frontier and you’re excited about the shift. AI is a force multiplier, not a crutch. You’re actively using AI daily and building workflows, not just typing into a chat box. Speed and quality are both achievable. Everyone here operates at a fast pace, is reliable and takes extreme ownership. There are no passengers at Discovered Labs. You’ll thrive here if: you get energy from excellent work that makes clients successful, you see gaps in processes and fix them without being asked, and you move fast while proactively communicating. You won’t thrive here if: you need heavy management, you wait for perfect instructions, or you think SEO is still just about keywords and links. We look forward to seeing your application. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/ We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget. You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product. The salary for this position is €83,000 annually. You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4. The Role As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes. You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high. Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment. Your main responsibilities will be: Ownership and delivery Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop. Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment. Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself. Craft and quality across the stack Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly. Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder. Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small. Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it. Working with product and design Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one. Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff. Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build. Raising the bar Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better. Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well. Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice. AI as core leverage Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too. About You You will thrive in this role if you: Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them. Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary. Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications. Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast. Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on. Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something. Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation. Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing. Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama. Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't. Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters. Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow. Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included. Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan. Nice to have: Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly. Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products. Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines. This Role Is NOT A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit. A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution. A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you. A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your tests, or own your performance regressions. A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why. A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work. The Team We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results. What's Happening at Toggl Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl 2.0 . One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people. Benefits Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results 24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays Unlimited sick leave In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered) 4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure) Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years €2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure €3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home €4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences €2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair) To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack
