items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Canada URL: https://designfiles.co/ About the job: We're looking for a highly organized Content Marketing Coordinator to join our team on a remote contract basis. This role is ideal for someone who loves turning ideas into finished marketing campaigns. You'll write content, coordinate creative assets, keep projects moving, and make sure every email, social post, landing page, and product announcement is polished before it reaches our audience. We're not looking for flashy marketing copy. We're looking for someone who can communicate like a real human, who can write the way you'd talk to a designer over coffee: helpful, clear, and genuinely useful. If you're someone who notices the small details, enjoys keeping projects organized, and gets satisfaction from shipping great work, we'd love to hear from you. What you’ll help with: You'll work closely with our marketing and product teams to help bring campaigns to life by: Writing and editing marketing emails, newsletters, social posts, ads, landing pages, product updates, and promotional copy Turning campaign ideas, product launches, and feature updates into clear action plans, timelines, and deliverables Coordinating with designers to create graphics, creative assets, and revisions Gathering screenshots, product details, customer examples, links, and supporting materials needed for marketing projects Scheduling and publishing emails, social content, and other marketing updates Helping execute product launches, webinars, contests, promotions, and campaigns Reviewing marketing assets before they go live to ensure quality and accuracy Keeping marketing calendars, task lists, and project documentation organized and up to date Following up with team members to keep projects moving and deadlines on track What you’ll need: Excellent writing and editing skills Able to write marketing that feels like a helpful one-on-one conversation, not generic sales copy Strong understanding of audience, tone, and clear communication Exceptional organization and attention to detail (this is one of the most important parts of the role) Comfortable managing multiple projects at once without losing track of details Reliable follow-through and a bias toward getting things done Experience with email marketing, social media, content marketing, or campaign execution Bonus points: Experience working with SaaS companies Experience in the interior design industry or another creative field About us: DesignFiles is an all-in-one business platform built specifically for interior designers. Thousands of designers use DesignFiles to manage projects, collaborate with clients, create presentations, source products, and run more profitable businesses. Everything we create is designed to make designers' lives easier, and our marketing reflects that. We focus on education, practical advice, and helping designers succeed—not pushy sales tactics. Apply for the job: Love writing clear, helpful content and keeping marketing projects moving? Join DesignFiles as a remote Content Marketing Coordinator. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/designfiles-content-marketing-coordinator

We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote, United States Director of Production Engineering Remote, United States About this Position Are you passionate about building the reliability, automation, and security foundations that let engineering teams move fast with confidence? At Legion, we are seeking a Director of Engineering, DevOps & SRE to lead the teams responsible for the availability, scalability, and security of our production environment. Our production infrastructure runs on AWS, leveraging services such as EKS, RDS, and a broad set of AWS-native technologies. You will partner closely with engineering and IT to build resilient systems, drive operational excellence, and ensure our platform meets the highest standards of security and compliance. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll spend ~20-30% of your time contributing directly to architecture, tooling, and incident response, and the rest driving vision, roadmap, and cross-team execution. Responsibilities Hire and build a globally-distributed DevOps/SRE engineering team. Recruit, mentor, and manage engineers, and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Own the reliability and infrastructure roadmap for our AWS-based production environment, including EKS, RDS, and related AWS services, ensuring scalability, high availability, and cost efficiency. Lead the organization's security operations (SecOps) practice, including vulnerability management, threat detection, incident response, and remediation, to proactively identify and resolve security issues before they impact customers. Define and drive engineering OKRs for infrastructure reliability, automation, and security, and track progress against measurable outcomes. Champion observability and alerting best practices (e.g., Datadog), including automating alert triage and response to reduce mean-time-to-resolution. Solid understanding of agentic AI infrastructure and how AI agentic workflows apply to SDLC and DevOps processes (e.g., automated investigation, remediation, and PR-generation pipelines). Drive Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, and automation practices to increase engineering velocity and reduce operational toil. Work closely with engineering and IT teams to align on infrastructure standards, access controls, tooling, and compliance requirements across the organization. Ensure the platform meets the highest standards of security, compliance, and data protection; implement and maintain robust security controls and audit-readiness. Lead and participate in the Incident Management on-call rotation, working with SRE and development teams to meet and exceed availability goals. Stay current on cloud, DevOps, and security best practices, and provide technical guidance and thought leadership to the broader engineering organization. Required Qualifications 8-12 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or production infrastructure roles, including people management experience. Deep hands-on experience running production workloads on AWS, including EKS (Kubernetes), RDS, and other core AWS services (e.g., VPC, IAM, Lambda, S3). Demonstrated experience running security operations (SecOps) — vulnerability management, incident response, and remediation of production security issues. 5+ years of experience leveraging observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana) to drive reliability, performance, and alerting improvements. Strong experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) and CI/CD automation. Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, or Bash, with day-to-day use of Git and test automation pipelines. Hands-on experience operating Linux/Unix production platforms (Amazon Linux, Ubuntu, RHEL/CentOS). Proven track record partnering cross-functionally with engineering and IT teams to align on infrastructure, tooling, and security standards. Demonstrated experience leading incident management and on-call practices for high-availability production systems. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field required; Master's degree preferred. Preferred Qualifications Experience with major cloud providers beyond AWS, such as Google Cloud Platform or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Relevant security certifications (e.g., CISSP, AWS Security Specialty, CKS). Experience with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA. 3+ years of experience with Kubernetes or other containerization/orchestration platforms at scale. Experience with Kubernetes-native delivery tooling, including Argo Workflows and Helm. 5+ years of experience leading teams in an agile/scrum environment. Experience building or scaling automated investigation and remediation pipelines for production error classes. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Salary Range: Base Salary Range $220,000 - $265,000 + Bonus + Stock Equity At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. Our posted salary range is done so in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers that allow employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and the internal equity for the same position within the company. Benefits include, but are not limited to: $0 monthly premium and other flexible medical, dental, and vision plans effective on the first day of employment 401k plan Discretionary Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays Parental Leave Equity Monthly Wellness Reimbursement Monthly Lunch on Legion ABOUT LEGION Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love. If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling. BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones. For more information, visit https://legion.co EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws. How We Determine What We Pay As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. items.title: STAQ Director
items.summary: At EQT, you won't just do a job—you'll help shape our future.
items.description: At EQT, you won't just do a job—you'll help shape our future. Through Transparent Leadership, you'll work alongside leaders who value collaboration and ensure every voice is heard. Through Connected Impact, you'll see how your work influences critical business decisions and drives value across our operations. Through Supported Growth, you'll have opportunities to expand your skills through cross-functional collaboration, development opportunities, and career advancement. Join our Qrew! Position Objective The Director, STAQ leads the team responsible for EQT’s Special Project Case (SPC) pipeline — the “Innovation Engine” that turns business ideas into delivered technology and process improvements. The role owns intake, prioritization, scoping, solution-architecture governance, and value realization across a portfolio that serves every EQT business department. The ideal candidate is a delivery-minded leader who is comfortable with technical projects and oil & gas business applications, sets clear priorities against finite capacity, and builds a high-performing team and a culture of continuous improvement. Essential Duties Strategy & portfolio: Develop and maintain the STAQ strategy — project prioritization frameworks, value-realization tracking, and portfolio management — so EQT focuses on its highest-value initiatives. Pipeline ownership: Own the SPC pipeline end to end — intake, triage, scoping, prioritization, development hand-off to IT delivery teams, documentation, and post-implementation lookback. Cross-functional governance: Lead recurring cross-functional Special Project Reviews with business departments and internal team standups and architecture-collaboration sessions to align priorities and unblock delivery. Architecture & quality: Govern solution architecture and data-quality standards so the pipeline stays reliable, fast, supported, valuable, and clean (the Innovation Engine scorecard). People leadership: Lead, coach, and develop the STAQ team (Business Process Operations Manager and Business Process Engineers); foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement. Budget & capacity: Develop and manage the STAQ budget and capacity plan; balance incoming demand against the standing backlog and available staffing. Stakeholder alignment: Communicate with executive and cross-functional stakeholders to align department portfolios, delivery priorities, and enterprise strategy; steward STAQ’s knowledge base and operating standards. Continuous improvement: Research and evaluate emerging technologies (automation, analytics) for business applicability and pursue continuous improvement of the pipeline and its supporting infrastructure. Minimum Qualifications 8+ years of combined experience in technology delivery, business operations, and/or process improvement, including team leadership Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical or quantitative field (e.g., Engineering, Computer/Data Science, Information Systems, or Business). An engineering degree is beneficial but not required. Experience delivering technology programs or products from inception through delivery to post-launch. Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, define project scope, and translate business needs into technical solutions. Demonstrated understanding of data structures, analytics, and solution architecture (conceptual fluency required; hands-on engineering not required). Proven ability to coordinate, organize, lead, and develop teams, and to manage competing priorities across many stakeholders. Comfort working on technical projects and with oil & gas business applications, with a strong understanding of how the business works. Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing or leading Salesforce-based business processes and custom solutions. Experience with data tools, pipelines, and analytics platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks). Engineering and/or operational experience in the oil & gas industry (beneficial, not required). Experience leading a portfolio, delivery, or business-process function. Familiarity with EQT’s “Way We Work” operating model (Programs, Utilities, Insights, Sessions, and Knowledge). Selected incumbent will be placed into the position that best suits their abilities and experience level. EQT Corporation and its subsidiaries is an Equal Opportunity Employer -- Disabilities/Veterans. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Track & Trace Coordinator (#2)
items.summary: Zelh is seeking a dependable, detail-oriented Track & Trace Coordinator to support our freight brokerage operations.
items.description: Zelh is seeking a dependable, detail-oriented Track & Trace Coordinator to support our freight brokerage operations. This position is responsible for monitoring active shipments from pickup through final delivery, maintaining accurate load information, communicating with carriers and drivers, and quickly identifying potential service issues. The Track & Trace Coordinator plays an important role in providing excellent customer service by ensuring our team always knows where each shipment is and whether it is operating according to schedule. This is a fast-paced position requiring strong communication, organization, follow-through, and the ability to manage multiple shipments simultaneously. Key Responsibilities •Monitor active shipments from dispatch through final delivery. •Contact carriers and drivers to obtain accurate pickup, transit, and delivery updates. •Confirm drivers are on schedule for pickup and delivery appointments. •Verify arrival and departure times at shippers and receivers. •Update shipment status, notes, ETA information, and appointment details in the TMS. •Identify late trucks, missed appointments, breakdowns, detention, rejected product, temperature issues, and other potential service failures. •Immediately escalate significant service issues to the appropriate operations or sales team member. •Proactively communicate delays rather than waiting for customers or internal team members to discover an issue. •Maintain consistent communication with carriers until problems are resolved. •Obtain and upload Bills of Lading, Proofs of Delivery, lumper receipts, and other required shipment documentation. •Assist with scheduling and confirming pickup and delivery appointments as needed. •Ensure completed loads contain the information and documentation necessary for billing. •Maintain clear, professional, and accurate notes so another team member can quickly understand the status of any shipment. •Assist Customer Sales and Carrier Sales representatives with operational support as needed. Working conditions: Work schedule: T&T #2 Wednesday–Thursday: 11 PM–7 AM CST Friday: 7 PM–3 AM CST Saturday–Sunday: 3:30 PM–11:30 PM CST Monday & Tuesday: Days off 1-hour unpaid lunch break during each shift Competitive Salary in USD Remote mode of work 10+ business days of paid time off Team building and corporate events Equipment provided A supportive team Requirements Extremely dependable with strong follow-through. Detail-oriented and organized. Comfortable making frequent phone calls, sending emails, and communicating by text. Able to manage a high volume of shipments without losing track of details. Strong sense of urgency when something is going wrong. Able to recognize potential problems before they become customer service failures. Comfortable working independently and making decisions within established procedures. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Able to remain professional when dealing with frustrated drivers, carriers, customers, or facilities. Experience in freight brokerage, trucking, transportation, dispatch, or logistics is preferred but not required. Experience with a Transportation Management System (TMS) is preferred. What Success Looks Like A successful Track & Trace Coordinator doesn't simply enter updates into the system. They own shipment visibility. Originally posted on Himalayas

Este profissional será responsável por liderar a gestão de demandas, incidentes e melhorias sistêmicas, assegurando rápida resposta às necessidades do negócio, além de atuar na condução de projetos estratégicos de transformação e automação de processos financeiros. Principais Responsabilidades Sustentação de Sistemas Financeiros Atuar como responsável funcional pelos sistemas de finanças, garantindo sua operação contínua e aderência às necessidades do negócio. Conduzir análises de causa raiz e coordenar planos de ação para mitigação de recorrências. Atuar como principal ponto de contato entre as áreas de negócio e as equipes de TI para temas relacionados à sustentação. Avaliar impactos de mudanças sistêmicas nos processos financeiros e operacionais. Realizar acompanhamento contínuo da saúde dos sistemas, identificando riscos e oportunidades de melhoria. Gestão de Relacionamento com o Negócio Manter relacionamento próximo e constante com as áreas de Finanças. Conduzir reuniões recorrentes de alinhamento, priorização e acompanhamento das demandas. Levantar requisitos, mapear processos e traduzir necessidades de negócio para equipes técnicas. Garantir comunicação clara e permanente entre stakeholders, usuários-chave e times de tecnologia. Gestão de Projetos Liderar projetos de evolução sistêmica, automação e transformação digital para as áreas financeiras. Coordenar atividades desde a definição do escopo até implantação em produção. Elaborar cronogramas, planos de ação, análise de riscos e acompanhamento de entregas. Conduzir cerimônias de projeto e reuniões executivas de status. Apoiar processos de testes, homologação, treinamento e gestão da mudança. Gestão de Backlog e Priorização Manter backlog de melhorias e demandas atualizado e priorizado. Definir critérios de priorização considerando impacto financeiro, riscos regulatórios, experiência do usuário e valor para o negócio. Trabalhar junto às equipes de desenvolvimento para refinamento de requisitos e acompanhamento das entregas. Qualifications Conhecimento dos principais processos financeiros, incluindo: Contratação e Faturamento (Billing) Contas a Receber (Accounts Receivable) Revenue Recognition Cobrança e aplicações de recebimentos Controles financeiros e contábeis Inglês avançado obrigatório Sistemas e Ferramentas Gestão de backlog (Jira, Azure DevOps ou similares) Ferramentas de documentação (Confluence ou similares) Power BI e IA (desejável) Experiência com ERP, sistemas financeiros e integrações Metodologias Agile / Scrum Kanban Gestão de Projetos Competências Comportamentais Comunicação clara e objetiva Forte capacidade de priorização Senso de urgência Organização e gestão simultânea de múltiplas demandas Perfil colaborativo e orientado ao cliente interno Capacidade de negociação com stakeholders Visão de processos e resolução de problemas Facilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e com constante mudança de prioridades Diferenciais Experiência prévia em áreas de Finance Systems, Finance Transformation ou Product Ownership em Finanças. Conhecimento de processos O2C, P2P e R2R. Experiência em sustentação de aplicações corporativas críticas. Participação em projetos de implementação ou transformação de sistemas financeiros. items.title: Lead Creative Strategist (Performance Marketing)
items.summary: Superside is hiring a Creative Strategist, Performance Marketing to lead the strategic thinking behind our clients' highest-volume, highest-velocity creative programs. You'll sit at the intersection of data and creative, turning performance signals from paid social, OOH, and programmatic campaigns into sharp, testable creative direction — while acting as a trusted strategic partner to the clients whose business results depend on it. You'll run strategy across a portfolio of accounts at once, each producing a high volume of creative every month, and you'll be the person both the client and the creative team turn to when they need to know not just what to make next, but why.

items.title: Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst
items.summary: Position Type : Full-time Location: Philippines (Remote) Schedule: Mon-Fri, EST About the Company Our client is a global leader in swimming pool technology, specializing in robotic pool cleaners, pool safety products, water treatment solutions, and related pool equipment for residential and commercial customers. With a strong international presence and a network of distributors, subsidiaries, and partners across multiple markets, our client serves customers worldwide through a variety of sales and distribution channels. About the Role Our client is looking for a Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst to monitor online marketplaces and digital channels across North America and Europe. The role focuses on identifying unauthorized sellers, marketplace and distribution violations, misuse of brand assets, and other compliance issues. You will conduct online research, analyze seller and product data, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports that provide actionable insights to the business. Responsibilities Monitor Amazon, eBay, Walmart, BestBuy, Home Depot, AliExpress, Temu, and other major marketplaces. Research products and identify new or unauthorized sellers. Classify sellers and verify their authorization status. Identify MAP, distribution, territory, and marketplace compliance issues. Monitor unauthorized use of logos, images, trademarks, and product content. Collect evidence such as URLs, screenshots, seller information, and product details. Maintain accurate seller databases and internal records. Prepare daily reports and monthly Voice of Consumer reports. Build and maintain dashboards tracking brand-protection metrics. Identify opportunities to improve research and reporting processes. Competencies and Qualifications Must-Have 3+ years of experience in data analysis, online research, e-commerce, compliance, or a related field. Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables. Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy. Strong written English and reporting skills. Ability to work independently and follow SOPs. Familiarity with Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces. Nice-to-Have Brand protection or marketplace compliance experience. Experience with PROWL, Helium 10, Salesforce, or similar tools. Knowledge of MAP, distribution, or channel compliance. Experience with dashboards and reporting. Experience using AI research and translation tools. Key Qualities Detail-oriented Analytical Investigative Highly organized What We Offer 100% Remote Work â Work from anywhere in the Philippines. Career Growth Opportunities â Gain hands-on experience, and continuous learning. Collaborative & Innovative Team â Work alongside skilled professionals who value excellence. Application Process We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and weâre here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible. The interview process includes a Recruiter Interview, Client Interview, and Assessment. As part of the process, candidates complete a hands-on task during the technical interview. Throughout each stage, we keep you informed and provide feedback as quickly as possible, ensuring you feel valued and supported throughout your journey with us. items.summary: Overview of the role: We’re on a mission to modernize insurance, making it simpler, more accessible, and customer-first. The insurance industry is a $1T market that has remained largely untouched by the digital revolution, and PolicyMe is here changing that. As a remote-first, Toronto-based startup with big ambitions, we’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner…
items.description: Overview of the role: We’re on a mission to modernize insurance, making it simpler, more accessible, and customer-first. The insurance industry is a $1T market that has remained largely untouched by the digital revolution, and PolicyMe is here changing that. As a remote-first, Toronto-based startup with big ambitions, we’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner to help us build the future of insurance in Canada and beyond. Joining a small, collaborative People & Culture team, you’ll combine hands-on recruiting with creativity, problem-solving, and continuous improvement while partnering with leaders across the organization. You’ll hire exceptional people to PolicyMe through innovative sourcing strategies, meaningful candidate relationships, while strengthening our recruiting processes, systems, and employer brand. What you'll be doing Own recruitment processes from beginning to end, including everything from intake and job-posting through sourcing, candidate communication, interviews, feedback, rejections, and close. Partner with hiring managers to clarify role requirements, design effective interview processes, calibrate on candidates, and keep searches moving. Develop sourcing strategies and build qualified pipelines for a variety of roles, with a strong focus on technical hiring (think, software engineers, some QA, product managers, etc.) Use LinkedIn Recruiter, Juicebox, professional communities, referrals, events, and other creative channels to source and engage candidates. Use data to drive how you recruit, including maintaining updated dashboards and organized processes within our ATS (currently Lever), tracking recruiting metrics and using funnel insights to improve how we recruit. Identify recruitment bottlenecks and implement practical improvements that reduce friction for candidates and hiring teams. Support employer-brand initiatives, including regular content for the PolicyMe LinkedIn page and careers content. Contribute to a thoughtful, inclusive, and consistent candidate experience at every stage of the process. What we are looking for 2–5 years of recruiting experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology, startup, scale-up, agency, or similar environment. Bachelor’s degree in business, human resources, or a related field, or equivalent experience. End-to-end recruiting experience, from intake through offer and close, with strong partnerships across hiring managers and recruiting teams. Hands-on technical recruiting experience across software engineering, product, QA, and design roles. Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple searches, projects, timelines, and stakeholders. Proactive, clear communicator who builds trust with candidates and cross-functional partners while effectively surfacing progress, priorities, and risks. Analytical and action-oriented problem solver who diagnoses issues, recommends solutions, and follows through. Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, Juicebox or similar sourcing tools, Brighthire, and Lever or another ATS. Curious and committed to continuously improving recruiting skills, tools, and processes, including a keen interest in using AI in how we build best-in-class recruitment and candidate experiences. Preference for Toronto-based, with interest in coming into our office on Thursdays (office is in Yorkville, there is no mandate to come in!). Why join us: Generous PTO - 20 vacation days A comprehensive benefits plan with premiums paid in full by PolicyMe Investment in your professional development, including an L&D budget, AI tooling budget, performance reviews twice a year and ongoing feedback to ensure you reach your highest potential An extremely high performing, low-ego, remote-first team that is truly disrupting an old industry Option to work from home or our Toronto-based office (bonus: we cover the costs to bring all our employees in-person twice a year for experiential socials!) Access to stock options based on performance Compensation: The total target cash compensation for this role is $88,000–$100,000 CAD , based on experience. We’ll walk through the details together during the interview. Compensation Additional Information About PolicyMe: At PolicyMe, we are Canada’s leading digital insurance solution, offering straightforward and affordable financial protection for families from coast to coast. Our product suite includes Life Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Health & Dental Insurance, all tailored to Canadians' evolving needs. We also offer B2B2C solutions, partnering with organizations to provide seamless digital insurance options. Founded by a team of insurance experts and technology entrepreneurs, PolicyMe is committed to making insurance simpler and more accessible. Since our launch in 2018, we have grown exponentially, selling over $10 billion in insurance coverage to Canadians. We are proud of the team we’ve built and are excited for those that are yet to join us. We operate with a remote-first culture, attracting top talent from across Canada. If you’re looking for a fast-paced, collaborative environment, working alongside incredibly ambitious yet humble humans, we may be the right place for you! To learn more, visit www.policyme.com . Additional Notes: Job Vacancy: This role reflects growth in our team and expanded operational scope. We’re hiring to support increasing demand and continue delivering an exceptional customer experience. Commitment to Equal Opportunity: PolicyMe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and provide fair consideration regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability. Accessibility Statement: We are committed to providing an accessible hiring experience. If you require accommodations during the application process, please indicate this in the “Additional Information” section of your application. We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

items.title: Snr. Marketing Manager, Enterprise ABM EMEA
items.summary: Hi, I’m Harriet, Ashby’s VP Marketing. I joined Ashby in August 2022 to lead the Marketing function. My career journey has been anything but linear starting out as a yoga teacher, working as an M&A lawyer, before finding my happy place in marketing. This is a common theme across the team, and we love to…
items.description: Hi, I’m Harriet, Ashby’s VP Marketing. I joined Ashby in August 2022 to lead the Marketing function. My career journey has been anything but linear starting out as a yoga teacher, working as an M&A lawyer, before finding my happy place in marketing. This is a common theme across the team, and we love to see people who have built their skills both inside and outside the marketing discipline. Over the past ~4 years, we’ve gone from a stealth brand to the default operating system for over 5,000 of the most ambitious companies in tech, finance, and healthcare. On this journey, we’ve also amassed a marketing team of ~30 folks from across North America and Europe who are some of the brightest and most humble humans that want to ‘win’, and have fun doing so. Our culture is focused on creating a space to do lots of career-defining work with the tools, people, and focus that means minimal thrash and lots of autonomy. You can learn a little more about how we work here and why our investors are excited about us here . For this role, we are looking for someone to lead demand generation for our enterprise segment in Europe. You will have a fantastic thought partner and US counterpart, Ben , as well as the autonomy to rethink and define the strategy and execution to fit the nuances of the different European markets. It’s ABM but not in its traditional form: we’re seeking a first-principles thinker who prioritizes meaningful engagement over generic tactics / outdated playbooks (for example, prioritizing a few key impactful moments of engagement over running a laundry list of generic tactics across digital channels). If working with both the sales and marketing team to find and convert enterprise pipeline in a low ego, highly ambitious environment appeals, we’d love to hear from you! What you’ll be responsible for in this role Partner with Ben to define our EMEA enterprise ABM strategy and the channels we bet on with consideration to broader global strategy and nuances of respective European markets. Here you play the critical role of orchestrator, pulling together all of the relevant marketing channels to support a delightful discovery and prospect journey and are the point person for your counterparts in Sales. Research and build prospect journey maps for target accounts, and develop the messaging, content, and creative that bring them to life, with support from our PMM, content, and creative teams. Work with sales and revenue operations to build target account lists that combine data signals with rep input, and own the methodology behind them — how cohorts are built, what assumptions they rest on, and how we measure whether accounts are actually moving. Manage our agency partners, including our gifting agency, Wildcard, to get campaigns executed well and fast. Execute on the strategy you define which will include activities like working with your events counterpart on the coordination of dinners, activations , ancillary conference events, and stunts. Apply our experimentation framework to run short sprints, learn quickly what works, and localise content, creative, and campaign strategy for EMEA markets. You will probably love this role if: You enjoy combining data and creative thinking — and you have taste. You can tell the difference between messaging that's genuinely compelling and messaging that's generic or cheesy. You're prospect-obsessed. You can step into the seat of the personas you're marketing to and build campaigns that meet them where they are, at the right time, with the right message. You are deeply curious and not afraid to break from traditional ABM playbooks. You build trust across functions. Sales managers and reps are excited to work with you, and the marketing team is fully bought into your campaign ideas and asks. You understand (and leverage) the massive advantage AI creates but not so pilled that you let efficiency gains undercut creativity and taste. This role is not for you if: You'd rely solely on 6sense (or equivalent) as your only source of truth. You're strong on one half of the job but not the other. You need to move comfortably between building and interpreting dashboards, and writing compelling copy and developing creative with our gifting agency and creative teams. You lean heavily on existing playbooks and tactics rather than stepping back and thinking from first principles. A lot of how we market at Ashby is deliberately different; curiosity and adaptability are critical. You aren't able to operate with autonomy and run strategies end-to-end. We give clear ownership and trust you with it; you should be proactive and resourceful. You believe that EMEA is one homogeneous market Interview Plan At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. We’ll dive into past projects and simulate working together via project working sessions. Our interview process is five rounds: 30-minute intro call with Michelle (Recruiting). 45-minute interview with Harriet (Hiring Manager). 45-minute interview with Ben (US lead on ABM). A take-home assignment, which you’ll have 40 mins to discuss with the hiring team. A virtual on-site of 1.5 hours with a panel of interviewers. Nhi (Strategic Projects Lead) Casper (Head of ENT Sales, EMEA) Antonio (AI & Automations Lead, Demand Gen) Benefits Competitive salary and equity. Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team. 10-year exercise window for stock options . You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable. Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it . Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply. Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. items.description: About Securly Securly is the K-12 market leader in AI-powered student safety and wellness solutions, protecting more than 20 million students across 20,000+ schools. Our mission is to create safer, more supportive learning environments by detecting potential harm, supporting student mental health, and empowering educators with actionable insights that help students thrive. By turning data into meaningful, actionable intelligence, Securly enables schools to identify risk earlier, reduce harmful incidents, and strengthen student support — driving measurable improvements in safety and wellbeing. We're proud to be recognized as a Top Place to Work , named to TIME's America's Top EdTech Companies 2026 list, a Top 40 Most Used EdTech , and one of the 150 most transformational growth companies. The Role Securly is looking for a Director, Customer Success Operations to lead the systems, processes, and people behind our entire post-sale customer journey. You'll lead our CS Ops and Renewals function - a CS Ops Manager, a CS Ops Specialist, and a team of Renewals Specialists - and own Vitally, our Customer Success platform, as the operational backbone of the business. This is a builder's role. Vitally has been live for about a year, and the next chapter is yours to write: deepening adoption, sharpening health scoring, automating renewals workflows, and turning good instincts into a repeatable, data-driven system that scales. You'll be the operational thought partner to CS executives - using data and process design to make sure customer growth and success directly fuel Securly's growth. Location: Remote (U.S.) Type: Full-Time, Exempt Reports to: SVP, Customer Success What Success Looks Like In your first 90 days, you'll get under the hood - auditing our Vitally configuration, current CS Ops and renewals workflows, and team structure. You'll build real relationships with your team and ship your first wave of improvements: sharper health scoring, better dashboards, and a more programmatic renewals process. By 6 months, you're driving measurable gains - better renewals efficiency, stronger forecast accuracy, and dashboards that CS and company leadership actually rely on to run the business. By your first year, you own a mature CS Ops and Renewals function that consistently meets or exceeds retention targets, backed by a trained, accountable team and a Vitally instance that scales with Securly's growth. What You'll Do Lead the team Hire, coach, and manage a team of a CS Ops Manager, a CS Ops Specialist, and Renewals Specialists - setting clear goals and holding the team accountable to them Structure team capacity and coverage to match renewal volume and customer segmentation Build a real growth path for your team, from onboarding through career development Own the process Design, implement, and continuously refine scalable playbooks that support the entire post-sale customer journey Own the end-to-end renewal process - timely, accurate, and built to minimize churn Design and run a programmatic renewals process suited to a high-volume, complex customer base Turn data into decisions Own customer health scoring, tracking, and measurement across the install base Define and build the dashboards CS and executive leadership use to manage the business Surface customer insights to Product, Support, and Sales to drive real improvements Build the tech stack Serve as the internal owner of Vitally - driving adoption, configuration, and continuous optimization Identify, build, and implement Agentic AI and automation that genuinely moves the needle on CS Ops and renewals outcomes Manage the broader tech stack, including integrations with Salesforce and other GTM systems What We're Looking For 3+ years leading a Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, or Renewals team - this is a leadership track record, not an individual-contributor background, with proven experience scaling CS tools, systems, and AI Real examples of scaling a CS Ops function - taking a team, process, or system from early-stage to measurably better performance, with strong examples of building tools, systems, and process, and applying AI Hands-on experience building tech, systems, and automation - you've architected workflows, integrations, or automation inside a CS platform (Vitally, Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce or HubSpot, not just used tools someone else set up Applied experience with Agentic AI and automation - you've actually built or implemented AI-driven workflows (like automated health scoring or renewals triage), not just explored the space A track record of building and coaching a team, with strong data analytics skills and fluency in core SaaS metrics (GRR, NRR, churn, CLV, NPS, CSAT) Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple cross-functional initiatives at once Experience in K-12, EdTech, or education-adjacent SaaS is a strong plus Why You'll Love Working at Securly Meaningful impact - build the operational engine behind a company that helps protect millions of students People-first culture - consistently recognized as a Top Place to Work Remote-first flexibility - work from home with a supportive, distributed team Real ownership - shape a growing platform and team, not maintain someone else's system Mission-driven work - what you build directly supports student safety and wellbeing Benefits & Perks Competitive salary up to $165K with performance incentives Medical, dental, and vision coverage 401(k) with employer match 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave Unlimited PTO, paid holidays, and a paid one-week year-end shutdown $1,000 annual professional development stipend Free mental health resources and Employee Assistance Program Equal Opportunity Employer Securly is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. Accommodations are available throughout the hiring process - just let us know at recruitment.us@securly.com #LI-Remote #LI-DO1

We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers. That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As…
items.description: Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 120,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers. That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As a team, we continuously inspire each other to learn new and better ways to make an impact. We own our jobs proudly - our leaders don't hold our hands, but they're in our corner whenever we ask for help - and our environment is flexible and remote-first. As our new Senior Product Designer , you'll lead and execute product initiatives from concept to UI, bringing a user-focused mentality to everything you ship. You'll join a small, close-knit Product Design team, report to the Head of Product, partner day to day with Research, Product Management, and Development, and work with other teams as collaborators and stakeholders. It's a hands-on senior design role with the opportunity to grow into leading the PD team as it scales, while staying close to the design work Your primary canvas is MyKinsta, the dashboard where our customers manage their sites, but your scope also extends to the service layer to cover the full user experience of Kinsta. This means a design output can include internal workflows, customer communication, or additional tooling. You'll work with a high level of autonomy while you design features, manage stakeholders, provide UX guidance, and occasionally step in to own a project through delivery. The ideal Kinsta Senior Product Designer is a strong craftsperson, a confident decision-maker, curious, collaborative, and self-motivated. What You'll Do: Own design projects end to end (concept, scoping, user flows, UI, release, and follow-up), at any scale, from small improvements to strategic new capabilities. Drive discovery: define what to build to address real problems and user needs, and study competitors and best practices. Work closely with Research, Product Management, and Development: request and apply insights, align on business requirements, and validate technical feasibility. Write clear specifications so design intent is unambiguous, and run design QA against both the intent and the Kinsta Design System. Give clear rationale for your decisions, resolve design and product deadlocks, escalate when you need feedback or mediation, and communicate trade-offs when priorities compete. Serve as Project Owner on occasion. We don't have full-time delivery managers, so one team member leads each project as its Owner during delivery, communicating progress and coordinating releases. Be a product expert: know how our product works, the personas and use cases we support, and how that translates into UI-level design solutions. Represent the craft: uphold professional standards in design thinking, problem solving, usability, UX, and UI; give and receive design critique; and help maintain and evolve the Kinsta Design System. What You Bring To The Role: A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience as a Product or UX Designer. Demonstrated experience shipping products and features from zero to production, with the ability to carry a project fully autonomously. Experience working in a SaaS environment, on a highly technical product, in cross-functional teams. Hands-on experience across the full design workflow: research, problem definition, ideation and facilitation, creating UI, and partnering in delivery. Expert-level proficiency with Figma. Experience working with and maintaining a design system. A portfolio with at least one case study taking a project from a problem statement to a delivered solution. We want to see your process and how you arrived at decisions, not only screens and a general workflow description. A good understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JS). You don't need to write production code, but you should have a working sense of feasibility and be comfortable poking at things in an Inspector. Proactivity: you take the initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do. Professional-level English with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Bonus if you have: Experience working on a hosting or web infrastructure product. Experience with technical products where the audience is developers or technology-oriented users. Experience with the WordPress ecosystem. Experience mentoring or leading other designers. Benefits: Annual remote expense budget. Flexible PTO. Paid parental leave. Annual professional development budget: available after one year with Kinsta. Sabbatical: available after three years with Kinsta (and every three years thereafter). Location-specific healthcare benefits (includes vision and dental) for employees hired in the USA, UK, Canada, and Hungary. Pension plan for employees hired in the UK, and 401k contributions for employees hired in the USA. Compensation Additional Information Kinsta is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate and we will take actions to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, citizenship, age, religion, creed, disability, marital status, veteran’s status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. By applying to one of our positions, you agree to the processing of the submitted personal data in accordance with Kinsta's Privacy Policy , including the transfer of your data to the United States. #LI-Remote, #IHSRemote

items.description: Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential. We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy. Position Overview The Manager, Customer Success (CS Manager) is a pivotal leadership role within the Customer Success organization. Your full professional capacity is invested in one outcome: building, developing, and leading a high-performing CS team that consistently delivers exceptional retention, expansion, and customer outcomes across the portfolio. The CS Manager is not a removed administrator. You are a hands-on people leader who is deeply connected to the day-to-day work of your team — present in account reviews, coaching conversations, renewal pipelines, and at-risk escalations. You understand the team’s accounts well enough to guide strategy, spot risk early, and develop each CSM's capabilities in the context of real work; but do so as a leader and coach, not as an account owner. The ideal candidate brings mastery of CS execution and is now ready to direct that expertise entirely toward the growth and performance of others. You are energized by developing people, committed to building scalable team systems, and commercially literate enough to hold the team accountable to the metrics that matter. Key Responsibilities Own team-level GRR, NRR, and expansion targets — accountable for aggregate performance across all direct reports' portfolios Maintain a real-time view of the team's renewal pipeline, at-risk accounts, and expansion opportunities through regular account reviews and reporting Identify commercial risk early across the team's portfolio and drive proactive mitigation — not just flag issues when they surface Ensure every CSM on the team has a documented account strategy, active success plans, and clear renewal and expansion plans for key accounts Partner with CS Leadership to set team targets, forecast performance, and report on retention and revenue outcomes at the portfolio level Serve as the executive escalation point for the most critical or complex account situations within the team's portfolio Own the consistent application of CS playbooks, processes, and standards across the team — identifying where gaps exist and driving improvement Partner with CS Leadership to develop, refine, and operationalize playbooks, renewal frameworks, and success plan standards Manage a team of CSMs across levels with direct accountability for their performance, development, and career progression Conduct regular 1:1s with each direct report — structured, purposeful, and focused on both immediate performance and longer-term development Deliver honest, specific, and actionable performance feedback on a consistent cadence — not just at formal review periods Develop and maintain individual development plans for each direct report, aligned to their career goals, current gaps, and the needs of the team Identify high-potential team members and proactively create stretch opportunities, exposure, and development experiences that accelerate their growth Address underperformance early and directly, with clear expectations, documented support plans, and consistent follow-through Actively contribute to hiring decisions, onboarding design, and ramp planning for new CS team members Build a team environment where feedback flows in both directions — where CSMs feel safe to raise concerns, share ideas, and push back constructively Competencies: People Leadership & Talent Development – Builds and develops a high-performing CS team through structured coaching, actionable feedback, individualized development plans, and clear accountability for performance and career growth. Commercial & Retention Leadership – Owns team-level GRR, NRR, retention, and expansion outcomes, ensuring CSMs understand their commercial responsibilities and have clear strategies to achieve portfolio targets. Strategic Account & Risk Oversight – Maintains visibility across renewal pipelines, account health, expansion opportunities, and at-risk customers, identifying trends and driving proactive strategies before risks impact retention. Performance Management & Accountability – Sets clear expectations, evaluates performance consistently, recognizes high potential, and addresses performance gaps early through direct feedback, structured support, and follow-through. CS Coaching & Execution Excellence – Coaches CSMs on account strategy, success planning, renewals, expansion, and executive engagement while ensuring consistent execution of CS playbooks and standards. Operational Excellence & Scalability – Builds and improves CS processes, reporting cadences, playbooks, onboarding programs, and team systems that create consistency and enable the organization to scale effectively. Executive Escalation & Customer Leadership – Provides leadership in complex or high-risk customer situations, helping shape strategy and executive communication while enabling the CSM to maintain appropriate account ownership. Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence – Partners effectively with Sales, Product, Finance, Operations, and CS Leadership to align customer strategy with broader retention, expansion, and business objectives. Required Qualifications 8–12 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Customer Growth in B2B SaaS Demonstrated track record of excellence as an individual contributor in CS — equivalent to CSM 3 or CSM Team Lead performance — providing the commercial credibility needed to coach and develop senior CSMs Prior people management experience with direct reports in a CS, account management, or related customer-facing function Proven ability to develop CS talent — identifying gaps, designing development plans, and delivering feedback that produces measurable improvement Strong commercial literacy: fluency in NRR, GRR, ARR, churn, and expansion mechanics and the ability to hold a team accountable to these metrics with depth and confidence Experience managing team performance — setting targets, reviewing pipelines, identifying risk, and driving accountability across a group of individual contributors Demonstrated cross-functional influence: working with Sales, Finance, Product, and Operations to align around customer and revenue outcomes Strong operational instincts — able to design and improve team processes, reporting cadences, and playbook execution standards Experience with CS and CRM platforms at both a user and team-management level Exceptional communication skills — able to give difficult feedback, navigate executive conversations, and represent the team's perspective with authority Preferred Qualifications Experience in a CS Team Lead, pod lead, or senior advisor role before moving into direct management — demonstrating a natural progression through the player-coach model Background building or redesigning CS team structures, onboarding programs, or career frameworks Experience managing CSMs across multiple levels simultaneously — including both early-career and senior team members Strong data fluency: designing team dashboards, renewal forecasts, and health scoring systems that inform management decisions Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies. Why Join Us? At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance: Health and Wellness: Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment. Retirement Savings: 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested. RRSP (CAN): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested. Paid Time Off: Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life. Parental Leave: 12 weeks paid leave for all employees. Remote Work Support: Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely. Holidays: Generous Holiday Schedule: Benefit from an extensive list of holidays to recharge and spend time with loved ones. Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one! EEOC & ADA Statement : Cordance and its companies provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, creed, sex, nationality, ancestry, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Cordance and its companies comply with federal and state disability laws and make reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Human Resources. This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Final candidate must be able to pass a background check. To view applicant notices required under federal and state law, please visit: https://cordance.co/applicant-notices/

items.title: Business Operations Manager
items.summary: About MonetizeMoreMonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally.
items.description: About MonetizeMore MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration . We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on. About the Role The company is seeking an experienced, systems-driven Business Operations Manager to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end-to-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes. The Business Operations Manager will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data- and AI-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems. Core Responsibilities 1. Process Kaizen & SOP Governance Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented. 2. Project Management & Visibility Own and maintain BE's project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond BE, building the foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into BL L10s. 3. Product Rollout Support Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go-live. Work closely with the incoming Group PM to formalize this process as a repeatable model. 4. Cross-Departmental & Enterprise Client Enablement Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross-functional commitments visible and actioned. 5. Data & Spreadsheet Management Own data pulls and spreadsheet-based reporting for BE initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable models that others can use without re-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role, not incidental. Who You Are The Experienced Operator: You have 4+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high-data-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC). The Systems Builder: You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably. Data- and AI-Fluent: You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work. Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process. Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly. What We Offer True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle. Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: About Offshore Launch Offshore Launch is a staffing agency that specializes in helping small business owners scale their operations with the top 1% of global remote talent. We are a people-centered agency with a passion for leaving every person and business in a better position than we found them. Why Join Offshore Launch ? Impact the growth and success of small and medium-sized businesses. Work in a people-first, remote environment that values growth and ongoing development. Access comprehensive benefits that include HMO, PTO, professional development, and an overall emphasis on teamwork and collaboration. However, the Agency provides ongoing support to ensure your continued success. able to independently produce structured, citation-backed, executive-ready reports Demonstrated experience sourcing executive/decision-maker contacts (LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, or equivalent) Comfortable drafting personalized outreach/cold emails as part of a research or business development deliverable Working knowledge of Monday.com or a comparable PM tool (Asana, Smartsheet) for Gantt charts and KPI dashboards Track record of multi-source verification and transparent sourcing/citation practices High discernment and tenacity — able to operate with minimal oversight and context-switch cleanly across multiple, unrelated client accounts Nice-to-have Prior exposure to legal tech, insurtech, investigations, or litigation consulting sectors Familiarity with luxury travel, ground transportation, or corporate meetings & events Experience directly supporting sales/BD teams (SDR/BDR-adjacent research background Compensation & Benefits (to be provided by Offshore Launch ) Up to $1800, depending on experience 13th month pay Performance-based bonuses up to 150% of one month's salary Comprehensive HMO policy, including dependents. Annual continuing education budget to support professional development Note The Client is not involved in compensation or benefits. As an employee of Offshore Launch , all compensation and benefits are to be provided by the Agency. Please note that we anticipate a response from candidates within 24 hours of our outreach. If we do not receive a reply within this timeframe, we will assume that you are no longer interested in pursuing this opportunity. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior PPC Specialist
items.summary: We're looking for a Senior PPC Specialist to lead paid acquisition efforts across Meta, Google, and other digital advertising platforms.
items.description: We're looking for a Senior PPC Specialist to lead paid acquisition efforts across Meta, Google, and other digital advertising platforms. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands that successful paid media isn't just about launching campaigns; it's about maximizing profitability. You'll be responsible for optimizing the entire acquisition funnel, analyzing campaign performance, improving conversion rates, and making strategic decisions that drive sustainable growth. The ideal candidate is analytical, data-driven, and comfortable balancing campaign execution with performance strategy. Requirements Key Responsibilities Plan, launch, and optimize paid media campaigns across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and other advertising platforms. Monitor and improve key performance metrics, including ROAS, CPA, CAC, CTR, Conversion Rate, and LTV. Identify profitability issues and optimize the entire conversion funnel. Conduct A/B testing for audiences, creatives, landing pages, and offers. Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable insights through dashboards and reports. Manage advertising budgets and scale high-performing campaigns. Collaborate with creative and marketing teams to improve campaign results. Implement and maintain tracking using GA4, Google Tag Manager, and advertising platforms. Stay up to date with industry trends, AI tools, and platform updates. Requirements Resume in English. Native or near-native English proficiency (spoken and written). 4+ years of experience managing Meta and Google Ads campaigns. Proven experience optimizing campaigns based on ROAS, CPA, CAC, and profitability. Strong understanding of conversion funnels and conversion rate optimization (CRO). items.title: Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!
items.description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About the role The CFO’s mission is to continue building upon Grüns ' already strong finance and data function — evolving it into a best-in-class engine that empowers the entire organization to make faster, smarter decisions. Leading a team of three strong leaders, this role is about leading the strong teams below them to democratize financial intelligence across the Grüns organization: self-serve dashboards, on-demand reporting, and real-time visibility that puts decision-making power in the hands of every team member. The CFO is a relentless, collaborative business partner, never satisfied with where the business is on revenue scale or profitability, always pushing for the next point of EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and driving efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. They will ensure Grüns scales with confidence while meeting all external requirements seamlessly in the background. This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL. What success looks like: If we look ahead a year from now, the right person in this role would have: Leveraged what we’ve built so far, found areas for improvement, and fully operationalized a goal accountability framework that keeps business initiatives tied to financial outcomes, ensuring the leadership team is consistently tracking toward revenue and profitability targets. Driven meaningful EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and improved LTV:CAC efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. Delivered self-serve dashboards, templatized reporting, and real-time P&L visibility across functions so every team has the data access they need without relying on ad-hoc requests. Business decisions are democratized and exponentially quicker. Created the conditions for a high-performing, motivated team empowering vs. micromanaging, actively developing leaders, and driving strong results and performance without burnout. Built the systems and processes to meet all external reporting and compliance requirements seamlessly, keeping the team focused on growth. We're looking for someone with: Relentless Growth Mindset: Always asking what it takes to get to the next level, whether that's another point of margin, better efficiency, or a faster path to revenue growth - a genuine internal drive to make the business the best it can be. Finding new opportunities across the business and proposing these opportunities to the CEO and functional leads. Integrity and Business-First Thinking: Prioritizes the truth over “looking good”. Navigates competing stakeholder interests honestly and thoroughly rather than taking the path of least resistance. Empowering Leadership: Leads by giving people the tools, clarity, and confidence to make great decisions vs. controlling the work directly. Actively develops their functional leaders, makes their team better than they were before. Drives sustainable high performance. Paper Wall Pusher: Treats perceived constraints as hypotheses, not facts. When told something takes six weeks or "this is how it's done," they ask why and push for faster, smarter, or different. Actively hunts for process bloat and inherited ways of working to find improvements. AI-Native Operator: Uses AI natively in their own workflow and actively builds AI fluency into the team's operating model. Sees AI as a core lever for scaling the function's impact without scaling headcount. Direct, but kind: Direct and honest in every conversation, saying what needs to be said, even when it's uncomfortable. Deeply committed to the business and the people in it. Experience: 10+ years leadership experience in a high-growth, profitable businesses; some level of physical inventory experience (CPG, retail, e-commerce, or similar) is a must Experience leading the functions in scope - finance, accounting, data, and BizOps functions Experience within a high-growth company that is adapting to public company practices Compensation & Benefits: At Grüns , we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary is $350,000 + incentive compensation, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team. A bit about us... At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you. Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all. So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious. What we care about... Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation. Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!
