items.description: Fractional CFO — Turning Financial Data Into Confident Business Decisions (Remote) Company: How To MANAGE a Small Law Firm (HTM) Location: 100% Remote (Must reside in AZ, CO, FL, GA, IL, MD, MI, NC, NJ, NY, PA, TX, VA, or WA) Department: Executive Leadership Employment Type: Full-Time | W-2 Employee Compensation: $110,000 Base Salary + Performance Compensation | $182,000+ On-Target Earnings Please Read Before Applying This role requires 10+ years of finance leadership experience, including direct experience managing multiple client relationships simultaneously — as a CFO, Fractional CFO, Outsourced CFO, Virtual CFO, Business Advisor, or in another multi-client financial leadership environment — specifically advising small to mid-sized businesses (roughly $1M–$35M+ in revenue) for 10 or more years. ✅ Done this before? Keep reading. ❌ Background is primarily in managing books, closing monthly financials, or overseeing an accounting team? This is a strategic CFO role, not a Controller or accounting role — likely not the right fit. ❌ Career built mainly around large enterprise or corporate finance, without sustained hands-on work with small/mid-sized businesses? Also, likely not the right fit — this role depends on that specific experience. This is a U.S.-based position. Applicants must currently reside in one of the states listed above and be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship. We’re unable to consider candidates residing outside the U.S. About the Role At HTM, our CFOs help law firm owners understand their numbers, improve profitability, and make confident business decisions. You’ll operate much like a CFO does for any single client — analyzing financials, guiding strategy, building trust — but within a structured portfolio model, serving as the financial partner to ~30 growing law firms. This is a full-time W-2 executive position — not a 1099 consulting gig or independent fractional practice. HTM provides the clients, systems, and infrastructure so you can focus entirely on helping owners make better financial decisions. No legal industry experience required — we’ll teach you what you need to know about serving law firms. Why This Beats Running Your Own Practice If you’ve built (or considered building) an independent fractional CFO practice, you know the tradeoff: the strategic work is rewarding, but finding clients and running your own back office eats into the work you actually want to do. At HTM, we remove that burden: No business development — we bring you a full portfolio; you never sell or chase your next engagement Predictable income + upside — guaranteed base plus performance compensation, not feast-or-famine Full benefits, real structure — medical/dental/vision (75% employer-paid), 401(k) match, unlimited PTO, and a built-in team Scale without the overhead — ~30 clients with systems and support staff already in place A fast-growing company behind you — Inc. 5000 Fastest-Growing Company every year since 2013 About HTM How To MANAGE a Small Law Firm is the nation’s leading provider of Fractional C-Suite services for solo and small law firms. Our clients don’t need another accountant — they need a financial leader who helps them understand the business and build a more profitable organization. What You’ll Do This is hands-on financial leadership, not report-and-explain. Serve as the financial leader for ~30 client businesses Review financial statements and identify opportunities for improvement Build forecasts, budgets, cash flow strategies, and KPI dashboards Improve pricing, margins, cash flow, and operational profitability Partner with owners on strategic growth decisions and financial accountability Help businesses become less reactive and more financially disciplined Build trusted, long-term relationships with business owners What You Bring 10+ years of finance leadership experience, with at least 10 of those years spent specifically advising or leading finance for small to mid-sized businesses ($1M–$35M+ revenue) Direct experience managing multiple client relationships simultaneously (CFO, Fractional CFO, Outsourced CFO, Virtual CFO, Business Advisor, or similar) A track record advising or partnering directly with founders’/business owners of small to mid-sized companies Strong financial analysis, forecasting, and strategic planning skills and the ability to translate data into business recommendations Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional leadership experience Ideal candidates also bring experience in service-based industries (law firms, agencies, consulting), full ownership of financial strategy, and success helping organizations scale beyond founder dependence Compensation & Benefits $110,000 base + performance compensation ($182,000+ on-target earnings) Medical, dental, vision (75% employer-paid); company-paid short- and long-term disability 401(k) with company match Unlimited PTO, plus a paid Thanksgiving-week shutdown and one additional mandatory paid week off EAP, pet insurance, legal insurance Professional and executive leadership development 100% remote Apply Today Become the financial leader growing law firms rely on to make smarter decisions and scale successfully — with a team, systems, and pipeline already built around you.

items.description: As a Product Owner, you’ll be directly aligned with one of our agile engineering teams, articulating and prioritizing customer challenges and opportunities for the team to solve in collaboration with the User Experience team. The ideal candidate will have excellent business acumen, experience in SaaS product management, and a passion for working in K-12 education technology, specifically in driving efficiencies in back-office systems and processes for K-12 school districts. In this role, data and analytics are the product, not a feature of one. As the Product Owner for our Advanced Analytics offering, you will work with school districts and education service agencies to build and maintain a platform that enables them to create their own data products while also developing ours. The foundation of this offering includes our data lakehouse, reports, dashboards, and the advanced capabilities that sit on top of the data. You will also partner with other Product Owners across the organization to support their analytics and reporting needs. This is a great opportunity for a highly organized, data-driven, and customer-focused individual with experience working with data platforms at scale. We welcome candidates from a variety of locations; however, all candidates should be open to occasional in-person participation for business meetings, team events, or collaboration opportunities. Candidates located within approximately 35 miles of Rochester, NY may be asked to work from the office more frequently based on business or team needs. Compensation $90,000 - $140,000 What You’ll Accomplish Works with the Product Director to translate high-level company vision and strategy into actionable product plans. Partners with Customers to identify and prioritize needs, documents them as epics with requirements and acceptance criteria, and works with Engineering and UX to break them into plannable features and stories while serving as the Customer advocate throughout development. Validates that solutions deliver meaningful impact against Epics and strategic goals, and coordinates with documentation, training, support, and marketing to prepare for release. Where appropriate, facilitates user acceptance testing and/or feedback demonstrations of work prior to release, collates and assesses feedback, and reshapes team priorities as needed to maximize value for the customer. Serves as a product SME for service, sales, and marketing, and represents SchoolTool externally at User Groups and Conferences to present features and gather customer feedback. Actively facilitates and participates in team retrospectives and the continuous improvements of our organizational structure, processes, and tooling to drive greater operational efficiency and value for our customers. Applies an AI-first mindset by effectively leveraging AI-assisted tools and technologies to enhance productivity, accelerate problem-solving, improve quality, automate routine tasks, and drive innovation in the delivery of solutions and services. Strong written and verbal communication skills over complex topics with both internal technical team members and non-technical stakeholders. Strong organizational / prioritization skills with the ability to prioritize incoming requests from multiple channels, manage concurrent projects, course correct for changing priorities via Support and APM tools. Ability to assess how different users consume and act on data and to define solutions appropriate to the user’s context (e.g., compliance reporting vs. operational decision-making vs. self-service exploration). Ability to define data quality, timeliness, and accuracy as product requirements, understanding that these are customer-facing decisions, not just engineering concerns. Ability to define measurable success criteria for analytics features beyond delivery, including adoption, accuracy, and impact on user decision-making or operational efficiency. Ability to work with customers to understand their data and reporting needs at the outcome level, focusing on what decisions they need to make rather than taking requests at face value. Demonstrates sound judgment in the ethical, secure, and compliant use of AI technologies while protecting confidential, customer, and company information. Identifies opportunities to use AI to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, improve efficiency, and increase business value. Licenses & Certifications CSPO (Certified Scrum Product Owner) or equivalent certification and/or experience a plus. Education & Experience BA in Information Technology, Computer Science or related technical fields preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. 4+ years of experience as a Product Owner, owning a data platform strategy, including how data is structured, accessed, and used to drive decisions through reporting and analytics solutions (canned reports, dashboards, self-service tools, alerts, data exports) and to drive more advanced product features is strongly preferred. 4+ years of experience in PK-12, strong familiarity with PK-12 data domains, ideally Ed-Fi (SIS, Assessment, SPED, MTSS, Instruction, HR, and Finance), and how they are used to drive decisions for school districts is preferred. items.summary: About MonetizeMore MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Ent
items.description: About MonetizeMore MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration . We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on. About the Role The company is seeking an experienced, systems-driven Business Operations / Project Manager with a strong AdTech Background to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end-to-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes. The Business Operations / Project Manager will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data- and AI-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems. Core Responsibilities 1. Process Kaizen & SOP Governance ### Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented. 2. Project Management & Visibility ### Own and maintain internal Notion project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond the department, building the systems foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into business line weekly meetings, as aligned with product operating model. 3. Product Rollout Support ### Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go-live. Work closely with Group Product Manager to formalize this process as a repeatable model. 4. Cross-Departmental & Enterprise Client Enablement ### Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross-functional commitments visible and actioned. 5. Data & Spreadsheet Management ### Own data pulls and spreadsheet-based reporting for departmental initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable, and scalable systems and models that others can use without re-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role. Who You Are The Experienced Operator: You have 4+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high-data-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC). The Systems Builder: You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably. Data- and AI-Fluent: You’re comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand-holding, and you’ve used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work. Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process. Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don’t let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly. What We Offer True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle. Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company.

items.summary: Headquarters: United Kingdom (Remote) Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the In
items.description: DevOps and Sysadmin Headquarters: United Kingdom (Remote) Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue. We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us. Senior SRE - Networks Fastly’s Technical Operations (TechOps) team is responsible for building & operating the infrastructure that powers the Fastly Edge Cloud Platform. We oversee an extensive global network that spans 6 continents with over 100 points of presence and 578 Tbps of connected capacity. Our platform serves a significant portion of the content delivered to internet consumers across the planet, with customers ranging from online media streaming services to e-commerce, to open source projects, nonprofits and more. We take this responsibility seriously! We’re looking for an experienced SRE with strong focus on Networks, SRE principals and knowledge of the internet who can bring engineering best practices, operational rigour, and automation skills to help craft the future of Fastly’s network and directly contribute to making the internet better. What You'll Do: Build, operate, and maintain the continually growing global network footprint of Fastly’s Edge Cloud Platform. Response to significant traffic incidents and lead network incidents, resolving edge cases and failure scenarios with your expertise in IP routing, particularly BGP. Write code that is performant, maintainable, clear, and concise and contribute to code reviews, improving the codebase and other team processes Partner in the development and iteration of tools and automation systems that improve how we operate and build the network. Innovate new methods for monitoring network performance, focusing on the end-user experience, and proactively address potential issues. Continual deep-dive of performance-based analytics and close involvement with partner teams to maintain a performant global network. Advocate for the operational stability of the network by identifying opportunities and partnering with engineering teams to shape their roadmaps and software solutions. Mentor team members on the complexities of global routing, especially in an anycast-heavy environment. What We're Looking For: Experience in the protocols and practices that make up the fabric of the global internet, including TCP/IP, BGP, Anycast and DNS. Experience in Automation and coding using languages like Python, or similar. Proficiency in Tier 1 Internet service providers, Internet exchanges and cloud providers. Ability to analyze internet traffic patterns across multiple dimensions using flow-based tools. Experience working with alerting, monitoring and visibility tools (such as Graphite/Grafana, Prometheus, or Splunk). Knowledge across cloud hosting solutions (i.e., GCP, AWS and Azure). Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI / CD pipelines (ie. Git, Jenkins, Ansible). Understanding of Linux/Unix systems administration and network stack optimisation. Adept at knowledge sharing and creating comprehensive documentation to empower teams. Able to collaborate with cross-functional teams to shape the technical roadmap, prioritizing initiatives to optimize automation tooling and the network. We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these: Experience writing production-level code using VCL or GO Experience in network telemetry including instrumenting infrastructure and collecting, processing, storing and analyzing data Experience working with geographically dispersed teams: previous remote work preferred Work Hours: This position will require you to work during scheduled hours from 0800 - 1700. This position will require you to be available during core business hours. It may also require occasional nights and weekends as necessary to support any on-call coverage. Work Location(s) & Travel Requirements : Fastly currently embraces a largely hybrid model for most roles which allows employees flexibility to split their time between the office and home. This position may require travel as required by your role or requested by your manager. This position has one opening and can be hired in the following locations: London (Hybrid) UK, Remote Benefits: We care about you. Fastly works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We support our teams with great benefits that start on the first day of your employment with Fastly. Curious about our offerings? We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to meet your needs. Our offerings may vary depending on the country where you work and are subject to change. Why Fastly? We have a huge impact. Fastly is a small company with a big reach. Not only do our customers have a tremendous user base, but we also support a growing number of open source projects and initiatives . Outside of code, employees are encouraged to share causes close to their heart with others so we can help lend a supportive hand. We value diversity. Growing and maintaining our inclusive and diverse team matters to us. We are committed to being a company where our employees feel comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work and have the ability to be successful -- every day. We are passionate. Fastly is chock full of passionate people and we’re not ‘one size fits all’. Fastly employs authors, pilots, skiers, parents (of humans and animals), makeup geeks, coffee connoisseurs, and more. We love employees for who they are and what they are passionate about. We’re always looking for humble, sharp, and creative folks to join the Fastly team. If you think you might be a fit please apply! A fully completed application and resume or CV are required when applying. All job applications must be submitted through our official careers site at www.fastly.com/about/careers . We will never request sensitive information, such as your Social Security number, bank account or credit card information during the application process. All official communication will come from an @ fastly.com or @ recruiting.fastly.com email address. Fastly is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity and to providing employees with a safe and welcoming work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Our employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, family or parental status, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and federal or state disability laws, Fastly will provide reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact your Recruiter, or the Fastly Employee Relations team at candidateaccommodations@fastly.com or 501-287-4901. Fastly collects and processes personal data submitted by job applicants in accordance with our Privacy Policy . Please see our privacy notice for job applicants . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/fastly-senior-sre-networks

items.description: OGC Global is a boutique customer experience and market research consultancy that helps leading organizations understand their customers, improve experiences, and make better business decisions. We are looking for a Senior Analyst to join our team and support a key Life Insurance client . This role combines analytical expertise, client management, and project leadership. The Senior Analyst will work closely with the client while overseeing and coordinating a team of analysts and project resources to ensure successful delivery of client work. The Role The Senior Analyst will serve as a key day-to-day contact for the client and will take ownership of assigned projects and workstreams. Monitor project progress and proactively identify and resolve risks or challenges. Manage multiple workstreams and priorities simultaneously. Build strong relationships with client stakeholders and develop a deep understanding of their business and objectives. Lead client meetings, project discussions, and status updates. Clearly communicate project progress, findings, recommendations, and next steps. Proactively identify opportunities to add value and improve the client experience. Analyze quantitative and qualitative research data to identify meaningful trends and insights. Developing analysis and translating findings into actionable recommendations. Develop and review client-facing presentations, reports, and other deliverables. Support customer experience, market research, and customer journey initiatives. Develop knowledge of the life insurance industry, including customer needs, products, and market trends. Requirements 4–7+ years of experience in market research, customer experience, consulting, analytics, or a related field. Experience working with financial services and/or insurance clients ; life insurance experience strongly preferred. Experience managing projects, workstreams, timelines, and multiple stakeholders. Experience coordinating or managing junior team members. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent client communication and presentation skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities. Ability to take ownership and work independently while effectively leading a supporting team. Strong proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel ; experience with research and analytics platforms is a plus. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, client-focused consulting environment. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Portfolio Analyst Altius Search Group is recruiting for a growing financial services company seeking a Portfolio Analyst to evaluate portfolio performance, identify emerging risks, and support sound credit and portfolio management decisions. Key Responsibilities Analyze portfolio performance, including delinquency levels, defaults, loss trends, concentrations, and exposure limits Identify early warning indicators and areas of emerging credit or operational risk Review financial statements, payment history, and borrower performance to evaluate ongoing creditworthiness Recommend changes to risk ratings based on financial performance and other relevant factors Develop and support action plans designed to reduce portfolio risk and improve performance Produce recurring portfolio reports, trend analyses, and management-level presentations Collaborate with Credit, Sales, Operations, and Asset Management on portfolio strategy and risk-mitigation initiatives Provide analysis and supporting information for credit committee discussions Evaluate the effectiveness of existing credit policies, scorecards, and decisioning processes Maintain accurate records and supporting documentation consistent with internal policies and audit requirements Assist with special projects involving portfolio analytics, financial modeling, and strategic planning Requirements Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related discipline At least three years of experience in portfolio analysis, credit analysis, credit risk, operational risk, or a related financial services role Strong financial statement analysis and credit assessment capabilities Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and experience developing financial models Ability to interpret complex data and clearly communicate findings and risk considerations Experience working with risk-rating methodologies and portfolio performance metrics Background in data analytics, including regression analysis or similar statistical techniques Previous experience in equipment leasing, commercial lending, or another asset-based finance environment Familiarity with business development functions and commercial decision-making Experience with credit scorecards or automated decisioning tools is preferred Professional Attributes Analytical and intellectually curious Strategic and forward-looking Creative in approaching complex business and risk-related challenges Strong written and verbal communication skills Effective at collaborating with stakeholders across multiple departments Highly accountable, organized, and attentive to detail Capable of balancing portfolio protection with business growth objectives Compensation Base salary range: $65,000–$85,000 Additional benefits and compensation details will be discussed during the interview process Highlights Analyze portfolio performance, identify credit risks, assess borrower financials, and support portfolio strategy. items.title: Director of International Business Development & Sales
items.summary: Hydrosat is a space and data analytics company building a new Earth observation constellation and software platform to unlock the power of thermal infrared imagery.
items.description: Hydrosat is a space and data analytics company building a new Earth observation constellation and software platform to unlock the power of thermal infrared imagery. We deliver high-resolution thermal insights that help governments, defense agencies, and agribusinesses better manage water resources, agricultural production, national security threats, and critical infrastructure. We grow through two distinct routes to market – government programmes, and commercial data and subscription products – and our product and engineering teams build the platform that powers both. Hydrosat is hiring a Director of International BD & Sales to bost growth, identify and develop strategic opportunities, and strengthen our position across international government markets. This is a senior, hands-on role combining channel leadership, business development, and market intelligence. You will own Hydrosat ’s international partner ecosystem, shape market-entry strategies, and identify relevant government programs before they reach formal procurement. Working closely with the VP Global, Government Programs, you will represent Hydrosat with senior customers and partners, make recommendations on where the company should invest its resources, and coordinate early-stage opportunities into qualified captures. Responsibilities Channel Strategy and Management Audit, improve and execute Hydrosat ’s international channel strategy. Identify, recruit, negotiate with, and onboard resellers and strategic partners. Establish reseller agreements for satellite data, IrriWatch, and other relevant Hydrosat solutions. Manage partner pipelines and hold resellers accountable against clear activity, pipeline, and revenue targets. Provide partners with the use cases, marketing materials, pricing guidance, training, and commercial support needed to generate and maximize revenue. Structure the global reseller network through partner tiers and performance reviews Grow partner-generated pipeline and revenue while addressing underperforming relationships. International Strategy and Market Development Develop market-entry strategies for priority countries and regions. Map government landscapes, including end users, buyers, budget owners, procurement processes, funding sources, and existing capabilities. Identify and engage relevant local partners, institutional stakeholders, and decision-makers. Produce actionable country and market strategies for leadership decision-making. Represent Hydrosat in selected customer, partner, and institutional engagements. Opportunity Intelligence and Early Capture Establish a systematic approach to monitoring relevant RFIs, tenders, funding programs, and institutional initiatives worldwide. Track national and international procurement platforms. Qualify opportunities based on strategic fit, funding, customer access, competitive position, timing, and probability of success. Develop preliminary capture strategies and make clear go/no-go recommendations. Position Hydrosat with key stakeholders before formal procurements are released. Advance qualified opportunities into structured captures Contribute to the development and adoption of Hydrosat ’s value proposition across government markets. Maintain accurate partner, market, and opportunity intelligence in CRM. Requirements At least eight years of experience in international business development, partnerships, channel management, market strategy, or capture. Demonstrated success building commercial partnerships and developing complex government or institutional opportunities. Strong commercial judgment and the ability to operate independently across multiple markets. Confidence engaging senior government, institutional, and industry stakeholders. A proactive, resourceful personality with strong analytical ability, intellectual curiosity, and attention to detail. Ability to turn fragmented market information into clear strategies, priorities, and actions. Excellent written and spoken English. French, Spanish, Portugeuse, or another European language is a strong plus. Experience in Earth observation, space, geospatial intelligence, government markets, water management, agriculture, climate technology, or deep tech is preferred. Willingness to travel internationally. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Do you love new ideas and look to improve the world in ways big and small? How you’ll make a difference The Manager, Strategy & Business Planning formulates, leads, and achieves impact of strategy approaches supporting future organization direction and strategies. Drives growth by developing and implementing strategies to deliver “break-through” business models and innovation within our core offerings. Partners extensively with regions and central functions to drive business growth, planning and alignment while delivering competitive and market intelligence insights. In addition to common responsibilities identified below, individual roles will focus on Business Planning, Regional Support, and Competitive and Market Intelligence programs to drive growth and impact. This role may also support and/or lead corporate development (e.g., M&A, JV, Strategic partnerships) activities as needed. What you’ll bring to the role Bachelor’s degree related in finance, accounting, or other highly quantitative discipline or field(s) related to responsibilities. MBA or equivalent experience desired. Minimum of 7 years’ experience in a strategic role (corporate strategy, corporate finance, consulting, investment banking), with demonstrated experience in driving identification and understanding of key market information to support strategy design, business planning, and decision-making. Experience with international business development; working with global teams. Deep experience developing and designing implementation plans to drive execution. Experience in dealing with sensitive, confidential materials and respect for same, with ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive organization topics and issues. International experience with sensitivity to cultural differences is highly desirable. Demonstrated ability to identify and define business questions and issues, and develop strategic, analytical and financial frameworks to conduct analysis. Creative, out-of-the-box thinker who is intellectually curious with a demonstrated interest in continued learning. Expertise with an array of analytical methods in strategic analysis, market research, and financial modeling. Demonstrated strategy development and corresponding business results. Ability to balance other business considerations. Success in balancing service orientation with need for assertive or persuasive approach. Strong leadership skills, including sound business judgement in assessing and prioritizing competing priorities, as well as demonstrated positive relationship building across diverse cultures and backgrounds. Demonstrated ability to create and apply performance metrics. Strong verbal and written communication skills and finesse, including experienced and polished facilitator, public speaking to small and large groups, as well as ability to give corporate and public presentations. Highly developed organization, planning and management skills with ability to think ahead and plan over a five (5) year horizon. See the big picture while attending to details. Ability and willingness to become thoroughly familiar with project management, the profession, and PMI to command the respect of the organization’s constituencies. Travel up to 50% What you can expect from us We value and nurture an environment of inclusivity and diversity, and a culture of communication and collaboration. Your health, safety and well-being come first, and we believe that you should have time for your work, but you should also have time for you.. Join us and you’ll get: an excellent total package, with compensation and benefits based upon your geographic location. skill development opportunities, to help you grow now and into the future. access to a global network, to enrich your professional experience. flexible options to help balance work time and your time award and bonus opportunities. The salary offer will be based on several factors, including the candidate’s demonstrated skills, qualifications and relevant experience. Let’s help make the world work better for everyone. Apply today! items.title: TECHNICAL SALES REPRESENTATIVE
items.summary: Who we are:We are Pioneering Industrial Sustainability.
items.description: Who we are: We are Pioneering Industrial Sustainability. Castolin Eutectic is a global provider of surface protection applications and solutions. Since 1906, we have brought innovative products and solutions to our customers, challenging ourselves to extend useful life, reduce maintenance costs, and increase industrial productivity while upholding our deep-rooted belief in sustainability. We employ a diverse team worldwide in over 25 countries who represent our core values of customer orientation, integrity, respect, team spirit, and trust. Our employees are part of a global family who work together to provide the best solutions for our customers. Opportunity! We have a current opportunity for a Technical (Industrial) Sales Representative to help grow our welding consumables division. Position Overview The Technical Sales Representative is responsible for maintaining and growing sales with existing customers along with prospecting for new customers. Our ideal candidate will have experience selling in the industrial/manufacturing/fabrication and welding space. Must have an understanding and knowledge of welding, wear mechanisms and maintenance / repair welding. What You’ll Do: Maintain and grow sales in existing customers (customer retention). Prospect for new customers / acquiring new accounts / Cold Calling - Sales Hunter Provide, with the assistance of the technical support group, service and technical support to existing customers. Coordinate request for information or quotations. Manage approval projects for new technologies and applications to current and prospecting customers. Develop a territory plan. Propose and implement marketing strategies in the territory. Ensure continuous improvement and sharing of technical knowledge, competitive and product information and methods. Maintain key information in our internal CRM system. Requirements What You’ll Bring: 2-5 years of SALES experience - Cold Calling A mechanical aptitude A basic knowledge of welding/welding distribution, wear mechanisms and maintenance & repair welding Target minded people that are driven to succeed; thrive under pressure and enjoy setting and achieving goals Energetic and self-motivated individual High level of integrity and committed to serving clients Strong interpersonal skills and a strong ability to listen Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written Detail-oriented and versatile Originally posted on Himalayas

The experience will be promoted to a large kids-and-families audience, with a strong focus on engagement, scalability, and player retention. General information This project is being developed for two major social media creators with a combined audience of 20M+ followers. The Roblox experience is expected to be heavily promoted across their social platforms, so the build needs to support a high-quality player experience and scale effectively as adoption grows. The role covers end-to-end ownership across product planning, development, launch support, and post-launch iteration. This is initially a project-based engagement, with potential for ongoing development and support if the initial launch performs well. Tasks and Deliverables We are looking for a developer/team that can own the project A–Z, including: Game concept and gameplay planning Roblox Studio development Map/world design 3D assets and environments Luau scripting Core gameplay mechanics Multiplayer systems UI/UX Player progression and rewards Data saving Monetization systems Mobile, tablet, PC, and console optimization Testing, debugging, and QA Roblox publishing and launch support Analytics and performance tracking Post-launch updates and improvements Required experience Strong portfolio of published Roblox experiences Deep experience with Roblox Studio and Luau Experience building games designed for large player counts Strong understanding of retention, progression, monetization, and Roblox game loops Experience optimizing Roblox experiences across devices Able to take ownership of both the technical development and overall product Strong communication and project-management skills Experience launching and maintaining successful Roblox games is highly preferred To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-pt-ft-senior-roblox-developer-game-designer

items.title: AI Creative Director / AI Associate Creative Director
items.summary: Superside is seeking visionary AI Creative Directors/Associate Creative Directors to guide a globally distributed team across branding, ad and social creative, presentations, print, and landing pages. In this high-impact role, you’ll shape the future of AI-enhanced creativity by integrating generative tools into our design workflows, elevating both quality and efficiency. You’ll lead by example as both a maker and a mentor, balancing hands-on creative work with strategic guidance. Collaborating with some of the world’s most ambitious brands, you’ll inspire cross-functional teams, develop human-centered creative strategies, and help build a scalable design practice rooted in experimentation, feedback, and continuous improvement.

items.title: Content Creator
items.summary: Superside is looking for a Cape Town based Video Content Creator who is a content creator at heart, comfortable in front of camera, constantly watching ads, and genuinely excited by the challenge of making paid social videos that people want to stop and watch. We’re looking for someone obsessed with new video ideas: the person who sees a Meta ad, a LinkedIn post or a weird Instagram Reel and immediately starts deconstructing why it works. What was the hook? Why did the first three seconds land? Was it the pacing, the caption style, the camera angle, the way the problem was framed? This role is for someone who naturally brings references, has ten rough ideas in the back pocket, and wants to test formats instead of waiting for a perfect brief. This is NOT a traditional video editor role. We’re not looking for someone who only wants to sit behind Premiere Pro and polish footage after the creative thinking is done. We need a hands-on creator who can help find the idea, shape the hook, appear on camera, storyboard the concept, support the shoot, and edit the final piece into something that feels sharp and native to the feed. You’ll work side by side with our Marketing Video Lead in Cape Town, tag-teaming concepts, shoots and edits in our dedicated studio and on location. You’ll also collaborate remotely with Superside’s wider creative team, sometimes owning projects from idea to final edit, and other times contributing to larger campaigns led by others. Your main focus will be creating advertising and brand content for Superside, including UGC-style ads, skits, direct-to-camera videos, explainers, campaign content and quick creative experiments. You’ll also support other teams across marketing on a varied mix of projects when your creative, production or on-camera skills are needed. You care enough about B2B and SaaS to make the work feel specific, not generic. You've got the editing and sound design chops to work confidently in Premiere Pro, the visual sense to storyboard in Figma, and the curiosity to use AI to make the work sharper, faster and more unexpected.

You’ll work with top global brands, crafting high-impact motion graphics, animated digital ads, Lottie animations, and more, all while collaborating with a world-class, globally distributed team of creatives. This is a high-ownership role where you’ll contribute to cutting-edge projects, explore new animation technologies, and help shape Superside’s creative motion capabilities.

items.description: Data Scientist, AI/ML Job Description: Today’s complex, fast-paced systems have become a minefield of reliability risks, any of which could cause an outage that costs millions and destroys customer confidence. That’s why high-availability teams use Gremlin to find and fix reliability risks before they become incidents. Gremlin Reliability Platform helps software teams proactively monitor and test their systems for common reliability risks, build and enforce reliability standards, and automate their reliability practices organization-wide. As the industry leader in Chaos Engineering and reliability testing, we work with hundreds of the world’s largest organizations where high availability is non-negotiable. About the Role of the Data Scientist, AI/ML As a Data Scientist, AI/ML at Gremlin, you will have the opportunity to improve the reliability of the internet at large by turning millions of chaos engineering experiments into automated failure analysis and remediation. You will be able to leverage your applied machine learning experience to inform product direction as well as solve complex technical problems that directly impact our customers (which range from the Fortune 500 to smaller organizations). You will work closely with a small, talented engineering team focused on quality, delivery, and predictability with an emphasis on providing our customers a great user experience. In this role, you’ll get to: Analyze Gremlin’s proprietary dataset of millions of chaos engineering experiments to identify failure patterns, root causes, and resilience signals across complex distributed systems Pretraining and fine-tuning machine learning models that automatically detect, classify, and explain failures observed during chaos experiments Build intelligent systems that deliver automated remediation recommendations, and eventually orchestration, by learning from historical experiment outcomes and system behavior Develop scalable data pipelines and feature stores to process, enrich, and serve large volumes of experiment data for both model training and real-time inference Collaborate closely with platform engineers and SREs to integrate AI-driven failure analysis and remediation capabilities directly into Gremlin’s core product Apply advanced techniques, including causal inference, graph ML, time-series modeling, and reinforcement learning, to continuously improve the accuracy and actionability of automated failure analysis Translate insights from millions of chaos experiments into AI-powered features that help customers automatically understand blast radius, pinpoint root causes, and accelerate recovery Research and productionize novel ML approaches, including causal AI and agentic systems, that turn raw chaos experiment data into automated, reliable remediation strategies We’ll expect you to have: Experience as a self-driven and collaborative problem solver with strong communication skills 5+ years professional experience building and productionizing machine learning, ideally for distributed systems, infrastructure, or DevOps and SRE use cases with more overall years of experience in software development. Hands-on experience with techniques such as causal inference, graph ML, time-series modeling, or reinforcement learning Experience building data pipelines and feature stores that support both offline training and real-time inference Experience with agile development environments and practices Strong advocate and practitioner of rigorous experimentation, model evaluation, and engineering best practices Comfort partnering with platform engineers and SREs to turn research into shipped product features Strong at breaking down ambiguous problems into concrete actions and milestones Bonus Experience: Experience with chaos engineering, site reliability engineering, or distributed systems Background in agentic AI systems or large-scale causal inference in production Experience standing up MLOps tooling such as model serving, monitoring, or feature store infrastructure Working in Remote first environments Has been on-call and participated in an incident management program *The role does not offer sponsorship employment benefits. **If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria above but still are interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box, we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. Compensation We expect the salary range for this role to be $220,000 - $290,000. We recognize that salary varies from person to person depending on level of experience and we welcome direct conversations about it. The final offer will vary based on assessment of a candidate's skills and ability and our budget and market data. Gremlin offers competitive total compensation packages including 401k Matching, Equity and other benefits such as flexible time off and paid company holidays. About Gremlin: Gremlin is a team of industry veterans and people eager to learn from one another. We set the standard for reliability and equip leading organizations with the mindset and expertise needed to drive reliability improvements that move the world forward. We’re backed by top-tier investors Index Ventures, Amplify Partners, and Redpoint Ventures. Our customers love us, and we’re thrilled to be a partner in their success. What Do We Care About: We Care about our People People are our critical differentiators. The company strives to treat our people with respect, empathy, and dignity. We expect that our people will treat each other similarly. In both cases, we will assume good intent. All are welcome at Gremlin. We know our differences make us stronger and that our best ideas and contributions can come from anyone at any level. We Care about Collaboration Gremlin is strongest when we come together as one team with shared goals. Be the glue, not the glitter. But as a remote company, teamwork and collaboration won’t happen by accident. We approach every challenge as a shared challenge. We rely on each other for diverse perspectives and creative ideas. We celebrate our wins as a team. We Care about Results Be high productivity, low drama. Results matter. To keep our pace, everyone owns the outcomes of their actions and takes action when needed. We reward speed over perfection. We empower each other to iterate and experiment. You are welcome at Gremlin for who you are. The more voices and ideas we have represented in our business, the more we will all flourish, contribute, and build a more reliable internet. Gremlin is a place where everyone can grow and is encouraged. However you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this sounds like a role that would make you excited to come into work everyday. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep building a more reliable internet by building and designing tools used by the best companies in the world. Visit our website to learn more - https://www.gremlin.com/about
